title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First day: Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.

First week:

  • Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.
  • Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.
  • Ship a few smaller features.

First month:

  • Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.
  • Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.

First 3 months:

  • Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.
  • Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.
  • Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.

After the first 3 months:

  • Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.
  • Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

title: AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll work on our most ambitious client engagements across DACH, helping leading businesses redefine themselves through AI. You’ll own major workstreams alongside a Senior AI Transformation Lead and the AI engineers who build with you. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the analysis behind the business case, and track the productivity or revenue each build delivers once it’s live. You’ll lead the change on the ground by training users, running workshops and helping people work in entirely new ways. What you learn shapes our products, platform and playbooks, so every engagement is faster and more ambitious than the last, and as one of our first 100 you’ll help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows in DACH.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the top performers wherever you’ve been, at university or at work. You typically have up to four years in consulting, PE, banking, strategy, operations or a high-growth startup. You structure complex problems quickly and back your arguments with data. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, build with it yourself (prototype workflows, agents, internal tools), know what models can and can’t do, and hold your own with engineers. You’re as comfortable with a client’s managers as with the operators doing the work. PE portfolio or value creation experience, exposure to software or services businesses, and German for client work in DACH are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. Learning from people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the chance to shape how the firm delivers and grows in Berlin as an early joiner. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on a problem you're proudest of solving and the impact it had.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Android Developer with Scrum Master Responsibilities (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Build Android software that gets people moving

Want to develop Android apps and see your code become part of a real product? At AUGLETICS, you will work on software for our connected rowing machines and our app. You can try out new features on the equipment and improve them with the team, from an early prototype to a reliable experience for our customers.

We develop and manufacture in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin. Our company has around 25 people. You will join a software team of four to five and work directly with our CTO, Christopher Klabunde. We have plenty of ideas and are looking for someone who enjoys building things, thinks for themselves and cares about quality.

What you will work on

  • Android development: Build new features for our device software and app, improve existing workflows and create an intuitive, reliable user experience.

  • Connected systems: Work on interfaces between the app, device software and backend, helping make data flows and error handling reliable.

  • Hands-on prototyping: Turn ideas into working prototypes, try them on our rowing machines and develop promising approaches with the team.

  • Quality from the start: Write understandable, maintainable code, take part in reviews and tests, and fix problems thoroughly.

  • AI-assisted development: Use AI tools for ideas, coding, testing and debugging. Understand and verify their output before it becomes part of the product.

Your role as Scrum Master

Alongside your technical work, you will help our projects move forward as a team. As Scrum Master, you will coordinate collaboration within our software team and with external development agencies, working closely with CTO Christopher Klabunde. This role does not include line-management responsibility.

  • Bring internal developers and external partners into a shared plan, with clear responsibilities, next steps and acceptance criteria.

  • Prepare and facilitate agile discussions, such as sprint planning, short daily check-ins, reviews and retrospectives, adapted to the needs of our projects.

  • Track dependencies, milestones and open decisions, raise obstacles early and help the team resolve them.

  • Help bring everyone’s work together so it can be tested as a complete product and prepared for reliable releases.

If you already have Scrum Master or project coordination experience, bring it with you. If you are new to the role, Chris and the team will support you as you grow into it. A Scrum Master certification is welcome, but not required.

What you bring

  • Programming fundamentals and an interest in native Android development with Kotlin or Java. Android experience is welcome; if you are new to it, tell us how you learn and why it interests you.

  • The ability to explain how you approach a technical problem. Personal apps, learning projects, university work, internships and student jobs all count alongside professional experience.

  • An interest in writing reliable, maintainable software and learning how to test it well.

  • Openness to AI-assisted app development and a willingness to question and check the results.

  • Initiative, a collaborative approach and the desire to learn an existing product and gradually take ownership.

  • Good spoken and written English is required. You need to discuss technical topics confidently with the team. German is not required, but it is a strong advantage.

  • The ability to work regularly on site in Königs Wusterhausen, where we develop and test directly on the devices.

A degree in computer science or a related subject, relevant vocational training, or equivalent knowledge provides a good foundation.

Experienced or just starting out? We would like to meet you

Already have several years of experience? Great – bring your ideas and a fresh perspective. New to this field or looking for your first professional role? That is welcome too. If you are excited about our product, have a technical foundation and learn quickly, we would like to hear from you.

Whichever stage you are at, it is our job to help you settle into the team and provide the knowledge, tools and support you need to succeed. You will get to know our product and ways of working alongside Chris and the team. We will match your initial tasks and responsibilities to your experience and help you grow from there.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Firebase as an app backend, for example user authentication, data storage or server-side logic.

  • Experience in iOS development, ideally with Swift or SwiftUI.

  • Knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, API integration or connecting software to devices.

What we offer

  • A real product you can try out yourself, with a direct impact on how our customers train.

  • A company of around 25 people, a small software team and close collaboration with CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Room for your ideas and professional growth, with responsibilities that develop with your skills.

  • A permanent, full-time position: 40 hours per week and 28 days of annual leave.

  • €50,000–€65,000 gross per year, depending on your relevant skills and experience.

  • A workplace in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one or two days of working from home per week by agreement.

Working near Berlin

Our office is at Zur Heide 10, Königs Wusterhausen. The town has direct S46 S-Bahn and regional train connections to Berlin; you can cycle from the station to our office. Regular on-site work matters because development, testing and teamwork happen around the actual rowing machines. This is a hybrid role based in Germany.

How to apply

Send us your CV in English or German. No formal cover letter is needed. A GitHub link or an app you have worked on is welcome, but optional.

We will start with a short online conversation, followed by a closer look at your experience, learning approach and the work at AUGLETICS.

title: Architecture Modeling Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Architecture Modeling Engineer you will own performance modeling and workload analysis for Arago's optical AI accelerator, working across hardware and software teams to evaluate design choices, shape the programming model, and optimize key compute kernels. This role turns workload requirements into architecture decisions and, ultimately, high-performance software on silicon.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong mathematical background, particularly in linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and quantitative performance analysis.

  • Strong knowledge of computer architecture, including compute pipelines, memory hierarchies, interconnects, and parallel execution.

  • Strong C/C++ and Python programming skills.

  • Experience analyzing and optimizing performance-critical kernels or low-level compute workloads.

  • Good understanding of AI/ML workloads, tensor operations, data movement, and common execution patterns.

  • Ability to work across hardware and software teams and translate workload behavior into architecture and software requirements.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Develop fast, flexible performance models to evaluate AI accelerator architecture choices and guide early design decisions.

  • Work closely with the software team to characterize key AI workloads, kernels, dataflows, and system bottlenecks.

  • Work closely with hardware architects to model compute, memory, interconnect, and scheduling behavior across proposed architectures.

  • Drive rapid performance studies and trade-off analyses across throughput, latency, utilization, bandwidth, and efficiency.

  • Help define and validate the programming model and workload mapping strategy for the accelerator.

  • Following architecture definition, work hands-on with the software team to optimize compute kernels and key workloads for the target hardware.

  • Build lightweight simulation, profiling, and analysis tools that support fast iteration from architecture exploration through software optimization.

Nice to have

  • Strong industry knowledge about AI hardware, GPUs, memory generations, rack-scale computing.

  • Experience building performance models, simulators, or analytical models for CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, or other accelerators.

  • Experience with profiling, benchmarking, and identifying hardware or software performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience in novel computing architectures: analog computing, in-memory computing, heterogeneous systems.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. You will gain hands-on experience selling AI-driven business transformation, build relationships with industry leaders across Celonis verticals, including Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, FSI,  Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Retail, Energy and Public Sector and develop the leadership skills needed to drive real change for enterprise customers.

Strategic Business Development & Executive Relationship Building

The qualifications you need:

  • Strong Academic Foundation: You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.
  • Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.
  • Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.
  • Industry Edge: You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.
  • Communication Excellence: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in Business English. Fluency in Dutch is a strong plus.
  • Analytical & Independent Thinker: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters.   • Work closely with your team, which includes business development representatives, value engineers, partner managers, and marketing specialists, to ensure seamless collaboration and success. 
  • Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven Track Record in Client-Facing Roles: You bring 2–3 years of professional experience from a top-tier management consultancy, corporate strategy/transformation function, or leading enterprise technology company. 
  • Strong Academic Foundation: You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.
  • Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.
  • Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.
  • Industry Edge: You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.
  • Communication Excellence: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in both English and German.
  • Analytical & Independent Thinker: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. title: Associate
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 


About the role

 

As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our clients in the industry.

We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI tools are optimised for real-world operations.

This is an exciting, new role for an individual motivated to build their knowledge of AI transformation in the Energy value chain.

  

What you'll be doing

 

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

  • Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

     

Who we're looking for

 

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You have some experience working on AI/data intensive projects in the Energy sector

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects/products

  • You’ve worked with technical teams

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, with examples of when you’ve taken initiative and owned finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and knowledgeable about the possibilities for innovation in Government technology

  

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
  • Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership 

Customer Research (~20%)

  • Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
  • Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)

  • Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
  • Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

Stakeholders

Product Managers: Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
Engineering & Design: Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
Customer Success: Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
Sales: Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
Marketing: Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
Customers: Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

title: Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Der Kopp Verlag ist ein unabhängiges Medien- und E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung am Markt und einem eigenständigen publizistischen Ansatz. Unser Sortiment reicht von Büchern und Zeitschriften über Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Lebensmittel und Drogerie bis hin zu Outdoor & Survival sowie Haus & Garten.

Ohne eine funktionierende IT läuft bei uns wenig: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerke, Server, Anwendungen und zahlreiche miteinander verbundene Systeme bilden die technische Grundlage unseres Unternehmens. Genau hier lernst du während deiner Ausbildung, wie moderne IT-Infrastrukturen aufgebaut, betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden.

Du interessierst dich für Computer, Netzwerke und Technik, willst verstehen, wie IT-Systeme wirklich funktionieren, und löst gerne Probleme? Dann ist die Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen Azubis, die mehr wollen, als einfach nur einen Abschluss zu machen. Du solltest neugierig sein, Verantwortung übernehmen wollen und den Anspruch haben, dich ständig weiterzuentwickeln. Dafür bekommst du bei uns früh echte Aufgaben, direkte Rückmeldung und die Möglichkeit, dir langfristig etwas aufzubauen.

Deine Ausbildung

  • Du lernst unsere IT-Infrastruktur und die verschiedenen Systeme im Unternehmen von Grund auf kennen
  • Du richtest Arbeitsplätze, Hardware und Software ein und unterstützt bei deren laufender Betreuung
  • Du lernst, wie Netzwerke, Server und unterschiedliche IT-Systeme zusammenspielen
  • Du unterstützt bei der Einrichtung, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Infrastruktur
  • Du analysierst Störungen und Fehler und lernst, Probleme systematisch zu finden und zu beheben
  • Du unterstützt Kollegen bei technischen Fragen und sorgst mit dafür, dass sie zuverlässig arbeiten können
  • Du lernst, IT-Systeme zu dokumentieren und Änderungen sauber nachzuhalten
  • Du bekommst Einblick in unterschiedliche Unternehmenssysteme und Schnittstellen
  • Du lernst moderne KI- und Automatisierungstools kennen und wie du sie im IT-Alltag sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll einsetzt
  • Du arbeitest bei echten Projekten mit und übernimmst mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigene Aufgaben
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren erfahrenen IT-Kollegen zusammen und lernst direkt aus der Praxis

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens Mittlere Reife, Fachhochschulreife oder (Fach-)Abitur; bei einer Umschulung eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung
  • Du interessierst dich für IT, Technik, Computer und Netzwerke
  • Du denkst logisch und hast Spaß daran, technische Probleme zu lösen
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bringst dich aktiv ein
  • Du bist selbstständig, zuverlässig und lernbereit
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig
  • Auch wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb funktioniert, bleibst du dran und suchst nach einer Lösung

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Simulation & Robotics, 2027 (Zurich)
descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. You will architect and implement the algorithms that run on every drone powered by Skydio as part of a world class computer vision and deep learning team with researchers who have pushed the state of the art in academia and industry.

As a Research Intern, you will be paired up with one or more members of our core software development team, assuming direct ownership of a project that meaningfully advances the capabilities of our team and products.

If you have a strong foundation in math, theory, and software development and you are interested in directly contributing to the development of the next generation of autonomy algorithms and pushing them into real products, we would love to hear from you.

 

Areas of Responsibility:

  • Core Simulator Architecture: Design, implement, and evolve the foundational architecture of the Skydio Simulator, ensuring it scales across vehicle types, environments, and use cases.

  • Physics and Dynamics: Improve and extend physics models governing vehicle motion, interactions with the environment, and dynamic agents.

  • Sensor and Hardware Simulation: Build high-fidelity simulations of cameras, IMUs, and other onboard components, including timing, noise characteristics, and hardware behavior.

  • Autonomy Stack Integration: Run and validate the full Skydio autonomy stack in simulation, ensuring consistency between simulated and real-world behavior.

  • Feature Development on Top of the Core: Implement simulator capabilities that unlock new workflows for customers and internal autonomy engineers, from training scenarios to advanced testing modes.

  • Performance and Fidelity: Profile, optimize, and improve simulator performance while continuously pushing realism and accuracy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop core simulator components in C++ and Python, working close to real-time constraints.

  • Collaborate with autonomy, perception, and controls engineers to align simulation behavior with real-world systems.

  • Debug complex interactions between physics, sensors, autonomy logic, and rendering.

  • Help shape the long-term technical direction of the simulator as both a product and an internal platform.

  • Contribute to documentation and shared understanding of how the simulator works internally.

Qualifications:

  • Strong software engineering experience with C++ and Python.

  • Experience building complex systems where performance, determinism, or correctness matter.

  • Comfort reasoning about time-synchronized systems, state machines, or real-time execution.

  • Ability to work in a large, evolving codebase with multiple stakeholders.

  • Interest in robotics, simulation, or physical systems (prior robotics experience is a plus, not a requirement).

Bonus Experience:

  • Robotics, simulation, game engines, or real-time systems.

  • Physics engines, sensor modeling, or hardware abstraction layers.

  • Multithreaded or low-latency system design.

  • Experience debugging systems that span software and physical behavior.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Masters, and $70/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. In addition to base salary, Skydio full-time employees are eligible to enroll in our benefit plans and take advantage of a variety of incentives and stipends.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

How we build software

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

  • Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

  • Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation.

What you bring

  • [3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience.

  • Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred).

  • You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain.

  • Fluent English.

Bonus: ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta) or attribution; AI or agent features in production (Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, MCP, RAG); LLM evaluation or observability; team use of Claude Code or similar; data pipelines; German.

What we offer

  • Direct impact on how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously.

  • A genuine AI-first culture: experiment, automate, share.

  • A transparent culture at eye level, with regular team events.

  • Strategy Days twice a year where the whole team shapes company strategy (past: Helsinki, Berlin, Belgrade, Swiss Alps, Zurich).

Application process

  1. Profile review and phone screen

  2. Take-home assignment: a backend feature

  3. Technical discussion with the engineering team

  4. [On-site] interview and team evaluation

title: Brand Director
descriptionHtml:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

  • Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

  • Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

  • A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

  • Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

  • Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

  • Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

  • Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

  • Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

  • You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

  • You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

  • You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

  • You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

  • You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

  • We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in the summer and one week in the winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). This enables everyone to actually disconnect and enjoy their vacation. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Per French standard, we also offer another 4 weeks to allow team members to choose when they want to take time off.

How to apply:

Send us your CV and a portfolio, plus one thing you'd rewrite on our website or in our app, and why. Keep it short. We'll know.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

Gesucht wird dabei ausdrücklich kein rein administrativer Team Lead. Du solltest aus dem Outbound Sales kommen, erfolgreiche Vertriebsansätze selbst angewendet haben und in der Lage sein, diese Erfahrung sehr praxisnah an dein Team weiterzugeben.

Deine Aufgabe

Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams von Business Development Representatives und entwickelst dieses zu einer leistungsstarken Outbound-Organisation weiter.

Dabei gehören insbesondere folgende Themen zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Leadership & Coaching: Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst deine BDRs kontinuierlich weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre individuellen Ziele zu erreichen und perspektivisch den nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen.

  • Hands-on Sales Coaching: Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team im Tagesgeschäft, analysierst Calls und Outreach-Aktivitäten und vermittelst konkrete Methoden und Best Practices aus deiner eigenen Vertriebserfahrung.

  • Performance Management: Du steuerst das Team anhand relevanter KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Qualität und Produktivität ab.

  • Outbound Excellence: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Prospecting-Ansätze, Messaging, Playbooks und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Teamaufbau: Du unterstützt bei Recruiting und Onboarding neuer BDRs und stellst sicher, dass neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.

  • Sales Strategy: Du arbeitest eng mit dem weiteren Sales Leadership sowie angrenzenden Teams zusammen und übersetzt Markt- und Kundenfeedback in wirkungsvolle Akquisitionsstrategien.

  • Customer Focus: Du stellst sicher, dass das Team trotz hoher Outbound-Aktivität einen professionellen, beratenden und kundenorientierten Vertriebsansatz verfolgt.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Wir suchen eine Person mit einem starken operativen Sales-Background und erster bzw. fundierter Führungserfahrung in einem ambitionierten B2B-Vertriebsumfeld.

Besonders relevant sind:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Business Development / Sales Development / Outbound Sales

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbar dynamischen Geschäftsmodell

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, Coaching oder in der Führung von SDR-/BDR-Teams

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Outbound-Methoden und Sales-Prozesse

  • Erfahrung mit KPI- und datenbasierter Vertriebssteuerung

  • Ausgeprägte Coaching-Mentalität und Freude daran, andere Vertriebler besser zu machen

  • Fähigkeit, eigene Sales-Erfahrung in konkrete Methoden, Playbooks und Trainings zu übersetzen

  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch bei gleichzeitig pragmatischer und umsetzungsorientierter Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Was die Rolle besonders macht

Die Position bietet deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum als eine klassische Team-Lead-Rolle.

Du übernimmst ein Team in einer wichtigen Wachstumsphase und kannst unmittelbar beeinflussen, wie Outbound Sales organisiert, gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Management und der kommerziellen Führung des Unternehmens zusammen.

Die Rolle eignet sich besonders für jemanden, der weiterhin nah am operativen Vertrieb bleiben möchte und Spaß daran hat, ein Team nicht nur zu managen, sondern durch Coaching, Struktur und eigene Sales-Erfahrung messbar besser zu machen.

Das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant ist ein wachstumsstarkes europäisches Technologieunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Das Unternehmen bietet eine B2B-Softwarelösung für mittelständische Unternehmen und hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren erfolgreich in mehreren europäischen Märkten etabliert.

Das internationale Team arbeitet in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und einer ausgeprägten Ownership-Kultur.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid mit klarem Fokus auf die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort

  • Rolle: Führungsverantwortung für ein Business-Development-Team

  • Umfeld: Internationales B2B-SaaS-/Tech-Unternehmen in einer starken Wachstumsphase

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: mit dem Sales Leadership und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern

Die Suche wird von uns im Rahmen eines direkten Recruiting-Mandats begleitet. Weitere Informationen zum Unternehmen, zur Teamstruktur und zum Auswahlprozess teilen wir gerne im persönlichen Austausch.

title: Business Director H/F - CDI
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

À propos de WPP Media :

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. 

Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. 

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com. 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com. 

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et missions :

Vous prendrez la responsabilité du compte MGM au sein de l’équipe OpenDoor (entité qui gère l’ensemble des LOB d’Amazon au sein de WPP Media France).

Sur ce portefeuille d'envergure, nous recherchons un Business Director – Client Lead pour incarner le conseil de haut niveau, guider les recommandations stratégiques et accompagner la montée en compétences d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire.

Vos missions principales :

  1. Vision Stratégique, Écriture & Prise de Hauteur :
  • Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et spécifique à chaque sortie cinéma en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°.
  • Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés.
  • Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.
  1. Appétence Innovation & Développement de la Valeur Client :
  • Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment : Influence & Content / Opérations Spéciales, Event…
  • Dans une démarche conseil créatrice de valeur (et non de pur push commercial), savoir détecter dans les échanges clients les besoins émergents pour co-construire des solutions sur-mesure avec l'appui des équipes d'experts internes (Data, Studio, Activation).
  1. Leadership Managérial & Coaching Orienté Développement :
  • Encadrer et animer une équipe (Account Directors, Account Managers, Executives, Alternants).
  • S'appuyer sur la forte autonomie de l'équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle du quotidien pour adopter une posture de mentor et de coach.
  • Identifier les axes de progression individuels — notamment sur la prise de hauteur stratégique, l'écriture et la formalisation des recommandations — et accompagner le développement des collaborateurs seniors pour les aider à franchir des caps majeurs.
  1. Coordination 360 & Orchestration Interne :
  • Assurer l'orchestration globale des réponses plurimédias (Online & Offline) en faisant le lien fluide entre le conseil, le planning stratégique, la création et les équipes d'activation technique (Social, Programmatique, TV/Vidéo).

Profil Recherché :

  • Expérience : 10 à 12 ans d'expérience en agence média sur des fonctions de conseil, de stratégie média et de relation client.
  • Expertise dans l’industrie du Cinéma, idéalement ayant déjà piloté un compte Entertainment (distributeur cinéma).
  • Expertise Média 360 : Solide culture générale des médias (Off & Online).
  • Qualités Rédactionnelles & Synthèse : Excellence reconnue dans la réflexion et l'écriture stratégique, capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à porter des dossiers stratégiques de haut niveau.
  • Posture Managériale :  Capacité avérée à faire progresser ses équipes par l'accompagnement et le coaching plutôt que par le micro-management.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel obligatoire.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent :

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.
  • Congés offerts : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.
  • Ancienneté : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.
  • Santé & Équité : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.
  • Engagement sociétal : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act.
  • Tools : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).

Process de recrutement :

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

  1. Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.
  2. Entretiens Opérationnels : Une rencontre avec les leads des comptes à gérer. Au moins un entretien physique est prévu dans nos locaux.
  3. Étude de cas : Réalisation d'un Business Case stratégique pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, de synthèse, la qualité de votre écriture et votre vision média.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.  

Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité.  

Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.
