title: Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) – AI, MarTech & Digital Solutions
descriptionHtml:
100% remote.

Neue AI-Tools, autonome Agenten, Automatisierungen, neue Plattformen oder smartere Wege, digitales Marketing effizienter zu machen: Wenn Technologie auf Marketing trifft, wirst Du neugierig.

Und noch besser: Du willst nicht nur darüber reden, sondern ausprobieren, bauen und umsetzen.

Wir sind eine unabhängige Digital-Performance-Agentur aus Deutschland und verbinden über 25 Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung mit AI, First-Party Data, eigener Technologie und datengetriebenen Lösungen.

Als Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest Du direkt mit unserem Director of Business Innovation und unserem Innovation-Team zusammen. Ihr identifiziert neue Möglichkeiten, testet Ideen und entwickelt daraus Lösungen, die bei uns und unseren Kunden tatsächlich etwas bewegen.

Kurz gesagt: Du machst aus „Das müsste man mal ausprobieren“ ein „Läuft.“

Dein Spielfeld:

  • Du findest heraus, was wirklich Potenzial hat.
    Neue AI-Anwendungen, APIs, Plattformen, Automatisierungen oder Entwicklungen im digitalen Marketing: Du behältst den Überblick, probierst Neues aus und bewertest, was für hurra.com und unsere Kunden echten Mehrwert bringt – und was einfach nur der nächste Hype ist.

  • Du baust Lösungen statt PowerPoints.
    Aus guten Ideen machst Du funktionierende Lösungen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Tools, Automatisierungen und Workflows und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz. Dabei kann es um AI, Data, Search, Media, Content, Analytics oder ganz neue Marketing-Technologien gehen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen auch gut bleiben.
    Was funktioniert, wird nicht einfach abgehakt. Du entwickelst bestehende Tools und Anwendungen weiter, machst sie stabiler und skalierbarer und kümmerst Dich darum, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig laufen.

  • Du bringst Marketing, Business und Tech zusammen.
    Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Search, Media, Data, Strategy und weiteren Bereichen zusammen. Du verstehst ihre Herausforderungen, übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen und bist Sparringspartner für neue Ideen und deren Machbarkeit.

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Du kennst digitales Marketing und denkst technisch.
    Du musst nicht in jeder Disziplin Spezialist sein. Aber Du solltest verstehen, wie digitales Marketing funktioniert und Spaß daran haben, es mit Technologie besser zu machen.

  • Du baust Dinge, statt nur darüber zu reden.
    Du probierst aus, entwickelst Prototypen, verbindest Systeme und schreibst auch mal ein Script. APIs, Automatisierungen, AI-Schnittstellen, LLMs und AI-Agenten sind für Dich keine Buzzwords, sondern Werkzeuge, mit denen Du echte Lösungen baust.

  • Du wartest nicht auf das nächste Briefing.
    Du erkennst neue Möglichkeiten, entwickelst eigene Ideen und bringst Themen selbstständig voran. Wenn etwas noch keine fertige Lösung hat, wird es für Dich erst interessant.

  • Du kannst technische Themen verständlich machen.
    Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe – auch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die nicht jeden Tag mit APIs oder AI-Agenten arbeiten. Dafür solltest Du Deutsch verhandlungssicher beherrschen. Gute Englischkenntnisse helfen Dir zusätzlich.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet:

  • 100 % remote und flexibel.
    Arbeite dort, wo Du am besten arbeitest – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne unnötige Präsenzpflicht.

  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement.
    Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Dinge auszuprobieren und Themen gemeinsam mit dem Director of Business Innovation voranzutreiben.

  • Eine ziemlich große Spielwiese.
    AI, Data, Automatisierung, MarTech, Search, Media, neue Plattformen und eigene Technologien: Dein Themenfeld ist bewusst breit.

  • Direkter Weg von der Idee zur Umsetzung.
    Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen. Gute Ideen sollen bei uns nicht in Präsentationen verschwinden, sondern ausprobiert werden.

  • Benefits, die zählen.
    EGYM Wellpass, Bike-Leasing, moderne technische Ausstattung und ein Team mit ziemlich viel Know-how in Search, Data, Media und Tech.

So einfach bewirbst Du Dich:

Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Schick uns Deinen CV und ein kurzes Video – zum Beispiel über Loom. In zwei bis drei Minuten würden wir gerne von Dir erfahren:

  • Welche Technologie oder welches digitale Marketing-Thema Dich gerade wirklich begeistert

  • Was Du zuletzt gebaut, automatisiert, getestet oder verbessert hast

  • Wie Du an technische Herausforderungen herangehst, für die es noch keine fertige Lösung gibt

  • Was wir unbedingt über Dich wissen sollten

Das Video ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Bewerbung - ohne geht's nicht. Uns interessiert nicht nur, was in Deinem CV steht, sondern auch, wie Du denkst, Probleme angehst und über Technologie sprichst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

title: Business Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the team & role

Our newest department, Motorway Enterprise, is bringing our proven marketplace model to the fleet and leasing sector - a 2-million-car market representing a quarter of all UK used vehicle sales. Launched in May 2026 with Mobilize Financial Services (Renault, Nissan, Dacia, and Alpine), our platform allows end-of-lease drivers to profile cars directly through our app and auction them to 8,000+ verified dealers. By removing physical storage and repeated transport, we cut weeks off traditional remarketing times and significantly lower costs.

As the department’s first dedicated commercial hire, you will build this business line from the ground up and shape a high-growth product inside an established scale-up. You will serve as the day-to-day contact for enterprise partners, running business reviews, tracking performance, and fully owning key relationships within six months. Acting as the operational bridge between external partners, our dealer network, and internal product, engineering, and ops teams, you will troubleshoot issues, write scalable runbooks, and collaborate with the commercial lead on pitches and new client onboarding.

What you’ll be doing:

What you’ll do:

  • Drive commercial strategy: Identify growth opportunities across partner, dealer, and transport revenue streams, collaborating closely with partner Commercial Leads to optimise pricing and fee structures.

  • Lead key partnerships: Serve as the trusted, day-to-day contact for Enterprise partners - leading monthly and quarterly business reviews backed by robust data and actionable insights.

  • Optimise trading performance: Build and leverage real-time dashboards to proactively pinpoint and resolve friction in pricing, dealer engagement, and ready-for-sale conversion rates.

  • Build scalable operations: Diagnose operational bottlenecks, partner with internal teams to implement lasting fixes, and author standard runbooks to automate workflows.

  • Accelerate dealer demand: Work alongside dealer account managers and engage directly with top-tier buyers to analyse purchasing trends, build account plans, and scale transaction volumes.

  • Champion the product: Establish yourself as the go-to subject matter expert on the Enterprise product, guiding internal teams and sharing critical domain knowledge across the business.

  • Support business development: Power new partner pitches and commercial business cases with sharp data analysis and realistic operational blueprints.

About you

  • Data fluent: You don’t just read dashboards and spreadsheets - you uncover the narrative within the numbers to drive clear business decisions.

  • Hands-on with AI tools: You have practical experience building, maintaining, and deploying AI workflows, agents, or artifacts that are actively integrated into day-to-day operations.

  • Strategic & execution-focused: Proven track record of translating analytical findings into structured action plans and delivering them to completion.

  • Client-ready communicator: Comfortable representing Motorway in both written briefs and high-stakes client meetings, distilling complex ideas into clear, digestible messages for senior stakeholders.

  • Commercially minded: A sharp understanding of how pricing levers, volume shifts, and operational costs drive unit economics and P&L outcomes, with an instinct for stakeholder priorities in negotiations.

  • Relentless problem solver: A demonstrated history of taking full, end-to-end ownership of messy problems in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Fast, curious learner: Automotive experience isn't required - what matters is your appetite to dive in, master our ecosystem, and scale a new industry standard.

You could be a great fit if

  • You’re an adaptable generalist who thrives when shifting gears across commercial, analytical, operational, and client-facing tasks in a single day.

  • You quickly build credibility, communicate with poise, and foster high-trust relationships with executive stakeholders.

  • You want genuine ownership in an early-stage department, taking as much satisfaction in designing the playbook as you do executing it.

  • You’re allergic to repetitive manual tasks and actively seek ways to streamline routine workflows using modern automation and AI tooling.

  • You prefer working with real-time data every single day to guide your decisions, rather than waiting for a monthly retrospective.

  • You’re open-minded, receptive to feedback, and genuinely curious about the mechanics of how the automotive market moves.

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

title: Business Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Business Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

descriptionHtml:
Mission principale

Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.

Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Principales responsabilités

A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale

  • Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année.

  • Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs.

  • Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements.

  • Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs.

  • Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération.

  • Préparer les analyses nécessaires aux revues budgétaires et aux présentations destinées au CODIR.

B. HR Data Analytics et aide à la décision

  • Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH.

  • Analyser les tendances RH et identifier les principaux facteurs d'évolution des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur le turnover, l'absentéisme, le recrutement, la mobilité interne, les rémunérations et les parcours professionnels.

  • Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles.

  • Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats.

  • Concevoir des analyses prospectives et, lorsque les données le permettent, des modèles de prévision pour anticiper les évolutions des effectifs et des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers.

C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation

  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles.

  • Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats.

  • Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique.

  • Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH.

D. Projets RH

title: Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

title: Chief of Staff or Founders Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.

About the role

We are looking for a Founders Associate or Chief of Staff to help build and run the operations of a young company and to automate them as we go. We will hire one person for this role. The title and scope depend on your experience: as a Founders Associate you will work alongside the founders on the operations; as Chief of Staff you will own key operational areas.

We want to build Grubel the way we build our products: with AI agents doing significant work. Your job is to help make the company run and to ask which parts of it should be run by software instead.

You will work directly with the founders on everything it takes to build the company: hiring, finance, legal and corporate housekeeping across our German and US entities, funding programs, investor communication, and the tools and processes that hold it all together. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how a company is built from the inside, or who has done it before and wants to do it again with better tools.

What you'll work on

  • Running our hiring process, from job postings and candidate communication to contracts and onboarding

  • Keeping our German and US entities in order: accounting, payroll, and corporate paperwork

  • Managing public funding programs and preparing investor updates

  • Setting up the tools our team runs on, and building AI agents that take over routine operations

  • Supporting the founders on projects that do not fit anywhere else, from offsites to partnership contracts

You may be a good fit if

  • You have a degree in business, economics, law, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • You have worked in a startup, consulting firm, or another fast-moving environment. You may be early in your career with exceptional evidence of ownership, or more experienced and ready to help build a company’s operations from scratch

  • You are organized, reliable, and happy to own tasks nobody has done before

  • You already use AI tools heavily in your own work and want to push that much further

  • You communicate well in English and German

Logistics

  • Location: Munich. This role is primarily on-site, with flexibility for individual days at home.

  • Full time employment

  • Competitive salary plus participation in our employee stock option program in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company.

Durch unseren starken Fokus auf Shopify bieten wir individuelle Beratung, technologische Exzellenz und erstklassigen Service. Unsere Kunden profitieren von einem engagierten und transparenten Team, das Qualität und Geschwindigkeit vereint.

Zu den Kunden von we-site zählen sowohl mittelständische Unternehmen als auch erfolgreiche D2C-Brands, darunter Miamor, nomadi, Hamburger Abendblatt, BirdBike, NeoTaste und Kärcher.

Unser Ziel: nachhaltiges Wachstum, messbare Ergebnisse und Onlineshops, die nicht nur optisch überzeugen, sondern Umsatz generieren.

Wir denken Agentur neu. Lust, dabei zu sein?

Deine Rolle

Du verbindest Daten, Nutzerverhalten und Design. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf CRO, A/B-Testing und der messbaren Optimierung von E-Commerce-Erlebnissen.

Du entwickelst aus Daten und Nutzerfeedback konkrete Optimierungsideen und setzt diese in Figma, Prototypen und Testvarianten um. Dabei ergänzt du unser bestehendes Design-Team um einen datengetriebenen CRO-Fokus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Online-Shops, Nutzerpfade und Conversion Funnels und identifizierst die wichtigsten Hebel für eine bessere User Experience und höhere Conversion.

  • Du entwickelst datenbasierte Hypothesen und konkrete Optimierungskonzepte für Startseiten, Kategorie- und Produktseiten, Warenkorb sowie Checkout.

  • Du erstellst Wireframes, UI-Designs und klickbare Prototypen in Figma und bereitest deine Konzepte verständlich für Kund:innen und Development auf.

  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, begleitest deren Umsetzung und bewertest die Ergebnisse anhand relevanter Kennzahlen.

  • Du leitest aus Testergebnissen konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab und dokumentierst Learnings für weitere Optimierungen.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere CRO-Prozesse, Testlogik und wiederverwendbaren UX- und Design-Bausteine weiter.

Praxiserfahrung

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in CRO, UX/UI Design, E-Commerce, Product Design oder einer Digitalagentur mit und hast bereits Online-Shops oder digitale Produkte datenbasiert optimiert, idealerweise inklusive A/B-Tests und eigener Figma-Konzepte.

Know-How

  • Du beherrschst Figma sicher und hast ein gutes Verständnis für UI/UX, Usability, Informationsarchitektur, responsive Design und typische E-Commerce-Strecken.

  • Du kennst die Grundlagen von CRO, Conversion Funnels und A/B-Testing und kannst Daten aus Tools wie Google Analytics 4 oder Shopify Analytics in konkrete Optimierungsideen übersetzen.

Soft Skills

  • Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit einem guten Gespür für Gestaltung, Nutzerbedürfnisse und klare digitale Erlebnisse.

  • Du argumentierst Designentscheidungen mit Daten, Nutzerfeedback und nachvollziehbaren Hypothesen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert und bringst Themen zuverlässig ins Ziel.

  • Du kommunizierst klar mit Kund:innen, Designer:innen, Entwickler:innen und Projektmanager:innen.

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und hast Freude an iterativer Arbeit, schneller Umsetzung und messbaren Ergebnissen.

WARUM WIR?

Deine Benefits

  • Arbeiten an echten, komplexen Shopify-Projekten bei starken Mittelstands- und D2C-Kunden

  • Lernkultur: Dein persönliches und fachliches Wachstum ist uns sehr wichtig

  • Große Eigenverantwortung und Raum, ein ambitioniertes Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Du siehst innerhalb kürzester Zeit die Früchte deiner Arbeit

  • Work hard, play hard! Wöchentliche Frühstücke, digitale Teamabende und physische Teamevents

  • Mindestens 1x pro Jahr eine Workation mit dem ganzen Team (Mallorca, Ski-Fahren, Dänemark)

Für uns selbstverständlich

  • Attraktives Gehalt

  • Hoher Ausstattungsstandard: Eigener Laptop, Stehschreibtisch, Dual-Monitor-Setup, eigene Telefonnummer etc.

  • Transparente Company Culture mit regelmäßigen Roadmap- und Feedbackmeetings

title: Customer Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will spearhead ambitious growth across our Public Services portfolio. Blending strategic consulting with AI delivery, you will unlock potential for UK Government departments and international partners.

You will lead multi-disciplinary teams to design AI solutions, navigate multi-million-pound programmes, and build trusting relationships with senior government stakeholders across key areas like the Home Office, Department for Education, DWP, HMRC, DEFRA, and MHCLG.

This is an entrepreneurial opportunity to shape the future of public services by turning cutting-edge AI into operational impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving sales growth and executing strategic account plans to hit ambitious multi-million-pound revenue targets across central government accounts.

  • Leading complex commercial negotiations, bidding opportunities, and pricing proposals for new and existing public sector portfolios.

  • Nurturing long-term relationships with senior government budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high client satisfaction.

  • Overseeing cross-functional delivery teams to guarantee high-quality execution of large-scale AI transformation programmes and GDS-style digital products and the associated digital service and technology infrastructure required

  • Mentoring team members to accelerate their professional development while supporting scalable business unit growth.

  • Proactively identifying innovative, data-oriented AI use cases that solve complex public sector challenges.

  • Advising client directors on AI strategy, engineering concepts, and technical implementation to demonstrate continuous value.

  • Serving as a key member of the Public Services leadership group, shaping strategic direction, driving commercial growth, and embedding customer excellence across the sector.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring a comprehensive background in consulting or public sector strategy, with proven experience leading large-scale transformation programmes across government and public accounts.

  • You possess a natural business development mindset, combining an appetite for commercial hunting with deep relationship-building skills to manage multi-million-pound deal processes.

  • You bring demonstrable experience in digital government transformation alongside strong commercial fluency in cutting-edge AI capabilities.

  • You excel at managing complex stakeholder relationships, guiding senior civil servants through fast-paced, high-stakes programmes with structured problem-solving.

  • You bring technical curiosity and acumen to engage confidently with technical teams and advise client directors on AI and advise client directors on the creative and safe applications of AI within their most important areas of business.

  • You demonstrate an entrepreneurial, adaptable leadership style with a proven ability to translate intricate technical concepts into real business value.

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Customer Information Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Customer Information Manager at the Bank of Communications Frankfurt Branch, you will be joining a dynamic team within a reputable global banking institution. Established in 2007, our Frankfurt branch serves as a crucial link between China and Europe, facilitating international trade and financial transactions. With a dedicated workforce of around 40 Chinese and German professionals across seven specialized departments, our branch offers a collaborative and multicultural work environment. You will play a pivotal role in managing customer information, ensuring efficient and secure handling of client data to support our diverse range of services including payment processing, foreign exchange trading, and cash management. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to our mission of bridging financial operations between continents while enhancing client relationships through effective information management. If you are passionate about the banking industry and possess strong analytical skills, we invite you to become part of our innovative team.

Tasks

  • Perform internal control duties within the department’s middle office, including ongoing monitoring of corporate clients’ operations and key market information relating to their industries and regions, as well as early-warning and ad hoc monitoring of existing credit clients.
  • Oversee post-loan monitoring activities, reminding and assisting relationship managers to complete periodic monitoring, on-site visits, KYC due diligence, PD rating updates, and loan administration tasks in the 531 system in a timely manner.
  • Compile business statistics for the Marketing Department, respond to internal and external enquiries, and provide accurate and timely business data and client information.
  • Handle account opening for non-credit clients, KYC updates, and the initiation of payment and foreign exchange transactions.

  • Manage and use the department’s email inbox.
  • Draft written materials, update the Operating Handbook, organise and arrange meetings, and prepare memoranda.
  • Perform other tasks assigned by the department supervisor.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Taxation, or a related discipline.
  • Professional qualifications such as CPA, CFA, or FRM are highly desirable.
  • Strong quantitative and statistical analysis skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Proficiency in Chinese and English, with basic German language skills (CEFR level A1/A2 or higher).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Previous experience in banking or corporate finance is preferred.

Benefits

We offer:

  • Employment in a small, flexible team with the opportunity to gain comprehensive insights into all aspects of banking.
  • Independent and diverse responsibilities within an international bank featuring streamlined communication channels.
  • Performance-based compensation along with standard banking benefits such as transportation subsidies and meal vouchers.
  • A modern workplace environment located in Frankfurt's banking district, complete with a cafeteria.
  • Post-work activities including various hobby groups and access to an in-house fitness center.
  • Opportunities for intercultural exchange within a collegial and familial atmosphere.
  • 30 days of annual leave with two additional days off on December 24th and 31st.
  • A break room offering panoramic views of Frankfurt's skyline, providing a space to relax and enjoy coffee.

Join our vibrant Frankfurt team as a Customer Information Manager, bridging China and Europe. Excel in international trade, payments, and finance. Enhance your career with global banking leaders.

title: Customer Intelligence Solutions Lead - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Want to transform customer engagement and growth at some of the world's largest institutions? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our Customer Intelligence solution. You'll own the solution across banking, insurance and the public sector, set the direction for the whole region, and take it to market – with real autonomy over how. You'll be the name the market knows on this subject, and the person Quantexa turns to for it.

Every large organisation is investing in data, analytics and AI to serve customers better. Most hit the same wall. The same person appears multiple times across systems that don't talk to each other. Relationships stay hidden – from families and social groups to corporate hierarchies and supply chains. The data is there, but it's fragmented, inconsistent and stripped of context, so nobody quite trusts what it says. The cost shows up everywhere: disjointed customer experiences, frustrated customer-facing teams, wasted marketing spend, and revenue left on the table.

That's the problem we solve, at scale. We connect data to build a real-world view of people, businesses, places and events, and the relationships between them – unlocking insight that accelerates revenue growth and makes customer experience genuinely better. Context is the part most approaches miss, and it's the part that makes everything downstream work: better decisions, trusted outputs, and AI that delivers on its promise across sales, marketing and customer service.

You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. We listen to what banks, insurers and public sector organisations really need. We shape the proposition around it. Then we make sure clients, partners and colleagues can see the value. The reach is unusual: our product roadmap, our go-to-market strategy and the conversations we have in the market all start here. Complex problems, senior audiences, commercial consequence. Ready?

What you’ll be doing.

  • Own the Customer Intelligence proposition across EMEA – shape the positioning, the messaging and the segments we go after, and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that influence our global roadmap.

  • Be the region’s senior expert – guide sales opportunities and client programmes as a trusted advisor to some of the largest financial institutions and government agencies in EMEA.

  • Build our voice in the market – publish thought leadership, speak at industry events, brief analysts, and host the client roundtables that shape their thinking and ours.

  • Team up with Marketing and Sales – on campaigns, market and competitor analysis, and the collateral and enablement that help our teams sell with confidence.

  • Grow the ecosystem with Alliances – develop the technology, data and delivery partnerships that give us scale, differentiation and pipeline across the region.

  • Feed the region back into global strategy – work with Product, R&D and Solution Engineering to keep the solution ahead of a market that never sits still.

What you’ll bring.

You have deep expertise in customer intelligence, customer analytics or data-led marketing, ideally in banking or financial services. Don’t tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we’d still like to hear from you.

  • Real depth in customer intelligence. You know the data, the analytics, and how both turn into commercial outcomes. Credible with practitioners. Credible with their executives.

  • A voice the market listens to. You can present, write, and hold a room of experienced stakeholders. Whether or not you enjoy the spotlight, you make complex ideas land.

  • Strategy, and sleeves rolled up. You’ll set the direction – then happily build the business case, the demo or the deck yourself.

  • Curiosity about the tech. You’ll learn our platform properly, so you can say what it does and where it’s genuinely different. Never settling for the surface-level answer.

  • Judgement, and generosity with it. There’ll always be more opportunity than time, so you’ll choose well and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you. Experience across several EMEA markets, or extra languages, is welcome rather than required.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Well-being days

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. descriptionHtml:
About Wunder Mobility

Wunder Mobility builds the software that powers shared mobility worldwide. Our platform runs 20M+ successful trips yearly, processing 50M+ daily API calls, across 500 cities in Europe, the US, and Asia. Operators like Forest (London), Green Mobility (Copenhagen), and Flexar (Singapore) rely on us every day to move cities forward.

What you will do

  • Demos and pilots. Run demos and pilots for the deals our leadership leads, and set up each prospect's demo or pilot environment.

  • Onboarding and launch. Own the plan, the timeline and the customer relationship from signature to go-live, with a technical lead from our team.

  • Your accounts. Own adoption, health, NPS, renewals, upselling and cross-selling, starting with an existing customer and adding the new accounts you help win.

Along the way, you refine our demo and sales playbooks with the team and help build the AI workflows behind our customer work.

The AI you'll work with

  • From week one, you prepare customer calls, account health checks, and ticket replies with Claude and our own shared skills, connected to our tickets, CRM, meeting notes, and product data.

  • Our company knowledge base is written for people and AI alike, so answers start from how we actually work.

  • Our product has AI built in. With Wunder AI, operators ask questions about their own fleet and rental data. You show it in demos and help customers use it.

  • We have a company standard for how we use AI at work, and the whole team works to it.

  • We are a founding partner of House of AI Hamburg. It shares the room with our team and hosts several evening events a week for Hamburg's AI community.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in customer-facing B2B software roles where you owned accounts: customer success, account management, implementation or solutions consulting.

  • You have run demos and pilots, and you can explain a complex platform in the language of the customer's business.

  • You have taken customers from signature to go-live, with a plan, deadlines and several parties involved.

  • AI is part of your recurring work and runs on real data. In our first call, you show us one workflow (anonymised or on sample data is fine) and tell us what you check.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • You enjoy taking existing processes and playbooks and making them better.

Nice to have

  • Experience in shared mobility, at an operator or a platform provider.

  • Go-to-market or marketing experience.

  • Something you built with AI that other people now use.

What you can expect

  • A fixed salary of €65,000 to €80,000 per year, reviewed every 12 months.

  • The new accounts you help win, from demo to launch and beyond.

  • Direct work with our CEO and leadership on deals and customers.

  • The AI tools you need. Within six months, you own at least one AI workflow that the team or company uses, with time set aside to build it.

  • Written reviews of your scope and pay with our CEO and your manager: after your first launch, when your book reaches four accounts, and after 12 months at the latest.

  • Hybrid working: in our Hamburg office on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

  • A 2-year fixed-term contract with 6 months' probation

How we hire

  1. Apply with your CV and short answers (a few sentences each, or a Loom recording) to two questions: Which customer did you take from pilot or signature to launch, and what would you do differently next time? What is the most useful AI workflow you set up in the last 90 days, and when did you catch it being wrong?

  2. Intro call, 30 minutes, with our Head of Customer Success. You show us one AI workflow you use.

  3. Case, at most 3 hours of preparation: a demo and a launch plan for a fictional operator, based on a short brief we send you. Ideally not slides but an interactive page or prototype you build with an AI tool. You present it live in a 60-minute conversation with our CEO and our Head of Customer Success.

  4. If needed, a short final conversation with another member of our leadership team.

  5. Offer. We ask for references at this stage.

We reply within five working days after each step. You get feedback after the case and after the final conversation. Our Head of Customer Success is your contact from start to finish.

We won't make a decision before the end of December 2026.

title: Customer Value Architect III
descriptionHtml:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones.

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products.

Responsibilities

  • Connect mixpanel to customer value
    • Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams.
    • Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals.
    • Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed.
    • Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome.
  • Own value delivery and product relationship 
    • Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization.
    • Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early.
    • Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low.
    • Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value.
    • Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate

title: Cybersecurity Manager
descriptionHtml:
Cybersecurity Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (European time zones)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as our Cybersecurity Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

At FullEnrich, security and privacy aren't just compliance requirements; they're fundamental to our product and the trust our customers place in us. As we scale, we're looking for someone to take ownership of our security, compliance, and corporate IT programs, ensuring we continue to protect our customers, strengthen our infrastructure, and meet the expectations of increasingly sophisticated enterprise clients.

As our first dedicated security and IT hire, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up. You'll own our security strategy and compliance roadmap, working closely with Engineering, leadership, and teams across the business to implement practical, scalable controls. Our engineers build and operate the platform, while you'll define, oversee, and continuously improve the security measures that protect it.

We're already SOC 2 compliant, with ISO 27001 and additional certifications on the horizon. Operating across multiple regions and working with 20+ data providers also brings interesting challenges around data privacy, vendor security, and international regulations.

This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, direct exposure to leadership, and the opportunity to build a security function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do:

Security & Infrastructure

  • Own and continuously improve our application and infrastructure security posture, partnering with Engineering to implement and maintain effective security controls.

  • Lead our vulnerability management program, including external penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and remediation tracking.

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize security risks, ensuring vulnerabilities are addressed based on their potential business impact.

Compliance & Certifications

  • Own our security compliance program end to end, maintaining SOC 2 and leading future certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Manage ongoing evidence collection, auditor relationships, control assessments, and remediation activities.

  • Develop and maintain a scalable compliance roadmap aligned with business growth and customer requirements.

Security Governance & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain security policies, risk assessments, and our company-wide risk register.

  • Lead regular access reviews, security awareness initiatives, and incident response preparedness.

  • Coordinate security incidents and drive continuous improvements to our security processes and controls.

Corporate IT & Identity Management

  • Own our corporate IT security framework, including device management (MDM), identity providers, SSO, and SaaS access controls.

  • Oversee secure employee onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, and hardware inventory management, working with our operational IT team on execution.

  • Improve and automate IT security processes to ensure they remain reliable and scalable as the company grows.

Data Privacy & Vendor Security

  • Oversee privacy operations, including data subject requests, vendor data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

  • Ensure our practices align with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and US state privacy laws, coordinating with our DPO and relevant stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain a risk-based vendor security assessment process across our data providers and wider SaaS ecosystem.

Customer Trust & Enterprise Security

  • Own the security due diligence process for enterprise customers, including questionnaires, audits, and security reviews.

  • Maintain our customer-facing security documentation, trust page, and audit report distribution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership to turn security and compliance into a competitive advantage, helping customers move through procurement and security reviews with confidence.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've taken full ownership of our existing SOC 2 compliance program, with evidence collection, control monitoring, and auditor coordination running smoothly.

  • You've assessed our current security posture, completed an initial risk assessment, and identified the highest-priority improvements across infrastructure, corporate IT, and identity management.

  • You've established an effective process for handling enterprise security questionnaires and customer due diligence, with turnaround times measured in days rather than weeks.

  • You've developed an initial 12-month security roadmap covering remediation priorities, penetration testing, incident response, and future certifications.

By 6 months

  • You've implemented improvements to our highest-priority security and IT controls, including identity management, endpoint security, and access governance.

  • You've established a repeatable vulnerability management process, with penetration testing completed or underway and remediation tracked through to resolution.

  • You've strengthened our incident response readiness through documented procedures and a tabletop exercise.

  • You've implemented consistent processes for vendor security reviews and privacy operations, ensuring risks are assessed and regulatory obligations are managed effectively.

By 12 months

  • Our SOC 2 compliance program is operating as a continuous, audit-ready process, with renewals running smoothly and minimal disruption to the wider business.

  • You've made measurable progress against our security roadmap, including advancing ISO 27001 or other certifications agreed with leadership.

  • Our corporate IT and security processes are reliable, scalable, and embedded into everyday operations.

  • Security is actively supporting business growth, with faster enterprise due diligence, stronger customer confidence, and fewer security-related obstacles in the sales process.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience owning a security and compliance program end to end, including SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, auditor management, evidence collection, and control remediation.

  • Strong understanding of application and cloud infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering teams to identify risks and implement practical controls.

  • Hands-on experience with corporate IT security, including MDM, identity providers, SSO/SCIM, SaaS access management, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations, particularly GDPR, and experience navigating international data protection requirements and cross-border transfers.

  • Experience managing security governance processes, including risk assessments, vulnerability management, incident response, and security policies.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence to work across technical and non-technical teams, engage with auditors, and represent security in enterprise customer discussions.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in a data-heavy or API-first SaaS business, particularly data enrichment, data brokerage, or similar industries.

  • Security management certifications such as CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) or equivalent.

  • Experience working as, or closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer (DPO).

  • Experience supporting enterprise sales processes through security due diligence and customer-facing security reviews.

  • French language skills or proficiency in another European language.

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Practical case on a real security & compliance scenario from our world (1 hr) – A chance for you to showcase how you think and work.

  • Deep dive with the VP of Engineering (1 hr) – A chance to talk through your approach, strategy, and how you'd operate in this role.

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Data Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Data Lead to build Plasma's data function from the ground up. You'll be our first dedicated data hire, working across Consumer, Payments and Business to give the company one trusted view of its users, its money and its operations.

At first you'll build much of the platform yourself: our Snowflake warehouse, the pipelines that feed it and the modelled layer on top. As the function grows, you'll choose the tools, set the standards and hire the team.

The Work

  • Own Plasma's data platform end to end: the Snowflake warehouse, ingestion from production systems and third-party providers, and the modelled layer the rest of the company builds on

  • Define the metrics the company runs on, including funded users, activation, engagement, balances, spend and retention, and make sure every team uses the same definitions

  • Partner with Consumer to understand how users behave across regions, segments and products, and turn that into specific product decisions

  • Design and analyse experiments, and be clear about when a result is real and when it isn't

  • Work with Payments and finance so the business can trust its numbers: reconciliation across ledgers, providers and banking partners, revenue reporting and unit economics

  • Find fraudulent and abusive patterns across onboarding, funding, card spend and transfers, and build the signals and rules that let risk and operations act on them

  • Treat data quality, testing, access control and PII handling as part of the platform, not an afterthought

  • Choose tools deliberately, set standards for the function and hire the team as Plasma scales

The Bar

  • A senior, hands-on data practitioner with a track record of both building a data platform and using it

  • Deep SQL and data modelling skills, with enough engineering range to build and run production pipelines yourself

  • Comfortable starting from very little, and building something that still makes sense when the team is five times bigger

  • Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. rigour, build vs. buy, a quick answer now vs. a reusable model later

  • You turn analysis into decisions. You can explain a finding to a non-technical leader in a few sentences and tell them what to do about it

  • You communicate clearly, write clean, tested code, and lead through technical decisions whether or not you're managing people yet

  • You have very high agency. You don't wait to be told which problem to work on; you go and find the ones that matter

Nice to have

  • You've been an early or founding data hire at a fast-growing fintech

  • Experience with real money data at a fintech: payments, cards, ledgers, settlement, chargebacks or FX. You know the ways financial data goes wrong

  • Hands-on fraud, risk or financial-crime analytics

  • Familiarity with stablecoins and on-chain data, including how blockchain transactions map to accounts, balances and ledgers

  • Experience hiring and growing a data team

  • Machine learning in production for fraud, risk or personalisation

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy.

As a Data Science Manager, you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders.

🔑 You'll play a key role by...

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products.

You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals.
  • Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work.
  • Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction.
  • Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities.
  • Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning.
  • Help connect Data Science work to measurable customer, product and commercial outcomes.
  • Work with Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning and other Data disciplines to ensure teams have the data, tooling and infrastructure they need.
  • Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work.

🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...

  • What we're doing at Monzo excites you!
  • You have significant experience managing and developing Data Scientists.
  • You're a strong strategic data leader who uses data to influence decisions and direction.
  • You have experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.
  • You're comfortable working autonomously in a fast-growing and evolving organisation.
  • You have a strong understanding of Data Science approaches including experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis and machine learning.
  • You're comfortable with tools and languages such as Python and SQL, and understand how to choose the right analytical approach for a problem.
  • You can build credibility with Product, Engineering and senior business leaders and influence without relying on authority.
  • You have strong product judgement and experience using Data Science to shape product development and strategy.
  • You know how to balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making and business impact.
  • You have experience helping Data Scientists develop their technical, product and leadership capabilities.

The interview process

Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

  • 30-minute recruiter call
  • 45-minute call with the hiring manager
  • 3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during the process.

What's in it for you

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK, with ad hoc meetings in London.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. descriptionHtml:
Als Pionier in der Bauwerkserfassung entwickeln wir hochpräzise, KI-gestützte 3D-Modelle, die die Inspektion und Instandhaltung von Bauwerken – auch unter Wasser – revolutionieren. Du begeisterst dich für KI, denkst dich gerne in neue Themen ein und möchtest aus Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen machen? Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Lust, Lösungen für ganz unterschiedliche Herausforderungen zu entwickeln? Dann gestalte mit uns, wie wir bei HydroMapper Daten auswerten, Prozesse automatisieren und neue Technologien in die Praxis bringen. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Hamburg!

  • Analyse- und Auswerteprozesse verbessern: Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und entwickelst sie weiter – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Analyse bis zur Bereitstellung nutzbarer Ergebnisse.

  • Développement professionnel : CDI à la clé (85% de conversion) ; socle de formation (onboarding, retex, café tech, deep dive de use cases tech...) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants.

  • Environnement de travail unique : flexibilité télétravail; évènements d’équipe et d’entreprise ; localisation idéale dans le 9ème arrondissement !
  • Socle de formation (training day, Retex, café tech) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants 

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. title: Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

  • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

  • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

  • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

  • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

  • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

  • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

  • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

Your Profile

  • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

  • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

  • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

  • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

  • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

Bonus

  • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.
