title: Delivery Manager (12 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Delivery Manager C2

Team: Delivery

Salary: £55,000 – £70,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: 12 month fixed-term

Reporting To: Lead Delivery Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You’ll be working within our delivery management function. The delivery management organisation’s mission is to:

Shepherd: Guide Product and Tech delivery management practices within the teams you are supporting. Simplify: internal reporting & risks to drive action. Standardise: process and practice to drive consistency across Product and Tech. Serve: alongside our Product and Tech partners to drive development forward in the organisation at pace. Be Neutral: provide objective, internally facing data and insights on how things are going to drive action by appropriate owners.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Delivery Manager to lead and ensure the timely and successful delivery of our product and technology roadmaps. The ideal candidate will excel at managing capacity plans, boosting organisational effectiveness, and maintaining clear and transparent reporting. You will partner closely with our Client Delivery team to align deliverables with client expectations and enable our teams to focus on their core strengths.


Responsibilities: 

  • Drive Roadmap Delivery Success:

    • Oversee the execution of Product & Tech roadmaps to ensure timely and successful delivery.

    • Manage and optimise capacity plans to meet Client deadlines and business goals, ensuring teams are aware of the outcome they are trying to achieve and how to measure it.

    • Track and report on initiatives milestones and deliverables.

    • Identify, manage, and resolve dependencies across teams to ensure smooth progress and prevent delays.

  • Ensure Transparent Reporting:

    • Maintain clear and transparent reporting mechanisms for delivery status and risks.

    • Develop and implement effective risk mitigation strategies.

    • Communicate initiative statuses and risks to stakeholders in a timely manner.

  • Align with Client Expectations:

    • Collaborate with the Client Delivery team to ensure deliverables meet client capabilities, support needs, and timelines.

    • Ensure that client feedback is integrated into the delivery process.

  • Clarity on Teams’ Effort Distribution:

    • Provide clear and detailed insights into team contributions to overall business goals.

    • Ensure that team efforts are aligned with strategic priorities.

    • Facilitate data-driven decisions by ensuring delivery information reaches the right stakeholders, and maintain a strong effort-to-value ratio in your area.

  • Boost Organisational Effectiveness:

    • Establish and refine ways of working to foster a scalable and adaptable Product & Tech organisation.

    • Implement Agile & Lean processes and tools that enhance efficiency and productivity.

    • Act as a change driver and promote a culture of continuous improvement and learning.

  • Enable Product and Tech to Focus on their Core Strengths:

    • Eliminate barriers hindering Product teams from dedicating time to innovation and strategic planning.

    • Allow Engineering teams to concentrate on technical excellence and execution.


What you'll bring

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Able to manage the end-to-end delivery of digital/technology products using Agile methodologies across cross-functional product teams.

  • Strong understanding of product development process and software development life cycle. 

  • Comfortable switching between team-level detail and executive-level overviews.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong coaching abilities to empower teams and colleagues to reach their full potential.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Able to draw on experience to apply the right approach in the right context.

  • Comfortable with uncertainty and adept at bringing people along on a change journey.

  • Worked in scaling a high-growth SaaS business.

  • Apply customer centricity in the way that you work.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

descriptionHtml:
Le Sud-Ouest pour ancrage, la glisse pour terrain de jeu, la passion comme ADN partagé. OneTurn vit et respire la culture outdoor et les sports d'action en portant des marques emblématiques comme Volcom, Spyder, Aspen, Etnies, éS et Emerica et pour certaines depuis plus de 30 ans.

Nos équipes œuvrent chaque jour pour amener des produits authentiques, techniques et créatifs entre les mains de ceux qui vivent pour rider. Ces produits sont le reflet de notre culture. Nos équipes sont avant tout des passionnés de montagne, d'océan, de glisse et de grand air. Des femmes et des hommes qui connaissent ces univers de l'intérieur, qui les vivent au quotidien et mettent toute leur énergie pour les incarner avec ambition.

Bienvenue chez OneTurn, OneTeam, Onthrills !

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE – Missions : Votre futur terrain de jeu !

Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Systèmes d’Information & Projets F/H/X, le Développeur Data & BI F/H/X conçoit, maintient et fait évoluer le data warehouse, les interfaces entre les systèmes et les rapports Power BI du groupe. Il contribue au sein de la DSI, à la trajectoire data du groupe.

À ce titre, ses missions principales sont les suivantes :

Data & Systèmes d’information

o Maintenir et faire évoluer le data warehouse SQL Server.

o Extraire et exploiter les données issues des applications métier (ERP, PLM, PIM, CMS, e-com, B2B, POS).

o Superviser l’exécution des flux (monitoring, alerting), traiter les incidents et documenter chaque flux (source, cible, déclencheur, procédure de reprise).

o Contrôler et fiabiliser la qualité et la cohérence des données ; participer à la gouvernance et à la structuration des données.

Développement, automatisation & intégration

o Concevoir et maintenir les automatisations et intégrations entre le SI et les systèmes tiers (T-SQL, API REST / JSON, n8n, packages SSIS existants).

o Développer et optimiser les procédures et fonctions T-SQL.

o Développer des interfaces d’accès aux données simples et performantes : vues, API, exports, serveurs MCP (accès gouverné, lecture seule, gestion des droits).

o Rationaliser l’existant : inventorier, migrer ou supprimer les traitements isolés (jobs, vues, fonctions, packages SSIS, scripts), centraliser l’ordonnancement.

o Contribuer aux choix d’architecture data.

BI & Analytics

o Concevoir, développer et maintenir les tableaux de bord Power BI.

o Concevoir et faire évoluer les modèles sémantiques Power BI.

o Identifier des leviers d’amélioration à partir des données et produire des analyses ponctuelles pour éclairer les décisions.

o Animer avec le DSI, la roadmap Data & Analytics : backlog priorisé, revue régulière avec les référents métier, communication des livraisons.

Accompagnement métier & support

o Comprendre les besoins des équipes opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions techniques.

o Prendre en charge le suivi des tickets et demandes d’assistance sur le périmètre data, intégration et outils internes, avec une priorisation partagée avec le DSI.

o Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’exploitation des outils de reporting et leur montée en autonomie (self-service encadré).

o Contribuer à l’acculturation Data au sein de l’entreprise : bonnes pratiques, diffusion des usages.

PROFIL – Le(a) candidat(e) de nos rêves

Formation : Bac+3 à Bac+5 en data engineering ;

Expérience : 3 à 6 ans d’expérience en développement BI / data engineering dans un domaine similaire ;

Compétences :

  • Maîtrise de SQL Server : T-SQL avancé (procédures, fonctions, optimisation), SQL Agent ; capacité à maintenir des packages SSIS existants (SQL Graph apprécié).
  • Maîtrise de Power BI : modèles sémantiques, DAX, administration des datasets et de la gateway.
  • Pratique des API REST / JSON, GraphQL et d’un outil d’orchestration (n8n ou équivalent) ; Python apprécié.
  • Connaissance de l’écosystème Microsoft Fabric / Azure.
  • Appétence pour l’IA appliquée aux données (MCP, RAG).

  • Compréhension des enjeux métier, recherche de la performance, capacité de synthèse.
  • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et gestion des priorités.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais technique dans un environnement IT.

OneTurn est une entreprise qui s'engage pour la diversité et l'égalité des chances.

Tous les postes ouverts au sein du groupe sont accessibles aux salariés en situation de handicap.

title: Director Account Management (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

Als Director Account Management (all genders) übernimmst Du die Gesamtverantwortung für unseren Bereich der Bestandspartner. Dieser Bereich erwirtschaftet mehr als die Hälfte des Unternehmensumsatzes. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und führst ein Team von bis zu acht Mitarbeitenden. Neben der Steuerung und Entwicklung des Teams treibst Du diesen Bereich erfolgreich in Richtung eines skalierbaren Plattformgeschäfts weiter.

  • Dein Kerngeschäft – Partnerbeziehungen: Du verantwortest mit Deinem Team die Beziehung zu unseren bestehenden Fachpartnern (SEM). Dazu gehören Bindung, Zufriedenheit, Umsatzentwicklung und der Ausbau der Partnerschaften. Der Bereich gliedert sich in zwei Segmente:

    • Mittlere Partner: Automatisierung und Skalierung in Kombination mit persönlicher Betreuung.

  • Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings, analysierst Erfolgskennzahlen von Partner:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen und leitest daraus eigenständig zielgerichtete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du führst ein achtköpfiges Team fachlich sowie disziplinarisch auf Basis klarer KPIs und entwickelst das Team zu Top-Performern weiter.

Anforderungen

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Vertriebsstrategien, KPIs, CRM, Pipeline-Management und Reportings.
  • Du weißt, wie man Mitarbeiter:innen durch gezielte Coachings und Workshops effizient ausbildet und weiterentwickelt.
  • Als starke Persönlichkeit mit Vorbildfunktion fällt es Dir leicht, Dein Team für die gesteckten Ziele zu begeistern, und dabei behältst Du jederzeit den Überblick.
  • Du handelst zielorientiert, denkst unternehmerisch und zeichnest Dich durch Deine fokussierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise aus.
  • Du überzeugst durch Deine ausgeprägte Umsetzungsstärke, hast keine Angst, eigenständig Entscheidungen zu treffen, und kommunizierst mit Top-Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe.

Was wir bieten

Hybrides Arbeiten // Bleib flexibel: Neben unseren wöchentlichen Teamtagen, die wir gemeinsam in unserem Office in Berlin verbringen, kannst Du nach Rücksprache auch aus dem Home Office arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr aus ausgewählten EU-Ländern zu arbeiten.

Raum zu wachsen // Bleib neugierig: In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deiner Führungskraft Deinen ganz persönlichen Entwicklungspfad. Hinzu kommen ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget sowie informative Workshops, die Dir neuen Input geben und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern.

Mentale und körperliche Gesundheit // Bleib gesund & aktiv: Wir möchten, dass es Dir gut geht und unterstützen Deine Gesundheit durch eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club. Verantwortungsbewusstsein // We #care: Wir sorgen uns um unseren Planeten und die Menschen, die auf ihm leben. Um unsere Welt ein kleines bisschen besser zu machen, fördert unser ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) unser Bewusstsein für umweltschonendes Verhalten. Zusätzlich arbeiten wir mit JobRad, bieten ein vergünstigtes BVG Ticket an und unterstützen bei unserem jährlichen Social Day tatkräftig soziale Projekte in Berlin. Teamspirit // Bleib vernetzt: Was uns antreibt ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl. 1x im Monat feiern wir deshalb unseren Company-Office-Day am Potsdamer Platz, an dem alle persönlich zusammenkommen. title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
descriptionHtml:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.
  • Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.
  • Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.
  • Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

  • Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.
  • A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.
  • Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.
  • Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

What we offer

  • Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg
  • Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products
  • Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget
  • Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget 
  • Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program
  • Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.
  • Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes
  • Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill
  • Childcare and company pension scheme benefit
  • Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT

  • Kunden- & Stakeholder-Management: Als strategische:r Berater:in begleitest du Marketing-, Media-, Daten- und Commerce-Verantwortliche auf Entscheider-Ebene. Dabei überführst du Erkenntnisse in konkrete Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen.

  • Thought Leadership: Du positionierst WPP Media als Vordenker für moderne Datenstrategie und machst den Business Impact datengetriebener Lösungen durch Executive Briefings, Case Studies und POVs sichtbar.

  • Branchenexpertise: Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im datengetriebenen Marketing, der Media-, Beratungs- oder AdTech/MarTech-Branche, mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Datenstrategien.
  • Fachkompetenz: Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Dateninfrastrukturen, Data Clean Rooms (z. B. InfoSum), CDPs, DSPs, Tagging, Analytics sowie von KI/ML-Konzepten im Marketing – mit der Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu definieren und mit Fachspezialist:innen in die Umsetzung zu bringen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Eine klare Vision für deinen Einflussbereich, ein ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille und ein exzellentes Standing bei Kunden und Kollegen.
  • Netzwerkkompetenz: Als kollaborativer Matrix-Networker suchst du aktiv den Austausch über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg und zeichnest dich durch hohe Problemlösungskompetenz aus.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und Vertrauen bei Kunden- und Agentur-Counterparts aufzubauen.
  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) erforderlich, ein weiterführender Abschluss ist von Vorteil.

title: Director, EMEA Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director, EMEA Professional Services to build and lead our services and customer engineering motion across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

This is a player-coach leadership role at the center of the EMEA go-to-market. You will shape how we engage EMEA customers after the sale and alongside it. You will help Sales position and sell both the subscription and, when it fits, services. You will own staffing and delivery for EMEA engagements. You will also coordinate the wider Customer Engineering team in region, including Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers.

You will work closely with EMEA GTM leadership and stay aligned with global Professional Services leadership. EMEA should feel like one team with the rest of PS, with the local context it needs to win.

Location: London preferred. Open to other EMEA locations with strong overlap with UK and European business hours. Some travel to customers and to our San Francisco and New York offices is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Define EMEA Customer Engineering programs: Partner with EMEA GTM leadership to design and run programs for the region. This includes onboarding, activation, enablement, and services offerings. Adapt global programs to regional needs such as data residency, regulated industries, language, and partner ecosystems.

  • Support positioning and selling: Support the creation and evolution of standard pre sales assets to support the AEs with positioning Professional Services. Work with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on deal strategy. Help position the subscription and the right post-sale path for each customer. Join executive conversations when needed. Scope and sell Professional Services when it is the right fit. Review SOWs, estimates, and pricing for EMEA deals.

  • Own resource management and delivery: Own staffing, capacity planning, and utilization for the EMEA PS team. Match engagements to the right people and practices. Make sure delivery follows PS methodology, including scoping, technical review, documentation, and customer handoff. Review key deliverables, surface risk early, and handle escalations.

  • Lead and grow the EMEA team: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop Architects, AI Engineers, and Engagement Managers in region. Set clear expectations and give direct feedback. Build a team culture with a high bar for quality and craft.

  • Coordinate across global Customer Engineering in a matrix model: Provide day-to-day coordination and supervision for EMEA Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers. Set shared priorities and make sure customers get a connected journey from activation to enablement to services to expansion. Work with their functional leaders on performance, growth, and standards.

  • Align with global PS leadership: Keep delivery standards, tooling, pricing, and reporting consistent across regions. Share what works in EMEA. Bring back playbooks, reusable assets, and process improvements from the global team. Contribute to the PS operating rhythm and roadmap.

  • Run the business: Own EMEA PS bookings, utilization, delivery margin, and customer outcomes. Report on pipeline, capacity, and risk to Customer Engineering and GTM leadership.

  • Stay close to customers: Remain active in key accounts. Act as the senior escalation point for strategic EMEA customers. Be a credible voice with technical and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • You have 10+ years of experience in professional services, solutions engineering, customer engineering, or consulting. At least 4 of those years were in leadership roles.

  • You have led a services or post-sales team in EMEA. You know the regional market and its regulatory landscape.

  • You have helped sell technical services alongside a software subscription. You can scope work, price it, and defend it with customers.

  • You have owned resource management and delivery. You understand utilization, capacity planning, and delivery quality.

  • You have led through influence in a matrix organization. You can set direction for people who do not report to you.

  • You are credible with engineers and executives. You can discuss agent architectures, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise AI adoption.

  • You have built programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment. You do not wait to be told what to do.

  • You communicate clearly and directly. You work well across time zones with a global team.

You exemplify our operating principles

  • You are motivated to build something great. You hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact.

  • You embrace hot takes. You share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate.

  • You operate with maximum agency. You take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock.

  • You run to the roar. You lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLM applications, or agent frameworks

  • Experience with SaaS subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and services attach

  • Experience working with SIs and cloud marketplaces in EMEA

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or open-source company

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

How Success Will Be Measured

  • EMEA customers have clear programs and a connected post-sale journey.

  • Services attach rate and bookings grow in the region, with healthy margins.

  • EMEA PS meets its utilization target over time, with exceptions understood and managed.

  • Delivery consistently follows PS standards, and material risks surface early.

  • Matrix partners in Enablement, Activation, and Account Management are aligned on EMEA priorities.

  • EMEA practices stay consistent with global PS and feed improvements back to it.

Compensation and Benefits

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role summary and impact 

This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. 

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a Director of Global Client Enablement to drive adoption, scale and measurable value from WPP Open across a portfolio of global client accounts hubbed in France. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a hands-on environment, working closely with clients, agencies, and internal teams to drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value from our platform and DTA services. 

You will be responsible for assessing adoption, identifying opportunities and blockers, and coordinating prioritised adoption plans, ensuring that client teams are trained and supported, and that feedback loops are established to continuously improve the client and user experience. You will work alongside regional and global enablement leaders to ensure your cluster’s enablement efforts align with WPP Media’s broader business objectives (Keep, Grow, Win). 

What you’ll do 

  • Client-team adoption:
    • Manage enablement programs for two key global client accounts within the French hub.
    • Assess adoption maturity, client priorities and use cases.
    • Identify opportunities and blockers and create clear, prioritised adoption plans.
    • Ensure client teams are onboarded effectively and supported through adoption of WPP Open, including relevant media tools, Agent Hub and Open Intelligence. Partner with account teams to expand product usage and deliver measurable business impact. 
  • Hands-on enablement delivery:
    • Deliver tailored product walkthroughs, demos and training, supported by practical guidance and best practice.
    • Coordinate change-management activity that helps client teams move to WPP Open-enabled workflows, embeds new ways of working and sustains day-to-day adoption. 
  • Collaboration & coordination:
    • Act as the primary enablement contact for the client portfolio, coordinating the adoption journey across client, account, regional, Product, Data and Analytics teams.
    • Establish clear owners and follow-through for actions, maintain feedback loops, share learning across accounts and markets, and consolidate client evidence to inform product and roadmap priorities.
  • Cross-functional enablement: 
    • Coordinate relevant cross-studio workstreams, pilots and joint initiatives across Media, Creative, Production, Commerce and other WPP capabilities.
    • Surface, document and route product, data or technical blockers to the appropriate specialist teams, track progress and maintain alignment through resolution without assuming specialist delivery ownership. 
  • Performance tracking & reporting:
    • Monitor adoption metrics, engagement levels and client satisfaction across the portfolio.
    • Evidence measurable client value, identify trends and gaps, reassess adoption maturity and adjust priorities and adoption plans with regional Enablement leadership. 
  • Support for growth & retention:
    • Identify opportunities for deeper adoption, optimisation and new WPP Open use cases that create measurable client value and support growth and retention.
    • Contribute to pitches where relevant, and develop enablement materials, case studies and success stories that evidence impact and can be reused across clients. 

The role coordinates enablement and adoption; technical deployment, configuration, integration and specialist delivery remain with the relevant Product and capability teams. 

Skills and Experience 

  • Experience in client enablement, customer success, change management or training within a technology or data-driven organisation. 
  • Strong understanding of technology and AI-enabled platforms and ability to act as a confident product advocate. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple client priorities. 
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret adoption data and translate insights into action. 
  • Familiarity with media planning and buying workflows is a plus but not required. 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. 

We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. 

Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong track record either working in an advisory role within a global corporate or charitable foundation, multilateral organisation, NGO, or government or consulting experience advising philanthropic clients. Agency experience is preferred and advantageous.
  • 10+ years’ relevant professional experience.
  • Deep understanding of the philanthropic and international development landscape, with first-hand experience of handling highly topical issues, and an extensive network from which to draw intelligence.
  • An understanding of the interplay between business, politics, and society, particularly as it relates to this sector.

  • A balance of creative and analytical thinking, bringing rigor, accuracy, and attention to detail.
  • A natural team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

title: Early Career SoC Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
SoC Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from full-chip architecture definition through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

About the team and role
As an Early Career SoC Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how our compute engines, memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects and I/O come together into a single coherent chip. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to full-chip performance modelling, specification writing, cross-block trade-off analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself.

About you
We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or SoC architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about how compute, memory and interconnect choices trade off against each other at the full-chip level, and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as an SoC Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to chip-level or system design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V SoC implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • A solid foundational understanding of SoC or computer architecture, including memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and how compute, memory and I/O blocks integrate into a coherent chip, gained through study, projects, internships, or research.

  • Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine.

  • Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), interconnect/NoC design, compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued.

  • A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: Embedded Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.  
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks

  • Contribute to software architecture and design decisions

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA)


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux)

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later)

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles

  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems)

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems

  • Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

What you get 
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop.

We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
L'équipe technique de Theodo, c'est 120 software engineers, tech leads, ou architectes tous issus des meilleures écoles d'ingénieur, et 13 Engineering Managers pour les faire réussir.

Tes missions

Tu interviens sur des produits Data & IA à forte valeur : plateformes data, pipelines de traitement à grande échelle, applications d'IA générative et systèmes en production avec un volume d'utilisateurs conséquent. Concrètement, tu vas :

  • Manager et faire progresser tes Tech Leads : tu accompagnes leur montée en compétence et leur épanouissement, tu évalues le niveau technique de tes équipes et tu les fais grandir, par la théorie comme par le terrain.
  • Garantir le delivery technique : tu challenges les choix techniques de tes projets en arbitrant les trade-offs avec pertinence (qualité, coûts / design-to-cost, délais, maintenabilité), tu sécurises les conditions d'un bon démarrage projet (notamment le staffing de la bonne équipe), et tu portes une stratégie qualité visant le zéro défaut, appuyée par des résolutions des problèmes.
  • Assurer la robustesse en production : tu maîtrises les conditions d'un produit qui tourne à l'échelle, gestion d'incidents, observabilité, sécurité, scalabilité, et la solidité de l'architecture.
  • Contribuer au développement business : tu participes aux discussions stratégiques avec nos clients (DSI, sponsors, C-level), tu sais créer et pitcher les bons supports techniques dans les gouvernances de projets complexes, tu détectes des opportunités et tu es acteur de l'avant-vente avec nos Sales.
  • Tirer l'amélioration continue : tu t'appuies sur le lean et tu animes des kaizen pour faire progresser tes équipes et tes projets en continu.

Les problématiques et les technos varient beaucoup d'un projet à l'autre : modernisation de plateformes data, mise en production de modèles, intégration d'IA générative dans les produits, accélération du delivery par l'IA. C'est précisément cette diversité qui fait la richesse du rôle.

Tes perspectives d'évolution

  • Managériale : VP Tech ou Group Manager
  • Technique : Architecte
  • Business / Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre)
Tes moyens pour réussir : • Management en direct par le CTO ou VP Engineer de Theodo • Formations au Lean management par les plus grands coachs Lean • Écosystème avec 500 expert·e·s tech & produit • Plusieurs dojos (sessions de mise en pratique) par semaine : "archi dojo", "projet dojo", etc.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience, avec une expérience confirmée en management d'équipes techniques.
  • Basé·e en région parisienne, avec une présence majoritaire au bureau attendue pour ce rôle stratégique et managérial.
  • Énorme envie de progresser, curiosité pour le Lean management, et attrait pour un environnement qui évolue vite.

Hard skills

  • Solide expertise technologique te rendant crédible et légitime auprès des équipes, sans être attendu·e sur le code au quotidien.
  • Expert·e des bonnes pratiques d'architecture technique et fonctionnelle, capable de concevoir des architectures évolutives et d'arbitrer des choix techniques dans des contextes grands comptes complexes.
  • Capacité à débloquer des Tech Leads sur des challenges techniques complexes, et à résoudre des problèmes à fort impact transverse.
  • Maîtrise des conditions d'un produit en production à l'échelle : gestion d'incidents, observabilité, sécurité, scalabilité.
  • Appétence forte pour l'IA générative : connaissance d'outils d'assistance IA (au-delà de GitHub Copilot) et compréhension haut niveau du fonctionnement des LLMs.

Soft skills

  • Leadership affirmé et posture pédagogique : tu donnes envie aux autres de te suivre et tu sais animer une équipe exigeante et performante.
  • Exigence sur la qualité technique et la qualité d'exécution.
  • Aisance relationnelle à tous niveaux d'interlocuteurs, y compris C-level, en particulier dans les discussions techniques stratégiques avec le client ; à l'aise pour mener des conversations difficiles et négocier avec plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Orientation business et création de valeur : chez Theodo, nous ne faisons pas de la tech pour la tech.

Le process de recrutement

  • Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l'équipe recrutement
  • Entretien valeurs & culture fit (1h)
  • Entretien de modélisation (1h)
  • Entretien Projet (1h)
  • Entretien final avec un dirigeant
  • Prise de référence
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle: prospecting through close, on complex deals multiple economic buyers

  • Multi-thread every opportunity: build relationships across finance, IT, security, and executive sponsors

  • Run deals with MEDDPICC or an equivalent framework

  • Manage internal teams through complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes

  • Navigate procurement, security reviews, and legal negotiations to close

  • Partner with BDRs to develop and prioritize enterprise pipeline

  • Identify target personas within top accounts and customize outreach to build pipeline

  • Build the playbook: talk tracks, battlecards, and the deal patterns others on the team will run

  • Own forecasting and pipeline accuracy for your book of business

  • Have real influence on GTM strategy and the product roadmap, working directly with founders

     

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 7+ years in sales, with 5+ years as an individual contributor closing enterprise deals ($100K+ ACV, multi-stakeholder, 6+ month cycles)

  • Fluency in a formal sales methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Command of the Message, or similar) and a track record of applying it to win complex deals

  • Experience selling into finance, accounting, or ERP buyers a plus

  • You have sold at early-stage startups, building process rather than inheriting it

  • Open to non-traditional backgrounds with finance or accounting experience

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to take radical ownership over deals and process

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations


Meet the Sales Team

Kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, walking the company through how we think about building AI-native workflows.

  • David Ryan closed 160% of his quota in his first quarter and was promoted to Sales Manager

     

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: £100,000 - £130,000

  • Commission: £100,000 - £130,000 (uncapped)

  • OTE: £200,000 - £260,000

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility support (Carrot)

  • Group life insurance (Allianz)

  • Workplace pension through Penfold (with salary sacrifice option)

  • Flexible PTO (28 days, including public holidays)

  • Unlimited AI token usage

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years' tenure)

  • In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

    "Join now if you want to to lock in, do the work and have the most rewarding role of your career!"

— David Ryan, Sales Manager at DualEntry
