title: Internal Communications Lead
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

The Internal Communications Lead will build the machine and communications culture that keep Faculty's leadership and teams genuinely connected as we scale - carrying vision, strategy and our worldview on AI to every team undiluted, and surfacing the stories from across the business worth telling

This role has two core mandates:

1. Building the internal communications machine - you will design and own how leadership and our teams stay connected day to day - whether live or written, scheduled or ad hoc, and whatever formats a genuinely global, always-on business needs. You will build the architecture - cadence, ownership, structure - so the right message reaches the right people at the right moment, and noise becomes context rather than clutter.

2. Culture, Voice & Connection at Scale - you will be the person who makes sure leadership's vision, strategy and worldview on AI actually reach our teams everywhere, honest and crisp, without being diluted, delayed, or lost in translation as we grow. Leadership owns their voice and their point of view - that stays theirs. Your job is building the stage it's delivered from: sharp, timely, and sensitive to how a message lands differently across cultures and geographies.

What you own

  • The voice going down - The communications framework and rhythm that allow the Faculty Leadership to effectively communicate their vision, strategy and worldview on AI to every team, wherever they are in the world, undiluted and on time.

  • The voice from Accenture to Faculty - Point person for relevant Accenture news, updates and requirements that the Faculty teams need to know.

  • The detective work - Some of the best things happening at Faculty aren’t visible from the top. A team quietly solved a hard client problem. Someone's work never got the credit it deserved. A pattern of small wins nobody's connected into a story yet. You go looking for this, building the instincts and the relationships across the business to find the stories worth telling.

  • How we organise ourselves to communicate effectively - The architecture and judgment behind all of it so our people get a clear read of what matters without being buried under what doesn't.

What you will be doing

Forums & Formats

  • Design the company-wide forums that carry leadership's message, choosing the right format for the right moment rather than defaulting to habit

  • Build for global and cultural nuance from the start, so a message crafted in one office lands with the same weight and clarity in every other

  • Establish a working cadence that respects people's time and attention, so more communication is never mistaken for better communication

Channel Architecture & Cadence

  • Own the internal channel architecture, so messages reach the right people without adding to the volume everyone already wades through

  • Set clear ownership of who can broadcast to the whole company, on what, and how often

  • Bring judgement to every leadership message: which forum, format, tone and timing will make it land, and the confidence to say when something needs live delivery, a short note, or nothing broad at all

Storytelling & Culture

  • Play detective for the stories that don't naturally surface and give them the visibility they deserve

  • Treat culture preservation as a first-order responsibility of scale, not a side effect of good comms: building formats that carry how Faculty's leaders and teams work together, not just what the business is doing

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Where needed, partner closely with leadership as a trusted advisor, protecting their voice while making sure it travels well

  • Establish strong cross-functional relationships across regions and teams to understand what's really happening in the business and shape the internal communications programme around it

  • Support the international expansion of Faculty's internal communications, working with regional colleagues to ensure forums and formats travel well and adapt where they need to

What we are looking for

  • Designing the Machine - A track record of designing and building the machine from scratch - cadences, channels, and company-wide forums - rather than simply running an existing playbook.

  • Judgement - A sharp instinct for signal versus noise: what deserves broad visibility, what doesn't, and the confidence to say so to senior stakeholders.

  • Storytelling - A detective's instinct for finding the story in a large, fast-moving organisation, and the ability to tell it with clarity and a genuine point of view.

  • Global & Cultural Fluency - Proven experience communicating across geographies and time zones, with real sensitivity to how messages land differently across cultures and offices.

  • Stakeholder Management - Skilled at working alongside senior leaders and founders, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and discretion.

  • Communication - Exceptional written and verbal skills, able to convey a complex or nuanced leadership message clearly and briefly without losing what made it worth saying.

  • Change & Scale Experience - Experience communicating through a period of fast growth, acquisition, or significant organisational change, ideally in a technical or fast-moving industry.

  • Autonomy & Resilience - Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale.

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30mins)

  2. Introduction with the Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  3. Panel Interview involving pre work (75 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform “Heartbeat” und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Erfahre über unser Product & Tech Team!

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros inBerlin &München zu arbeiten, mit flexiblen Home-Office Möglichkeiten
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung, Steuerung oder Koordination von IT- oder Softwareentwicklungsprojekten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und interdisziplinären Projektteams.
  • Du kennst agile Vorgehensweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban und setzt diese sicher im Projektalltag ein.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Projektbudgets, Zeitplänen, Aufwänden und Risiken.

  • Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Werkzeuge, um Projekte effizienter und erfolgreicher zu steuern.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are hiring an IT Support Engineer to own the employee technology experience end to end — from day-one device readiness through the full asset lifecycle. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable resolving a Tier 3 macOS escalation, standing up device management infrastructure from scratch, and turning repetitive support work into documented, self-service processes.

You will be the technical escalation point for our Windows and macOS fleet, administer our identity and endpoint management platforms, and partner with security to keep the fleet patched and compliant. You will also mentor junior support staff and set the standard for white-glove service across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Be the front line supporting MDM platforms across the fleet in collaboration with our Technical Engineer — Supporting Windows & macOS — including enrollment, configuration profiles, group policies, and software distribution.

  • Serve as the Tier 1/2 escalation point for macOS and Windows device management issues, including configuration drift, update failures, and security policy conflicts.

  • Work with Technical Engineers to standardized OS images and deployment workflows on a quarterly cadence.

  • Monitor endpoint performance and digital employee experience to identify emerging issues before they scale, and drive proactive remediation across the fleet.

  • Execute workstation imaging, setup, and deployment for new hires and internal transfers, scaling to 100+ builds per month during peak hiring.

Identity & Access Management

  • Tier 1 /2 — provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and application access requests.

  • Tier 1 /2 supporting authentication methods including FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, and biometric authentication.

  • Troubleshoot via remote sessions with Slack Huddle, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with the IT Engineering team on patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint compliance using tools such as BigFix, SentinelOne, or Automox.

  • Exposure in supporting security-driven remediation tickets within SLA and maintaining fleet compliance against internal and regulatory standards.

Service Delivery & Support

  • Own a high-volume ticket queue in ServiceNow or Jira, consistently meeting or beating SLA targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

  • Provide in-person and remote support to a globally distributed workforce across North America and EMEA time zones.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace issues including sync failures, authentication errors, mail flow, and collaboration tooling (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint).

  • Support conferencing and telephony systems for internal and executive-level meetings.

Asset Lifecycle & Vendor Management

  • Provide asset management support to help track and manage our computer hardware and software.

  • Asset shipping and recovery for our new joiners and leavers.

Enablement

  • Lead new-hire IT onboarding sessions covering workstation setup, security protocols, and support procedures.

  • Author and maintain runbooks and self-service documentation in Confluence or SharePoint to reduce repeat ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT support, end user services, or systems administration.

  • Strong hands-on expertise troubleshooting both Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

  • Production experience administering at least one major MDM platform (JAMF Pro, Microsoft Intune, Addigy, or equivalent), including building configuration profiles and policies from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of identity platforms — Okta, Active Directory, or Entra ID — including SSO and MFA administration.

  • Experience with endpoint security and patch management tooling (BigFix, SentinelOne, Automox, Zscaler, or similar).

  • Proficiency with an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and a track record of meeting SLA commitments at volume.

  • Strong administration skills in Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal process and high ambiguity, and to build structure where none exists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a white-glove approach to customer service across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • JAMF Certified Tech (JAMF 200) or higher; Microsoft, Okta, or CompTIA certifications.

  • Linux fundamentals and experience administering virtual machines (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V).

  • Experience supporting file share, print, or application servers on Windows Server.

  • Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

  • Reporting and dashboarding experience with Power BI or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting users across multiple international regions.

Success in the First 6 Months

  • Fully ramped on the fleet and operating independently as the Tier 3 escalation point for Windows and macOS.

  • Measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution and repeat ticket volume through documentation and automation.

  • Onboarding and imaging workflows standardized, documented, and consistently delivering day-one readiness.

  • Endpoint compliance sustained at or above target across the fleet.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 40 lbs.

  • Onsite presence required for imaging, deployments, hardware repair, and in-person support.

  • Occasional after-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows, migrations, and escalations.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
descriptionHtml:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.


Mission

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide.

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards.


Your Responsibilities 

Technical Leadership

  • Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities.

  • Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.

  • Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development.

  • Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products.

  • Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers.

  • Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture.

  • Coach team members in both technical and professional development.

  • Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery.

Product Development

  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components.

  • Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code.

  • Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions.

Scientific & External Collaboration

  • Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events.

  • Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners.

  • Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors.


Your Profile

Education & Experience

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field.

  • 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment.

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists.

  • Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus.

  • Experience bringing AI models from research to production.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling.

  • Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment.

  • Strong programming skills in Python.

  • Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries.

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker).

  • Good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus.

  • Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated.

Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).


Why join Volta Medical? 

Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution.

Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices.

At Volta, you will enjoy:

  • Meaningful work with real clinical impact.

  • An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.

  • The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare.

  • High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture.

  • A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle.

Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:

Propulsés par une croissance ultra-dynamique (15 M€ de CA en 2025 et une récente levée de fonds), nous structurons notre département Delivery. Nous recherchons un(e) leader capable d'allier rigueur opérationnelle et excellence technologique.

title: Lead Deployment Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Lead Fullstack Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo AI-Modernisation
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet

Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :

    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution :

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect: participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

title: Lead/ Head of Sales Europe (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe's leading Fintechs and Financial Institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 330 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, BlackRock, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experiences.

As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are looking for an exceptional sales leader for continental Europe. You will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt owning the topics most critical to Upvest's expansion beyond its current home markets:

About the role:

Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets

We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy.

This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves.

Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions

Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI.

You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing.

Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech

Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets.

With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it.

What you’ll do:

  • Real ownership of a region: This is a defining hire for our European expansion. You own commercial success for your markets, with Alexander, our Co-Founder Til Rochow, and the rest of senior leadership as your close sparring partners and supporters.

  • A product that gives you an unfair advantage: Our Investment API is genuinely differentiated, a full-stack B2B investment infrastructure crafted with the best product principles and most modern tech stack in the industry. It is live, regulated by BaFin and the FCA, and proven at scale with clients such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin.

  • A team that takes the work seriously: Upvest's Growth team, and the company around it, is one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a collaborative and fun culture. You will have dedicated revenue ops, solutions engineering, marketing, and partnerships colleagues working with you on your deals, and strong practices around feedback, psychological safety, and team health.

  • The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you.

  • Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing.

You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to.

How we Upvest in you:

Our Values:

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

title: Lead Tech SRE
descriptionHtml:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one.

What you would do

Architecture & specs

  • Own the target architecture of Kestra Cloud on GCP: the per-customer dedicated stack (cluster, network, databases, queues), how it is templated and versioned, regions, and the path from Beta to GA.

  • Write the specs (design docs, RFCs, ADRs) that turn product needs into infrastructure work, and defend the trade-offs: cost per customer vs isolation level, GCP project vs cluster vs node pool per customer, managed service vs self-run.

  • Define SLOs and error budgets per service and per tier, and make them the basis for prioritization.

Delivery

  • Break specs into work and dispatch it across the team, then review and unblock. You set the bar for Terraform modules, Helm charts, and GitOps conventions.

  • Automate the customer instance lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, backups, migration, and decommissioning, with no manual steps.

  • Own the release path of Kestra Cloud with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions: progressive rollouts, rollback, and upgrade safety across the whole fleet of customer instances.

Monitoring & operations

  • Build the observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) so that issues are caught before customers report them.

  • Run on-call and incident response for the team: rotation, runbooks, blameless postmortems, and follow-ups that actually ship.

  • Plan capacity for a workload that is bursty by nature, and keep autoscaling honest.

Continuous improvement

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps) on GCP: per-customer cost visibility, right-sizing, committed use, and spot where it fits.

  • Harden the platform with our security engineer: network policies, workload identity, secrets, and audit trails toward SOC 2 expectations.

  • Feed back into the product: when Kestra itself makes the cloud hard to run, you write the issue, propose the fix, and work with core engineering to land it.

Our Tech Stack

  • Cloud: GCP (GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS, Cloud Load Balancing, IAM / Workload Identity)

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm

  • Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Monitoring & Logs: OpenTelemetry, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

  • Programming language: Java, TypeScript (you read it; you don't need to write it daily)

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years in SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including at least 2 years leading the technical direction of a team or a platform.

  • Deep, production-grade Kubernetes expertise: you have operated fleets of clusters at scale and know where they break (upgrades, configuration drift, networking, resource sizing).

  • Strong Google Cloud experience: GKE, IAM, networking (VPC, private clusters, load balancing), and managed data services. Equivalent depth on AWS or Azure is not a substitute here.

  • Expert Terraform: you have designed module structures and state layouts that scale to many identical customer environments, not just written resources.

  • Proven ability to architect, spec, and dispatch: you can show design docs you wrote, explain the trade-offs you made, and describe how you split the work and delivered it.

  • Real on-call and incident experience, including running postmortems and turning them into durable fixes.

  • SaaS operations background: you have run a product for paying customers, with SLOs that mattered.

  • Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

  • Pragmatism: you pick the boring solution when it works and can explain why.

Nice to have

  • Experience running workloads that execute untrusted or user-defined code (sandboxing, gVisor, node pool isolation).

  • Built or operated a fleet control plane for per-customer environments (Kubernetes operators, Crossplane, GKE Fleet / Config Sync, or custom provisioning services).

  • FinOps practice on GCP: per-customer cost attribution, committed use discounts, spot node pools.

  • Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the infrastructure side.

  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Kestra, Airflow, Temporal, or similar) or the JVM in production.

Your first six months

  1. Month 1: take over the current architecture, audit the current Kestra Cloud architecture, and map the gaps between Beta and GA.

  2. Months 2 to 3: publish the GA architecture spec and the SLOs, agree on them with the CTO, and turn them into a roadmap the team can execute.

  3. Months 4 to 6: deliver the first GA milestones (one-click provisioning of a customer instance, observability coverage, safe upgrade path) with your two SREs.

  4. After month 6: drive continuous improvement of the platform, including a re-architecture of the first version of Kestra Cloud based on what Beta and the first GA customers taught us.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work from anywhere: We're a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you'll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

  • Health coverage: From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.

  • Home office setup on us: We'll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.

Our Hiring Process

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

  • Intro call with our CEO (30 min)

  • Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous: write a short design spec for a Kestra Cloud scenario on GKE and Terraform, including how you would split the work across a team of three)

  • Architecture review with our CTO, walking through your spec and the trade-offs (45 min)

title: Legal Counsel, Employment
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Please apply with a CV in the English Language. This is a Paris-based role with global reach and therefore Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) is important.

Role Summary

Checkout.com is seeking a talented and dynamic Legal Counsel with a strong French employment law background to join our Employment Legal team. This role will involve advising on the full spectrum of employment law issues across our French business and supporting broader global employment law initiatives, especially across other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will work closely with our People Team and key business stakeholders in France and internationally. This is a great opportunity to support and develop our French employment legal strategy while collaborating as part of a global team supporting employees across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You will take a consultative and commercial approach to handling complex Labor Code compliance matters, works council (CSE) consultations, litigation, employee relations, and strategic projects across France. You’ll also advise on individual and collective dismissals, restructurings, settlement negotiations, performance management, misconduct investigations and HR audits. You’ll monitor legal and regulatory developments across EMEA and provide proactive guidance on emerging risks and legal requirements. You’ll also help the employment legal team develop scalable processes, templates, and compliance frameworks, including through the use of AI tools.

You will be able to handle multiple areas of responsibilities autonomously, demonstrating excellent critical judgment with hands-on approach. You will report into our Associate General Counsel (Head of Employment) based in London. You will also work closely with the regional People Team leads, based in France and other EMEA jurisdictions.

You will be joining a high-achieving legal team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be the best legal team in the world, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

Essential Qualifications:

  • French qualified lawyer (Avocat admitted to the French Bar or Master 2 in French Employment Law / Droit du Travail)

  • 5+ years experience specializing in French employment law, either in a reputable law firm or in-house

  • Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex legal issues clearly to non-French leadership.

  • Within a commutable distance from our Paris office and comfortable working in the office as necessary under our hybrid working policy (currently three days per week on scheduled office days).

Strong candidates will demonstrate the following:

  • Experience as in-house employment counsel, ideally in a large global business headquartered outside of France.

  • Extensive experience managing CSE consultations, collective negotiations, restructurings, and pre-litigation/settlement strategy in France.

  • Work with a high-growth technology or another fast-paced company.

  • Exceptional analytical and writing skills, with a business-centric focus on risk.

  • Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands.

  • Enthusiasm for new challenges and working with a range of different stakeholders.

  • Be a systemic thinker with proven abilities for process improvement and simplification, including AI.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture.

Role Type and Location

This is a permanent and full-time role based in Paris. Under our current hybrid working policy, office attendance is mandatory on 3 days per week.

Additional Information

If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We're always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

We believe in equal opportunities

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.

Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.

When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.

We want to set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. We’ll be happy to support you.

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Legal Engineer - In-House
descriptionHtml:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading in-house legal teams get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how legal teams operate inside complex businesses, identify where AI can make the biggest difference, and turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how their legal function works — whether that's transforming a high-volume process, embedding Legora across a global team, or building the case for AI with senior stakeholders.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to in-house legal teams — understanding their business, priorities and constraints, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal work gets done.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to enterprise-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across the legal function.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of in-house legal work — from contracts and commercial advisory to regulatory, compliance, disputes and knowledge management.

  • Partner with General Counsel, legal operations leaders and legal teams to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to the outcomes that matter to their business.

  • Be the voice of the in-house lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of their needs, constraints and workflows into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from individual lawyers to legal leadership.

  • Help clients navigate one of the most significant shifts in how in-house legal teams operate — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal services are delivered to the business.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora serves corporate legal teams as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked inside an in-house legal team and understand the reality of being a lawyer within a business. You know that great in-house legal work isn't just about giving the right legal answer — it's about balancing risk, commercial priorities, speed and the needs of stakeholders across the organisation.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how legal teams operate.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within an in-house legal function, giving you a strong understanding of its workflows, pressures and relationship with the wider business.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to a General Counsel and the wider business.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between lawyers, legal operations teams, business stakeholders, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer (ranging from mid to principal) to help build the models that underpin these control systems and help us level up our machine learning infrastructure.

Whether in research or deployment focussed teams, we operate as one cohesive unit, sharing tech stack, knowledge, and objectives. Our focus spans from fundamental ML research to commercial-grade software development, offering diverse learning and impact opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

Reporting to a Machine Learning Team Lead, you will:

  • Build state-of-the art systems which combine edge control with active learning algorithms to continuously deliver impact and reduce CO2 emissions.

  • Work in the machine learning team as an individual contributor, building, testing and deploying our models, optimisers and controllers.

  • Contribute to technical innovation and problem-solving across the machine learning lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer projects, planning, designing and delivering the work packages required, as well as playing a significant role in the development of our product.

  • Help establish best practices to improve our internal processes.

You will also contribute to our fear-free development process by building tooling that helps the team move faster and more sustainably. You will be supported by continuous builds, tests, a constructive review system, and a strong culture of improving engineering processes.

What a great fit looks like
