descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Operations Specialist

This role sits within the Coach & Instructor Enablement Team the team exist to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale. This team has six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

Specifically, you will

  • Coordinate onboarding and on-going training for coaches and instructors. That covers scheduling, audience, facilitator/SME, materials, attendance & completion, recordings, teach-backs, certification tracking, compliance, CPD completion, chasing as needed and other training operations admin.

  • Own enablement initiatives/projects end to end, ensuring the right coaches and instructors receive the right training and up-skilling at the right time to deliver customer programs. You manage every contributor and hold the central view across all enablement work.

  • Manage the shared Senior Coach and Instructor pool day to day, allocating their time across Technical Skills, EPA and other enablement work while the specialists direct the content.

  • Provide operational support to the enablement team. Make sure the data and enablement inputs are ready for the monthly quality calibrations led by senior leadership.

  • Keep a record of champions and buddies, who they support and what has been handed to them, so delegated work does not get lost.

  • Keep the enablement content library and enablement communications in order, from version control and retiring old material to release notes and reminders.

  • Report regularly to Senior Managers and Delivery Managers, and help prepare for MBRs and QBRs.

About You

  • 2–4 years of experience in an Operations, Project Management, or Customer Success function - ideally in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment

  • You’re passionate about using data to solve problems and can build dashboards or reports that turn raw information into actionable insights

  • You’ve designed and implemented processes or playbooks that improved team performance and operational consistency

  • A natural collaborator who communicates clearly, navigates ambiguity with confidence, and takes initiative to move work forward without waiting for direction

  • You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing long-term improvements with short-term needs, and consistently deliver to a high standard

  • You are empathetic and mission-driven: motivated by helping learners succeed, and by supporting the coaches who enable that success

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Operativer Leiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Sie bringen wirtschaftliches Verständnis, Organisationstalent und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen mit. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung, treffen klare Absprachen und sorgen dafür, dass Vorhaben zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

Wir wünschen uns:

  • Eine kaufmännische, betriebswirtschaftliche oder touristische Qualifikation beziehungsweise vergleichbare Berufserfahrung

  • Interesse an Tourismus, Standortentwicklung und Wirtschaftsförderung
  • Bereitschaft, Veranstaltungen und Aktivitäten bei Bedarf auch außerhalb der üblichen Bürozeiten zu begleiten

Die Position

Sie erwartet eine vielseitige Aufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Verbindung zur Geschäftsführung und zur Gemeinde. Gemeinsam mit dem Team tragen Sie dazu bei, Badenweiler als touristischen Standort weiterzuentwickeln und Ideen in sichtbare Ergebnisse umzusetzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

title: Organic Growth Manager (SEO & AI Search)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're reconnecting one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries with AI: general contractors publish their tenders on Cosuno and find the right subcontractors, and subcontractors find the projects that fit them and win more of them. As our Organic Growth Manager, you make Cosuno the answer when contractors and trade firms search, on Google and in AI assistants: through our blog, our website and Marketplace pages, and the sources AI answers rely on. And you join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, the website relaunch with our agency, which you'll use to grow organic traffic significantly. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you'll do

  • You build our blog into a steady source of qualified sign-ups: an editorial plan from search data, sales calls and trade press, original research from our platform data, and customer stories, written to a high German standard with freelance writers and AI tools.

  • You own website SEO: public Marketplace pages, landing pages and programmatic trade and region pages, plus technical health, structure and speed.

  • You make Cosuno the source AI assistants cite (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, structured content and a tracked set of the prompts our customers ask.

  • You start our content partnerships: guest posts, joint studies and collaborations with trade media and partners that earn links and mentions. Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you also keep organic LinkedIn and our founders' posts running, then hand them over.

  • Your big project in year one: the website relaunch. Our agency builds the new site and owns sitemap and design; you are their SEO sparring partner and the owner of SEO for the move: you set the requirements, challenge the structure, own redirects and migration checks, and turn the relaunch into a clear jump in organic traffic. Until it goes live, you make the small changes on the current site that matter most.

  • You use AI to make organic faster and better: with our GTM & Growth Engineer you keep automating research, briefs, content and reporting, and test new formats, landing pages and free tools built on our platform data. You pick the smart solution, not the shiny one, and scale what brings sign-ups.

  • You measure the path from impression to qualified sign-up and demo request, and report what organic contributes.

What You Bring

  • You've owned SEO and content for a B2B or two-sided platform and can show growth in qualified sign-ups or pipeline, not just rankings.

  • Strong technical SEO: you've owned SEO through a site migration or relaunch and grown traffic through it.

  • Hands-on experience with AI search and how language models choose their sources.

  • You write excellent German, brief writers well and turn data into blog posts and stories that search, AI answers and journalists pick up.

  • You're data-driven and at home in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar.

  • You work AI-first: you set the strategy, automate what can be automated with our engineer and steer writers and the agency, rather than write everything yourself. You get things done and learn fast in a small team.

  • Native-level German and fluent English: most of our content is German.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: You own organic growth from the ground up, including the website relaunch, our biggest marketing project of the year.

  • AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €60K – €70K

title: Partner Business Director - 11956

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins. Why join Coupa?

title: Partner Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über ALVA Energie

Wir bei ALVA Energie treiben die Energiewende voran! Mit Solarbetreibermodellen auf Mehrfamilienhäusern und Gewerbeimmobilien bieten wir ein Rundum-sorglos-Paket: Von der Installation über die Verwaltung bis hin zum Betrieb der PV-Anlagen als Energielieferant. Unser Ziel ist es, die dezentrale Energiewende einfach und zugänglich zu machen. 🌞

Als wachsendes Start-up in Berlin setzen wir auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung. Jede:r hat die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung beizutragen und Ideen einzubringen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. 🚀

Über die Rolle

Als Partner Manager*in machst du unser Partnernetzwerk zu einem zentralen Kanal für Leads und Umsatz. Du findest die richtigen Partner, verhandelst die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften nicht auf dem Papier bleiben, sondern messbar Ergebnisse liefern. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales-Team zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

Partner gewinnen & entwickeln

  • Du identifizierst und priorisierst strategische Partner, die zu unserem Angebot und unserer Vision passen

  • Du baust neue Partnerschaften auf und entwickelst bestehende Beziehungen kontinuierlich weiter

  • Du verhandelst Kooperationsvereinbarungen und Rahmenverträge, die für beide Seiten echten Mehrwert schaffen

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie um

  • Du vertrittst Alva auf Branchenevents und Messen, gewinnst dort neue Partner und pflegst bestehende Partnerschaften auch im persönlichen Kontakt

Partner befähigen & steuern

  • Du führst neue Partner strukturiert ein und befähigst sie, qualifizierte Leads für uns zu generieren

  • Du konzipierst Partnerkampagnen und Anreizsysteme, die die Bindung stärken und messbare Ergebnisse bringen

  • Du sorgst für eine saubere Deal-Registrierung und erstellst verlässliche Forecasts zu Pipeline, Umsatz und Partnerperformance

  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sales-Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass Partner-Leads reibungslos übergeben werden

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Partnermanagement, Channel Sales oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle sammeln, idealerweise im kommerziellen B2B-Umfeld

  • Du bringst Verhandlungserfahrung mit und setzt dich überzeugend für das Beste für Alva ein

  • Du hast bereits strategische Allianzen aufgebaut und komplexe Beziehungen mit mehreren Stakeholdern gemanagt

  • Du hast nachweislich zu Lead-Generierung und Umsatzwachstum beigetragen und denkst in Pipeline und KPIs

  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. Niveau C1) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus der Energie-, Immobilien- oder Solarbranche mit

Zusätzlich zählen für uns folgende Kompetenzen:

  • Beziehungsaufbau – Du gewinnst schnell das Vertrauen von Partnern, kommunizierst klar und bleibst auch in schwierigen Phasen der Zusammenarbeit lösungsorientiert

  • Verhandlungsstärke – Du bereitest Verhandlungen strukturiert vor, verstehst die Interessen deines Gegenübers und schließt Vereinbarungen, die langfristig für beide Seiten funktionieren

  • Ergebnisorientierung – Du misst Partnerschaften an Leads, Pipeline und Umsatz und steuerst nach, wenn ein Partner nicht performt

  • Flexibilität & Hands-on-Mentalität – Du passt dich schnell an neue Situationen an und packst selbst mit an, wenn Prozesse im Partnergeschäft erst noch entstehen

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Mit deinen Ideen hast du die Chance, unser dynamisches Team zu bereichern und aktiv die Zukunft der Solarenergie in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up mitzugestalten!

  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Kommunikation in einer lockeren und positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • Gestaltungsspielraum - Bei uns hast du 100% Verantwortung für das, was du tust, und darfst mit Herausforderungen wachsen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und dadurch eine steile Lernkurve

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit zum Home Office sorgen für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

  • modernes Office im Zentrum von Berlin und guter BVG-Anbindung (z.B. Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • ausgestattete Küche mit Kaffee, Softdrinks und Snacks rund um die Uhr

  • regelmäßiges Team-Lunch und weitere Teamevents

  • Wir bieten attraktive Zuschüsse zu Urban Sports Club, einem DanceBike und für den ÖPNV

title: Performance Marketing Manager:in (all genders) für Paid Ads, Creatives und KI
descriptionHtml:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Unser Wachstum hängt an zwei Seiten gleichzeitig. Wer etwas verschicken will, braucht jemanden, der es mitnimmt. Wer mitnehmen will, braucht Aufträge auf seiner Strecke. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind.

Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.12. in mit 30h/Woche als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Paid-Kanäle verantworten

Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt.

  • Den ganzen Funnel im Blick

Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden.

  • Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie

Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen.

  • Creative-Pipeline

Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert.

  • Testing-Programm

Du testest systematisch statt nach Bauchgefühl. Von der Hypothese über das Setup bis zur sauberen Auswertung. Learnings dokumentierst du so, dass das ganze Team sie nutzen kann.

  • KI und eigene Tools

Du arbeitest KI-first. Mit Claude Code baust du dir eigene Tools für Auswertung, Reporting, Automatisierung und Creative-Varianten. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

  • Performance sichtbar machen

Du lieferst ein klares wöchentliches Reporting für Team und Gründer:innen. Nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern was wir jetzt tun sollten.

  • Trends und Plattform-Änderungen

Neue Formate, Algorithmus-Updates, Veränderungen bei Tracking und Attribution. Du hast sie auf dem Schirm, bevor sie uns treffen, und leitest ab, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet.

  • Datenschnittstelle im Marketing

Du wirst Ansprechperson für Datenfragen aus CRM, SEO und Social Media und verbindest die Zahlen zu einem Bild.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und dabei eigenständig Budget verantwortet. Idealerweise bei einer App, auf einem Marktplatz oder in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.

Meta Ads und Google Ads kennst du in der Tiefe. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur aufgesetzt, sondern Account-Strukturen gebaut, Budgets über mehrere Kanäle gesteuert und auf Events jenseits des Installs optimiert. Erfahrung mit Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Mobile-Attribution und Tracking-Setups ist ein klares Plus.

Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Tool-Wissen:

  • Du denkst in Funnels, nicht in Downloads. Ein günstiger Install, aus dem nie ein Transport wird, ist für dich kein Erfolg.

  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert. Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sauber und sagst auch, wenn ein Test nichts gebracht hat.

  • Du nutzt KI täglich und hast Lust, dir mit Claude Code eigene Workflows zu bauen.

  • Du kennst die Trends im Paid-Bereich und bringst neue Ideen mit, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du triffst Budgetentscheidungen selbst und kannst sie mit Zahlen begründen.

  • Du schreibst Ad Copy, die unsere Zielgruppe wirklich trifft.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann und wo es für dich am besten passt

  • Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm

  • Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr

  • Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren

  • Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Antwort auf diese Frage:

Performance Marketing für einen Marktplatz wie MUVN funktioniert anders als für einen Onlineshop oder eine klassische App. Wir brauchen Menschen, die etwas verschicken, und Fahrer:innen, die es mitnehmen, am besten auf derselben Strecke. Was würdest du bei uns anders angehen? Und auf welche Kennzahl würdest du als Erstes schauen?

Es gibt keine richtige Antwort. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst.

Oder schick uns ein kurzes Video dazu. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.

So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit Katharina, dann eine Session mit Jule an einem echten Case aus unseren Kampagnen, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.

Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.

Let's get it muvn. 🚀

title: Plateform Security Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. En 2021, Theodo lance une practice experte en cybersécurité pour aider nos clients à sécuriser leur environnement Cloud. Aujourd'hui, l'équipe compte 11 SecOps Engineers.

Tes missions

Nous intervenons en équipe sur l'essentiel de nos projets : Plateform Security Engineer, SecOps et Project Manager travaillent main dans la main pour garantir l'impact de nos actions chez nos clients.

En tant que Plateform Security Engineer, tu partages ton temps entre trois dimensions:

  • Le delivery technique: tu gardes les mains dans la tech pour contribuer directement à l'avancée des projets : IAM, sécurité réseau, pentest, outils de sécurité Cloud et CI/CD, hardening, secrets management font partie de ton quotidien.

  • La stratégie sécurité: tu es responsable de la stratégie sécurité des projets sur lesquels tu interviens : audits de sécurité, identification de failles, conception d'architectures “secure-by-design”, remédiations pragmatiques, mise en conformité.

  • La montée en compétence de l'équipe: tu contribues à la progression des SecOps avec qui tu travailles, via de la formation, du pair programming et du coaching.

Tu auras également l'opportunité de t'impliquer sur des projets internes à Theodo Cloud : l'amélioration de nos standards de sécurité, la construction de formations, la veille technique et le thought leadership (articles, talks).

Les opportunités d'évolution

Nous proposons une évolution possible à nos Plateform Security Engineers vers un rôle d'Engineering Manager, que ce soit sur un axe management et/ou un axe expertise technique.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons une personne ayant :

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste de Plateform Security Engineer ou DevSecOps

  • L'habitude de travailler sur une stack technique moderne : Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud providers publics (AWS, GCP, Azure)…

  • Une maîtrise des concepts de sécurité infrastructure : IAM avancé, sécurité réseau (VPC, firewalls, WAF), CI/CD, méthodologies de pentest et d'audit

  • Le goût du partage de compétences : tu as déjà accompagné la montée en compétence d'un ou plusieurs collègues (pair programming, mentoring, formation) et ça te donne envie d'en faire plus

  • L'envie de contribuer à la croissance d'une practice encore jeune, en participant à la structuration de nos méthodes, de nos formations ou de notre présence externe (articles, talks)

Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t'auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l'étudier !

Pour information

  • Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris.

  • Nous permettons à nos équipes de télé-travailler jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine.

  • Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique.

Déroulement des entretiens

Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 3 jours.

Si ton profil nous intéresse, nous te proposons le process suivant :

  1. Un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l'équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche.

  2. Un entretien d'une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo Cloud.

  3. Un entretien technique d'1h de mise en situation autour d’un schéma d’architecture

  4. Un entretien technique d’1h autour d’un exercice sur une VM

  5. Un échange avec notre Partner cybersécurité.

Notre process dure en moyenne 2 semaines.

Tu seras accompagné(e) par une personne de l'équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process.

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Platform Reliability Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineering Manager leads the platform reliability team: the engineers who take on incidents escalated from the Global and Site Operation Centres and manage them through to resolution, and the Service Delivery Managers who run incident, change and problem management. Together they work with the operations centres and the specialist engineering teams to keep the estate within the service levels it is measured against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, and strong technical competence is a core requirement of it. The role is expected to step into complex faults alongside the engineers, guide the diagnosis and recovery, and judge the technical quality of the team's work. The role manages the team's 24/7 on-call operation, its escalation paths to the specialist engineering teams, and its service level objectives. The team treats operations as a software problem, and the role leads the work of turning what the team learns into runbooks, guarded automation and permanent fixes. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead and manage the platform reliability team, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development and wellbeing across regions. 
  • Manage the team's 24/7 on-call and incident command rosters, with cover across regions. 
  • Serve on the incident command roster and act as incident commander for major incidents on rostered weeks, alongside the Service Delivery Managers. 
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for the team: join complex faults, guide diagnosis and recovery, and review the technical quality of the root cause analysis, runbooks and automation the team produces. 
  • Manage the service level objectives for the services the team supports, and report service performance to leadership. 
  • Work with the specialist engineering teams on clear escalation paths and response commitments. 
  • Hold the team to its incident, change and problem management practice, and arbitrate when speed and process pull in different directions during an incident. 
  • Drive the team's runbook and automation work, so that common faults are fixed once and handled by runbooks or automation, and engineers have time to build automation between on-call weeks. 
  • Build a clear development path for the team's engineers into senior specialist roles, with mentoring and rotations agreed with the other engineering managers. 
  • Work with the Service Delivery Managers and the engineering teams so that new and changed services are ready to support in production. 
  • Turn production evidence, such as incident trends and repeat causes, into clear improvement requirements for the engineering teams, and follow them to closure. 
  • Manage customer and leadership reporting on service health with the Service Delivery Managers, and attend customer service reviews where contractual response commitments are discussed. 
  • Keep the team's ITSM, on-call and operational tooling fit for purpose. 

Skills & Experience 

  • Solid hands-on engineering experience in infrastructure operations or site reliability engineering (Linux, networking, storage, Kubernetes or virtualisation), with the technical depth to lead a recovery, question a diagnosis and judge whether an escalation carries enough evidence. 
  • Significant experience leading a 24/7 operations, SRE or production engineering team in a large-scale hosting, HPC, telecommunications, data centre or service provider environment, including running on-call rosters and incident response. 
  • Working ability in scripting or programming (for example Python, Go or Bash) and in infrastructure as code, enough to review the team's automation and runbook code. 
  • Working knowledge of site reliability engineering practice, including service level objectives, error budgets, toil reduction, runbook automation and production readiness, applied alongside formal incident, change and problem management. 
  • Clear communication and sound judgement, including under pressure. 
  • Experience with ITSM, on-call and observability tooling (for example Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty and Grafana). 
  • Experience building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at pace, coaching early-career engineers, setting performance expectations and growing people into senior roles. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience as a major incident commander, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure and leading post-incident reviews. 
  • Experience operating GPU, HPC or AI infrastructure, including the failure modes of large-scale distributed training and inference. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment with customer-facing reporting. 
  • Experience working under contractual response commitments and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. 
  • Experience setting up a new operations function or team, including rosters, escalation paths and standards. 
  • Experience leading teams across time zones with follow-the-sun handovers. 
  • ITIL or an equivalent service management qualification. 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required.

About Ogilvy:  

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fueled by Behavioural Science. Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally and the agency also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP. 
 
  

The Role:  

As Account Director, you'll champion "earned first" thinking to create impactful, culturally relevant consumer PR campaigns. You'll lead a team, build strong client relationships, and drive innovative strategies that generate buzz and deliver measurable results. This role is fun and energetic, offering great opportunities to learn and develop with a variety of complex but rewarding clients. You will be responsible for fostering a positive and collaborative work environment within the account management team, encouraging open communication and constructive feedback. You will manage relationships with third-party vendors, to ensure the agency delivers high-quality work that meets client expectations. You will also act as a liaison between the client and the agency's internal teams, providing clear communication and direction to ensure all parties are aligned on project goals and timelines. You can see opportunity in risk and you’re not afraid to be brave and challenge your clients to want to achieve a better result for all. 
  
 

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Inspire & Lead: Mentor a team to develop and execute breakthrough, "earned first" PR & Influence campaigns. 
  • Client Partnership: Build trusted advisor relationships with clients, understanding their business and anticipating their needs. Guide them across media and social communications. 
  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with creative teams to develop compelling narratives and assets that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, leveraging data and analytics to optimize results and demonstrate ROI. 
  • Innovation & Trends: Stay ahead of industry trends, identifying new opportunities and approaches to enhance campaign effectiveness. 
  • Budget Management: Manage client budgets effectively, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and within budget. 
  • New Business: Support new business efforts, participating in pitches and developing compelling proposals. 
  • Crisis Management: Develop and implement crisis management plans to protect client reputation. 
  • Inclusivity: Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work. 

Requirements: 

  • Extensive experience in consumer PR and influence, with a proven track record of driving successful campaigns.

  • Interest and desire across beauty and FMCG projects

  • Share and use media knowledge to guide clients on what you believe is the best for their brand 
  • Deep understanding of consumer behavior and ability to develop creative strategies that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Demonstrated ability to think "earned first" and create campaigns that generate organic buzz. 
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Data-driven mindset and analytical skills. 
  • Knowledge of industry trends and best practices. 
  • Experience in crisis management. 

  • Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work.
     

How we help you Thrive:

  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm

title: Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

  • Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. No separate ivory-tower architect required.
    Reviewing and choosing well. You read far more code than you write, and your value is in the quality of review: catching the silent assumption, the security flaw, the architectural drift, knowing where models fail and looking there first. You pick the right tool for the job (Claude Code for a deep refactor, an inline assistant when that is enough, a sub-agent for parallel work, the right model for analysis versus generation) and you know the constraints differ by client, an enterprise like PayPoint or Natwest versus a scale-up type business like Zuto or OAG.
    Working with non-determinism. You see where AI moves the bottleneck and help people left and right of you unblock the value stream. You build with AI components but know success is no longer a binary, reaching for evals, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths as naturally as you reach for unit tests.

Technical breadth across the full stack

Exceptional means depth in at least one area but competence everywhere the system reaches.

  • Backend: an instinct for distributed systems (what fails, what is eventually consistent, where queues back up), APIs that age well, thoughtful data modelling, and an understanding that languages are mostly syntax differences you can close with AI.
    Cloud: cost-aware and security-aware by default, reaching for IaC, composing the primitives rather than stitching together managed services and hoping it works.
    Data: modern pipelines, governance and lineage, increasingly vector stores and embeddings, with data quality treated as seriously as production code because garbage in, garbage out is far worse once AI features depend on it.
    Web and mobile: past the framework arguments, with a clear view on what you would pick today, and able to build "good enough" front ends yourself with AI.

Full-stack here means seeing the platform as one system and knowing which levers matter most. It does not mean front-end work with a few Node.js servers.

System thinking, consulting and commercial judgement

At CreateFuture we work in a consultancy context, where many otherwise excellent IC engineers can struggle.

You know technology is roughly 30% of the picture; the rest is design, argument and reasoning, commercial and political acumen, and the clarity to frame outcomes for a COO, CTO, CIO or CEO in their own language.

You know when gold-plating is wasteful, you can name when a project's real problem is not technical and say so even when it is awkward, and you have a strong sense of what is durable versus what is fashion.

You are not the engineer who introduced the team to seven new technologies last year; you are the one who removed three and quietly made the remaining stack stronger.

Leadership mentality

Technical work is necessary but no longer sufficient. By default you raise the level of everyone around you, regardless of discipline.

  • Communicate clearly and frequently (documents, decisions, post-mortems, design notes); the written artefact is the machine-readable context we can feed to AI later.
  • Make decisions and own them. You don't escalate everything or hoard control, and you are willing to be the benevolent dictator when it is your turn.
  • Mentor in AI fluency, not just code: tooling, prompting and review discipline, so your team is twice as productive a year from now.
  • Need little line management. You communicate upwards, raise by exception, self-resolve, and can be trusted with financial controls.
  • Disagree well. You tell people they are wrong with evidence and no ego, and you change your own mind when you are shown to be wrong.

What we're not looking for

  • The gifted engineer who sits in a silo. This is a team game.
  • The one who is fluent with AI but ships without the guardrails and quality gates enterprise clients expect.
  • The one with strong technical opinions who cannot justify them commercially and gets defensive when challenged.
  • The pure manager who wants to orchestrate teams rather than get involved. This is about setting a new standard, not coordinating it.
  • The engineer who will not immerse in a client environment. This role will mean on-site work and trusted relationships built in person. We are not going back to working away from the client and being bypassed.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

descriptionHtml:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead



Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge



Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:


  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.


We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do



You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:


  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.


What We're Looking For



You'll need:


  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have


  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.


You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:


  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.


Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.


The Role

As a Principal Project Manager, you will support end-to-end implementations of Celonis’ technology across our largest and most strategic customers. You will articulate Celonis’ product positioning to customers and collaborate with Sales, Partners and Value Engineering to establish Celonis’ Services Value proposition and create statements of work with customers during the pre-sales phase. 

In this role, you will assist customers in understanding how to build best practice and enduring capabilities, are responsible for identifying further Services needs by the customer whilst engaged and responsible for customer satisfaction throughout a customer's engagement with Celonis.

The work you’ll do

  • Lead complex transformational customer programs, shape and define the project outcome and then steer towards it.
  • Planning, scheduling, and management of project timelines and activities from project kick-off through to training, ensuring each project is delivered on time and meets the customers' requirements. 
  • Manage resources, schedule, scope and budget on multiple projects by creating and maintaining detailed project plans that emphasize speed to delivery and maximise the efficient use of resources needed to meet the requirements. 
  • Collaboration with senior executives, process owners and technical teams within each customer to understand their goals, objectives and requirements and to ensure their successful implementation. You will be their primary point of contact for product feature requests and escalation of support issues. 
  • Regularly communicate project status, covering key discussion items, action items, risks and issues. Keep projects up to date in the Celonis Professional Services Automation System to enable accurate and timely project and portfolio reporting.

  • Provide guidance and mentoring to the implementation team, including partner resources, to ensure Celonis methodology is being followed.
  • Use your experience to contribute to the continual improvement of Celonis Services methods as well as the maturing field expertise and best practices.

  • Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Safe/Agile).
  • Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or other related field.

  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

title: Product Certification Engineer, Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is looking for a Product Designer to join our growing global User Experience team based in our Manchester office. You will be a key contributor within our global product organization, collaborating across our hubs in Manchester, San Francisco, London, and beyond.

Now is an exciting time to join our UX team of 25+ designers and researchers shaping the future of enterprise planning. We design powerful, data-rich, and intuitive interfaces that help customers make confident business decisions, while defining the next generation of AI-powered experiences across the Anaplan platform. Our work spans core modeling capabilities, intelligent applications, agentic AI experiences, and user-facing planning workflows—all underpinned by a world-class design system.

In this role, you will own feature-level product design across the Anaplan platform. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers to solve complex design challenges impacting thousands of enterprise users worldwide. From evolving core planning experiences to contributing to cutting-edge AI capabilities, you'll help build enterprise products that are scalable, accessible, and user-centered from concept through delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Design: Design and deliver user-centered solutions for a defined product area, balancing user needs, technical constraints, business goals, and emerging AI capabilities where appropriate.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers throughout the entire product development lifecycle.

  • Discovery & Research: Participate in discovery activities including customer interviews, workshops, journey mapping, usability testing, and the exploration of AI-driven user experiences.

  • Complex Workflow Simplification: Design intuitive experiences across both traditional enterprise workflows and AI-powered interactions, helping users accomplish complex tasks with confidence.

  • Prototyping & Artifacts: Produce high-quality user flows, wireframes, interaction patterns, and interactive prototypes using Figma.

  • Design System Stewardship: Work with and contribute to the Anaplan Design System to ensure consistent, accessible, and cohesive product experiences.

  • Data-Informed Iteration: Leverage qualitative and quantitative data, customer feedback, and experimentation to validate design decisions and continuously improve experiences.

  • Champion Best Practices: Advocate for accessibility (WCAG), usability, and the thoughtful, responsible adoption of AI across the product ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • Professional experience in product design.

  • Strong foundation in user-centered design principles and design thinking methodologies.

  • Proven experience designing for data-rich, workflow-heavy interfaces and complex systems.

  • High proficiency in Figma and experience working within comprehensive design systems.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, trade-offs, and rationale clearly to cross-functional partners.

  • A systems-thinking mindset with a passion for high craft, continuous iteration, and constructive feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for enterprise platforms, including admin, builder, data modeling, or AI-assisted workflows.

  • Exposure to designing AI-powered experiences (e.g., conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, contextual recommendations, or generative AI features).

  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how design decisions translate into technical implementation.

  • Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1+) and inclusive design practices.

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, financial systems, business planning software, or complex B2B solutions.

  • Experience operating within Agile, cross-functional product teams.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software at a pivotal moment for Anaplan. You’ll join a collaborative team of talented designers and researchers working on products trusted by many of the world's leading organizations.

You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex design challenges, influence product direction, and grow your career in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, design excellence, and continuous learning. Whether you're refining core workflows or exploring the frontiers of AI-driven planning, your work will make a measurable impact on thousands of businesses across the globe.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
