title: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge
descriptionHtml:
Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge

Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week

Team: Product

Start date: ASAP

About Neural Concept

Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time.

About the role

Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line.

We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself.

As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives.

You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production.

What you will do

  • Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page.

  • Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use.

  • Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on.

  • Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements.

  • Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.

  • Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release.

  • Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail.

  • Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform.

Who you are

Must have

  • Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools.

  • Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction.

  • Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git.

  • A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps.

  • Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams.

  • Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate.

Nice to have

  • Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost practices.

  • Familiarity with requirements engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE, SysML).

  • Experience working with CAD data or geometry processing.

  • Experience with vision-language models, vector databases, or search ranking.

What you get

  • Ownership of a product capability that customers use in real engineering programs, with direct access to the engineers who use it.

  • A competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • A collaborative, multicultural team where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Colleagues who share knowledge freely and support each other.

  • A hybrid model and flexible hours. We focus on results and trust you to organize your time.

title: Product Manager* – Artificial Intelligence
descriptionHtml:

Location: Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Gestalte die Zukunft von Artificial Intelligence – von innovativen Produktideen bis zu skalierbaren Lösungen mit echtem Business Impact.

AlsProduct Manager* – Artificial Intelligence bei Capco gestaltest du die Entwicklung und erfolgreiche Vermarktung innovativer AI-Produkte, Lösungen und Acceleratoren.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Innovation. Dabei vernetzt du unterschiedliche Stakeholder, entwickelst unser AI-Produktportfolio strategisch weiter und übersetzt technologische Möglichkeiten in messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden.

Du begleitest AI-Produkte von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung. Dabei setzt du auf AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen, intelligente Automatisierung und den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von AI-Technologien, um Produktentscheidungen zu verbessern, Entwicklungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und Innovationen schneller nutzbar zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • AI Product Portfolio Management: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios aus AI-Lösungen, Demonstratoren und Acceleratoren und identifizierst Potenziale für Skalierung und kommerzielle Nutzung.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du koordinierst Product Owner, Business-Stakeholder und Engineering-Teams über verschiedene Geschäftsbereiche und internationale Standorte hinweg und sorgst für gemeinsame Prioritäten.
  • Product Development & AI-Enabled Delivery: Du übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen und Marktpotenziale in Produktstrategien, priorisierte Backlogs und Roadmaps. Dabei nutzt du geeignete AI-Tools und automatisierte Workflows, um Analysen, Produktentwicklung und Entscheidungsprozesse zu unterstützen.
  • Go-to-Market & Commercialisation: Du entwickelst überzeugende Value Propositions, unterstützt die Produktpositionierung und Sales-Enablement-Aktivitäten und arbeitest eng mit Business- und Account-Teams zusammen, um AI-Lösungen erfolgreich am Markt zu etablieren.
  • AI Innovation & Strategic Alignment: Du identifizierst neue AI-Anwendungsfelder, einschließlich Generative AI und Agentic AI, und stellst die Abstimmung mit Unternehmensstrategien und globalen Initiativen sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst du Responsible-AI-Prinzipien, Governance-Vorgaben und menschliche Qualitätskontrollen.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, in der Technologieberatung oder im Innovationsmanagement mit und kannst komplexe Themen in strukturierte Produktstrategien übersetzen.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis moderner AI-Technologien, einschließlich Generative AI, Large Language Models und Agentic AI, sowie ihrer geschäftlichen Einsatzmöglichkeiten.
  • Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst technologische Fähigkeiten in überzeugende Value Propositions, Business Cases und konkrete Produktanforderungen übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und kannst interdisziplinäre Teams koordinieren sowie unterschiedliche Interessen miteinander verbinden.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Du bist offen für den Einsatz freigegebener AI-Tools, hinterfragst AI-generierte Ergebnisse kritisch und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Governance und menschliche Entscheidungsverantwortung.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche oder in einem Beratungsunternehmen.
  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung, Skalierung oder Vermarktung digitaler Produkte und AI-basierter Lösungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Aufbau von AI-Produktportfolios, Acceleratoren oder wiederverwendbaren Technologiekomponenten.
  • Erfahrung mit AI-Governance, Responsible AI oder der Integration von AI-Lösungen in bestehende Unternehmensprozesse.
  • Erfahrung mit internationalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams sowie agilen Produktentwicklungsprozessen.

Warum Capco

  • Gestalte innovative AI-Produkte und Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für führende Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen.
  • Arbeite in einer kollaborativen, offenen und unternehmerisch geprägten Beratungskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Profitiere von kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung, Trainings und branchenspezifischen Zertifizierungen.
  • Werde Teil internationaler Teams und arbeite mit AI-Expertinnen und -Experten an zukunftsweisenden Technologien.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung für eigene Initiativen und gestalte die digitale Transformation der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche aktiv mit.

Benefits

Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Benefits-Paket, das deine persönliche Entwicklung, dein Wohlbefinden und deine individuellen Bedürfnisse unterstützt:

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitsmodelle sind abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekteinsatz möglich.
  • Persönliche Begleitung: Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie ein persönlicher Coach und Buddy unterstützen dich beim Einstieg.
  • Mobilität: Profitiere von unseren Bike-Leasing-Programmen.
  • Capco Benefits Card: Monatliche Gutschrift in Höhe von 44 EUR.
  • Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks und Mental-Health-Kurse.
  • Familienservice: Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen.

  • Community & Networking: Regelmäßige Firmenevents und After-Work-Veranstaltungen.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Arbeitskultur: Eigenverantwortung, flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungswege.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Ein dynamisches, wachsendes Unternehmen mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, eigene Ideen und Talente einzubringen.

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir möchten unseren Bewerbungsprozess für alle Menschen zugänglich und unkompliziert gestalten. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder individuelle Anpassungen benötigen, sprich uns gerne an – wir helfen dir weiter.

Bei Capco schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und individuelle Stärken. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Vielfalt und authentische Zusammenarbeit entscheidend zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beitragen.

Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität, gegenseitigen Respekt und Zusammenarbeit. Diese Werte prägen unseren täglichen Umgang miteinander sowie unsere Partnerschaften mit unseren Kunden.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs.
  • Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements.
  • Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles.
  • Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations.
  • Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations.
  • Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers.
  • Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

title: Product Owner - Acquitech
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner - Sales & Marketing, Acquisition Technology

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for a Product Owner to join the Acquitech team.

You'll own the roadmap for the team behind iwoca's acquisition data, technology and models.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they power.

The team

Acquitech builds and maintains the data infrastructure behind iwoca's direct acquisition channels. The team's aim is to get the right data to the right places – so ad platforms find businesses worth reaching, analysts trust the reports they build, and the sales team knows who to call first.

The team works across four areas:

  • Tracking and attribution. Recording every lead and sign-up accurately, and sending conversion data back to ad platforms so their algorithms improve over time.

  • Customer value prediction. Building models that estimate a potential customer's expected value, used to guide where marketing spends, who receives direct mail and which businesses a salesperson prioritises.

  • The data layer. Providing a clear, trusted foundation so analysts and channel managers can build reporting without second-guessing the numbers.

  • Team tooling and automation. Building tools and automated workflows, from automating sales task assignment to running LLM analysis on sales calls so the team can review performance at scale.

The team is small – three engineers, two data scientists and you – with the senior engineer sharing the day-to-day leadership. You'll report to a Senior Product Owner in an adjacent team.

The role

As Product Owner in Acquitech, you'll turn requests from marketing and sales into well-scoped work the team can deliver, and own the roadmap. You'll have real ownership of systems that directly shape acquisition spend, and the space to move quickly in a small, capable team. The work mixes delivery – compliance sign-offs, ad platform integrations and product changes – with discovery cycles where you prototype and test ideas quickly.

You'll become the go-to person for Acquitech systems and processes, and you'll use AI to multiply what a small team can deliver – from prototyping ideas to automating workflows for the team and its stakeholders.

  • Roadmap and priorities. You'll own priorities across Acquitech's work, writing clear requirements and seeing them through to release. You'll set direction with the Head of Direct Acquisition and the channel leads who depend on the team.

  • Tracking and ad platform integrations. You'll lead the team's work on conversion tracking, custom audiences and API migrations. You'll own the product change documentation that comes with them, working through Compliance, Data Privacy and Legal.

  • Discovery. You'll run discovery work to find new opportunities, using AI to prototype and test ideas quickly, and bring findings back to the wider business – for example through weekly learning sessions.

  • Ways of working. You'll run the team's rhythms – stand-ups, retros and monthly reviews – and set clear quarterly goals.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Product ownership. You've worked in a product role, managing several projects end to end – writing requirements, owning priorities and being accountable for results.

  • Data literacy. You use data to diagnose problems, size opportunities and evaluate whether a release delivered what you hoped.

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss trade-offs with engineers around APIs, tracking pipelines and data flows. You follow the argument without needing everything translated.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly. You adapt technical detail for commercial colleagues and commercial context for engineers.

  • Leadership. You're comfortable running stand-ups and retros, setting quarterly goals and keeping priorities clear.

  • AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce specs, analysis, or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Marketing technology. You've worked with tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads or Meta Ads, or on conversion tracking and attribution.

  • Analytics tools. You've used Looker, Amplitude or a similar analytics platform to build or maintain reporting.

  • Data pipelines. You understand ETL concepts or database architecture.

  • Data science collaboration. You've worked alongside data scientists or contributed to a modelling project.

  • Regulated products. You've worked in fintech, lending or another regulated product area.

The salary

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. We're open-minded, so include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every team member always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £50K – £70K

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

title: Product Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

  • Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.

  • Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects.

HOW WE WORK

  • Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.

  • Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest.

  • AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2–4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation Manager

  • You learn a complex product in depth, fast, and explain it clearly to people with very different backgrounds

  • You're confident in front of customers: you lead a meeting, handle tough questions and can say no with good reasons

  • You've managed projects with external stakeholders, including scope, timelines and expectations

  • You turn scattered customer feedback into clear, prioritized input, and you pull usage data yourself to back it up

  • You use AI tools every day in your own work

  • German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our product and engineering team in English

Bonus points for experience in construction, construction tech or procurement, or with product enablement (help centre, webinars, product tours).

WHY US?

  • Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Air.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

ABOUT US

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Productmanager Data & Webdiensten
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een inspirator die strategische IT-doelen weet te operationaliseren en innovatie binnen je team stimuleert? Wil jij een veilige en moderne generieke technische IT-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden? En zorg jij ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt?

Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Productmanager Data en Webdiensten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van de productroadmap en begeleid je de processen die nodig zijn om onze producten en diensten conform de geldende kaders te realiseren. Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening.

Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. Onze diensten voldoen vanaf het ontwerp aan de geldende CIS- en ISO-kaders, waarbij het naleven van security- en compliancebeleid prioriteit heeft.

Je begeleidt een team van 10 tot 15 engineers en senior engineers bij Agile werken en de inhoudelijke productontwikkeling. Je stimuleert een proactieve werkwijze en zorgt voor de verbinding tussen strategische doelstellingen en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega-productmanagers, architecten, servicemanagers, beheerteams en andere stakeholders.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt een samenhangende productstrategie en visie voor de productsuite van het team Data en Webdiensten en stemt deze af met het hoofd IGI en andere stakeholders. Hierin borg je naast vernieuwing ook veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie.

  • Je vertaalt de vastgestelde productstrategie en visie naar een meerjarige roadmap, kwartaalplanningen en een productbacklog.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt Agile-events, waaronder dagstarts, sprintplanningen, sprintreviews, retrospectives en refinements, zowel binnen als buiten het eigen team. Daarnaast coach je teamleden.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor technische teams, architecten, Security Services, Contracts & Finance en servicemanagement. Je bevordert de samenwerking en zorgt voor afstemming over productdoelen en -strategieën.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met afnemers en andere productmanagers, verzamelt feedback en vertaalt hun uitdagingen en behoeften naar de verdere productontwikkeling.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met het hoofd IGI en andere productmanagers KPI's en succesmaatstaven, bijvoorbeeld voor adoptie, efficiëntie, kosten en productiviteit van engineers. Je maakt de prestaties van geleverde diensten inzichtelijk en houdt toezicht op veiligheid, compliance, beschikbaarheid en performance. Hiervoor benut je bestaande inzichten vanuit servicemanagement en ontwikkel je waar nodig aanvullende inzichten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het team Data en Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). Deze afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 experts, verdeeld over onze locaties in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het team Data en Webdiensten telt circa 15 collega's die eveneens op beide locaties werkzaam zijn.

We werken volgens een Agile-methodiek in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage aan deze werkwijze vinden we belangrijk. Dit betekent onder andere het opstellen van kwalitatief goede stories en epics, het actueel houden van stories op het Azure DevOps-bord en een actieve, constructieve deelname aan dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je beschikt over methodische kennis van Agile en Scrum en weet hoe je samenwerking en continue verbetering binnen een team stimuleert. Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Daarbij herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over technische basiskennis en hebt begrip van API's, cloudsystemen en software- en/of infrastructuurarchitectuur.

  • Je hebt kennis van Agile en Scrum en beschikt over de methodische vaardigheden om deze werkwijzen toe te passen.

  • Je beschikt over sterke sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief samen te werken met engineers en stakeholders.

  • Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken.

  • Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4818,- en maximaal € 7094,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

De sluitingsdatum voor deze vacature is woensdag 25 november 2026.

title: Productmanager Parts & Tyres
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? Krijg je energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Dan is deze functie bij BAS Parts & Tyres iets voor jou!

BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Van complete motoren met meer dan 700 pk tot truckcabines die in containers de hele wereld overgaan: bij ons draait alles op grote schaal!

Als Productmanager Parts & Tyres ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling en groei van jouw eigen assortiment. Je analyseert de markt, onderhoudt contact met leveranciers en bepaalt welke producten interessant zijn om in te kopen. Met jouw commerciële inzicht en analytische vaardigheden zorg je ervoor dat onze producten goed aansluiten bij de vraag van klanten wereldwijd.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te werken en direct bij te dragen aan het commerciële succes van BAS Parts & Tyres.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Productmanager ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw productgroepen. Je combineert markt- en data-analyse met inkoop, assortimentsbeheer en samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen.

Je houdt ontwikkelingen binnen de markt in de gaten, onderzoekt welke producten goed verkopen en kijkt waar nieuwe commerciële kansen liggen.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je analyseert marktontwikkelingen, verkoopcijfers en klantbehoeften om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je onderhoudt contact met leveranciers, onderhandelt over inkoopmogelijkheden en koopt zelfstandig onderdelen in;

  • Je signaleert kansen om het assortiment uit te breiden, aan te passen of juist producten uit te faseren;

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat productinformatie, zoals specificaties, omschrijvingen en kenmerken, volledig en correct online staat;

  • Je bewaakt de commerciële prestaties van jouw productgroepen en stuurt op omzet, marges en beschikbaarheid;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van inkoop, sales, e-commerce, marketing en IT om verbeteringen door te voeren;

  • Je draagt actief bij aan het behalen van persoonlijke en teamdoelstellingen.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. Daarbij combineer je analytisch werken met commercie en ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontdekken en benutten van nieuwe kansen.

Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk?

Bij BAS Parts & Tyres krijg je de kans om zelfstandig aan jouw eigen assortiment te werken. Je hebt direct invloed op welke producten we aanbieden, hoe we deze presenteren en hoe succesvol ze worden verkocht.

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met uiteenlopende technische producten en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Of je nu nieuwe leveranciers ontdekt, verkoopresultaten analyseert of samen met collega's verbeteringen doorvoert: geen dag is hetzelfde!

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris met een bonusregeling;

  • Een veelzijdige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief;

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via producttrainingen, taalcursussen en andere opleidingen;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationaal groeiende organisatie;

  • Een jong, ambitieus en gezellig team waarin successen samen worden gevierd;

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en ruimte voor ondernemerschap;

  • Deelname aan het BAS Fit-programma met sportactiviteiten zoals de marathon van Eindhoven, het BAS Voetbaltoernooi en het BAS Padeltoernooi;

  • Gezellige borrels, teamuitjes en natuurlijk de legendarische BAS-feesten!


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een ondernemende en analytische collega die commerciële kansen herkent, initiatief neemt en graag verantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;

  • Je hebt interesse in automotive, techniek en truckonderdelen;

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data om te zetten naar concrete commerciële kansen;

  • Je werkt graag met Excel en kunt verkoopcijfers en marktontwikkelingen analyseren;

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen en laten groeien van een assortiment;

  • Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en denkt in oplossingen;

  • Je kunt goed plannen en organiseren en houdt overzicht wanneer het druk is;

  • Je werkt graag samen met verschillende afdelingen.

Nog geen uitgebreide kennis van truckonderdelen? Geen probleem! Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, commerciële instelling en interesse in techniek kun je bij ons volop leren en jezelf ontwikkelen.

Een nieuwe locatie, volop groeimogelijkheden

BAS Parts & Tyres blijft groeien en investeert daarom in een gloednieuwe vestiging in Veghel. Hier vind je een modern kantoor met ruimte voor 100 collega's, een uitgebreide kantine en twee magazijnhallen met samen 2.500 m² opslagruimte en een hoogte van 15 meter.

Deze nieuwe locatie biedt volop mogelijkheden om onze internationale handel verder uit te breiden. Als Productmanager speel jij een belangrijke rol in deze groei en krijg je de ruimte om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS Parts & Tyres!

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS Parts & Tyres is onderdeel van BAS Group, een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel van vrachtwagens, trailers, machines, onderdelen en banden.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze dienstverlening verbeteren!

title: Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

title: Projectontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

· Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform engineering assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design engineering role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft powerplant systems. Experience with electric aviation or electric propulsion systems is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
descriptionHtml:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

descriptionHtml:
Aker Systems was founded in 2017 by a team of experienced technology professionals who recognised an opportunity to provide highly secure enterprise data platforms to large organisations.  We build and operate ground-breaking, ultra-secure, high performance, cloud-based data infrastructure for the enterprise. Our proprietary technology solutions drive performance and reduce costs while helping our clients to improve the management and sharing of data across their organisations.

In 2024, Aker Systems won the Breakthrough Culture Awards highlighting growth companies putting culture first. In 2020 Aker Systems was recognised as a ‘One to Watch’ on the Sunday Times Tech Track.  The Company was also recognised at the Thames Valley Tech Awards 2020; winning the Thames Valley Tech Company of the year, the Emerging Tech Company and High Growth Tech Business categories.  We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.  We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, and supportive place for you to do your very best work.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Lead Data Engineer to design, build and evolve secure, scalable data platforms for clients across the UK Public Sector and Utilities sectors.

You will work closely with architects, engineers and client stakeholders to deliver modern cloud-based data solutions that support operational, analytical and AI-driven use cases. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping clients modernise their data estates while ensuring solutions are secure, reliable and scalable.

Working across multiple projects, you will lead the development of batch and real-time data pipelines, support architectural decision-making, and help establish engineering best practices across delivery teams.

Strong experience with real-time streaming technologies is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and deployment of secure, scalable data pipelines and data platform components.
  • Design and implement batch and real-time streaming solutions using modern event-driven architectures.
  • Own technical design decisions across projects, balancing scalability, security, performance and delivery requirements.
  • Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions and architecture discussions with client stakeholders.
  • Assess existing client data platforms and design practical approaches for modernisation, migration and integration.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion, transformation and integration capabilities across a variety of data sources.
  • Develop cloud-native data platforms using AWS services and open-source technologies.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, lineage and security requirements are embedded throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Drive engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Support multiple client engagements, helping delivery teams maintain consistent engineering quality and standards.
  • Mentor and support engineers across project teams, providing technical guidance and leadership.
  • Perform data modelling, performance tuning and root cause analysis to resolve complex data and platform issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

Real-Time Streaming & Data Engineering

  • Strong commercial experience designing and implementing real-time streaming data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Apache Pulsar, or similar event-driven technologies.
  • Experience building high-volume, low-latency, resilient data pipelines in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern data engineering patterns, including batch, streaming and hybrid architectures.

Data Engineering & Databases

  • Extensive experience developing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing data models for analytical and operational workloads.
  • Proficiency in Python or other modern programming languages used for data engineering.
  • Experience configuring, tuning and optimising relational and NoSQL databases.

Cloud & Software Engineering

  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud services, including EC2, RDS, Lambda, Athena, Glue, S3 and IAM.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and engineering automation.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.

Regulated Environments

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within UK Public Sector, Utilities, Energy, Water, Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Understanding of security, governance and compliance considerations within regulated environments.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of Ansible and Packer.
  • Linux and Windows administration experience.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning or advanced analytics platforms.
  • Experience working on programmes requiring UK Government security clearance.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated environments.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support and mentor others.
  • A focus on delivering practical solutions that create value for clients.
  • A passion for building reliable, scalable and secure data platforms.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Aker Systems Attributes

At Aker we work as a team; we are collaborative, hardworking, open, and delivery obsessed. There is no blame culture here: try things, and take responsibility for the outcomes. You are always part of the wider Aker. We help our colleagues and take pride in successfully achieving difficult tasks. We run towards problems and help to solve them. Communicate always, do so accurately and in a timely fashion.

In return, we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company paid medical insurance and life assurance, pension scheme, annual training allowance, wellbeing allowance, virtual GP, Employee Assistance plan and more.

Equal Opportunities

Aker Systems fosters a diverse environment that encourages openness in its communications and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics. We embrace differences of opinion and diversity because they help challenge us and find new groundbreaking technical solutions.

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.
