title: Partner Solution Architect - SAI
descriptionHtml:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. 

About the Role 

Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. This individual will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Veeam partners, working closely with Veeam’s Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to design, demonstrate and validate Securiti.ai solutions for partners and their customers. This position adds deep technical expertise to the partner motion while preserving the Channel Manager’s ownership of the overall partner relationship. 

The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC. Together with Veeam channel and partner teams, this individual will build partner technical capability, lead solution design and proofs of value, and help convert partner-led opportunities into measurable Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue. 

 Success requires technical depth, strong collaboration and the ability to translate complex data security and AI governance requirements into clear, deployable solutions. The ideal candidate is a credible pre-sales architect who excels in an overlay model — someone who strengthens existing Veeam partner relationships while contributing the architecture, demonstrations and enablement needed to build a successful Securiti.ai practice. This person can earn the confidence of partner engineers and customer security leaders alike and turn technical engagement into repeatable, partner-delivered outcomes. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment 

Operate as the technical overlay within the Veeam channel organization: 

  • Partner with Veeam Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to support each assigned partner with a consistent technical engagement cadence. 
  • Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. 
  • Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. 
  • Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. 
  • Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. 
  • Serve as the bridge between partners and Veeam and Securiti.ai product management, engineering, support and services teams, relaying field feedback and feature requirements. 

 Partner Technical Planning 

  • Develop technical enablement and certification plans for assigned partners alongside their Veeam Channel Managers and Partner Specialists, setting goals for certified engineers, demo capability, proofs of value and delivery readiness. 
  • Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. 
  • Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. 
  • Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. 

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

  • Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai. 
  • Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. 
  • Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. 
  • Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. 
  • Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. 
  • Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. 

 Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support 

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 
  • Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 
  • Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 
  • Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

  • Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 
  • Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 
  • Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 
  • Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 
  • Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. 

What You’ll Bring 

  •  7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. 
  • Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. 
  • Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. 
  • Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. 
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. 
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. 
  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. 
  • Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. 
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. 

 Bonus Skills 

  • Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. 
  • Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. 
  • Familiarity with privacy and AI regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF. 
  • Relevant security, privacy, or cloud certifications (for example CIPP, CISSP, CCSP, or an AWS, Azure or GCP architect or security credential). 

What You'll Get

You will generate new demand and build qualified pipeline, working both self-generated outbound and inbound demand from marketing. You will run discovery conversations that produce genuinely qualified opportunities, and stay with them until they are established with a Sales Specialist.

What You’ll Bring

title: Principal Engineer, Duo Agent Platform
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.

Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.

The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.

This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.

What you'll do

  • Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
  • Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
  • Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. 
  • Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
  • Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
  • Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
  • Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
    • Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
    • Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
    • Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
    • Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
  • Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
  • Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
  • A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
  • Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.

About the team

The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. What You'll Be Doing

What You Bring

  • Commercial experience with Elixir, or strong backend development experience in technologies such as Ruby on Rails, Python, Java, or PHP combined with a strong motivation to learn Elixir

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le projet AMRIT :

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

Le poste est à temps plein et comprend des déplacements en France et à l’étranger en fonction des besoins du projet.

L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

    ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

    ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

    ********************************************************

    ENSTA (https://www.ensta.fr) is a higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of the defense. The school’s mission is to train civil and military engineering students, as well as highly qualified executives and PhD graduates for the public and private sectors, particularly in the fields of defence and security, transport, energy, maritime activities, digital technology and cutting-edge technologies.

    ENSTA supports the transformation of major national strategic sectors through its research, innovation and educational programmes, thereby addressing the challenges of national sovereignty. It comprises six teaching and research units (UFRs) which conduct applied research in close collaboration with industry.

    ENSTA is a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). As part of IP Paris, the school participates in the activities of IP Paris interdisciplinary centres, notably the Interdisciplinary Centre for Seas and Ocean (CIMO), co-founded with Ifremer and supported by the Defence Innovation Agency (AID) and the French research council CNRS. Researchers from the school also collaborate on studies led by interdisciplinary centres such as Hi-Paris – winner of the 2024 AI Cluster award – E4C and E4H, amongst others.

    Joining the school means becoming part of an institution committed to gender parity and professional equality, diversity and supporting its staff with disabilities, from the moment of recruitment and throughout their careers. To safeguard wellbeing at work, the school pursues an active policy on working conditions, based in particular on a healthy work-life balance.

    The AMRIT project :

    Today in Europe, the operations of in situ observing platforms rely on a network of Research Infrastructures distributed all around Europe. The activities in the network include in situ and remote operations at sea and data management of a large number of assets for a wide variety of applications. Such activities rely on important IT resources, R&D to improve the capacity of the platforms, as well as managerial and financial activities to run the infrastructures and provide access to them. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) is a pioneering project designed to revolutionise the landscape of marine research infrastructures in Europe, strengthening their ability to respond to Europe's policy and global scientific challenges.

    AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) is a Horizon Europe & UKRI funded project, with 26 European partners, designed to advance Marine Research Infrastructures (MRIs). By developing tools and services integrating the operations of marine observation platforms, AMRIT aims to:

    • Ensure seamless operation of marine observation platforms.

    • Ensure the full nominal use of sensors and accelerate their evolution.

    • Exploit the complementarity of the various observation platforms.

    • Ensure the overall coherence of the ocean data value chain.

    • Ensure a consistent and comprehensive list of metadata and descriptors.

    Mission of the Scientific and Technical Manager :

    As third party of ARMINES, the administrative Coordinator of the Horizon Europe Project AMRIT, ENSTA is seeking a Scientific and Technical Manager. Under the supervision of the project Scientific Coordinator, Professor Laurent Mortier (ENSTA), the main tasks of the Project Manager are to:

    • Coordinate the overall implementation of the project and monitor its progress, including work packages, deliverables, milestones, deadlines and key performance indicators, in close collaboration with the Scientific Coordinator and with the support of ARMINES administrative staff.

    • Monitor project risks, deviations and corrective actions, and propose mitigation or adjustment measures where necessary.

    • Lead and coordinate the consortium, maintaining regular communication with consortium members, facilitating collaboration among partners, ensuring the effective flow of information and supporting partners in the implementation of their activities.

    • Organise and coordinate consortium meetings, including steering committee meetings, technical meetings and general assemblies, as well as their preparation and follow-up.

    • Coordinate the preparation of project reports and deliverables, consolidating contributions from partners and ensuring their quality and timely submission.

    • Contribute to the communication, dissemination and exploitation of project results, including through workshops and conferences, in coordination with the relevant partners.

    • Act as the main liaison with the European Commission, including maintaining regular communication and follow-up with the Project Officer.

    • Represent the consortium and build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders at national, European and international levels.

    Required qualifications and skills :

    • Applicants must have an advanced university degree (M.Sc or equivalent degree) in Oceanography, Marine Science or Engineering, or related fields. A PhD in a relevant field is an advantage.

    • Applicants must have at least 5 years (PhD included) of relevant experience in ocean observations or services in ocean observation organisations.

    • Applicants must have demonstrated experience in coordinating, managing and implementing projects, desirably at the European or international level.

    • Excellent organizational, written and communication skills.

    • Professional command of both spoken and written English, and good knowledge of French and/or another European language.

    Desired qualifications and skills :

    • Motivation and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders on national, international (and interdisciplinary) levels including researchers, operators, administrative staff, science officers, and policy makers.

    • Degree in management of European affairs or similar.

    • Knowledge of major national and EU funding instruments.

    • Experience of working and collaborating among Research Infrastructures in the environmental field.

    Working conditions :

    ENSTA is committed to a recruitment process that promotes equality, diversity and inclusion. All applications, regardless of any distinction (age, disability, gender, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), are welcome in our recruitment process.

    The role is full-time and involves travel within France and abroad, depending on the project’s requirements. Remote working is possible in accordance with the employer’s current policies.

    Administrative :

    The position is for a duration of 18 months, based in ENSTA premises in Brest, Brittany. Other locations may be considered.

    Enquiries about the position should be addressed to Professor Laurent Mortier (). Enquiries regarding the detailed terms and conditions of employment at ENSTA can be addressed to Margot Provost ().

    To apply for this position, the full application must be submitted via the website https://enstaparis.recruitee.com/ by 27 September 2026, together with all the documents requested on the website.

    Please also send your CV, a covering letter, and the name of 2 referees in the project field, before 20th September 2026 to:

    • Margot Provost ()

    • and Pr. Laurent Mortier ()

    Interviews will be organised online with the shortlisted applicants.

    Complementary informations :

    The contract is financed by Grant Agreement 101132013 Horizon Europe - European Commission “Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together” (AMRIT)


    Connaissances :

    • Connaissance des principaux instruments de financement nationaux et européens ;

    • Expérience de travail et de collaboration au sein d’infrastructures de recherche dans le domaine de l’environnement.

    Savoir-faire:

    • Motivation et capacité à interagir avec de multiples parties prenantes aux niveaux national, international (et interdisciplinaire), notamment des chercheurs, des opérateurs, du personnel administratif, des responsables scientifiques ou équivalent ;

    • Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit, et bonne connaissance du français et / ou d’une autre langue européenne.

    Aptitudes:

    • Organisation ;

    • Rédaction ;

    • Communication.

    Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur (Master ou équivalent) en océanographie, en sciences marines, en ingénierie ou dans les domaines connexes.

    Un doctorat dans le domaine pertinent constitue un atout.

    Les candidats doivent justifier d’au moins 5 ans (doctorat compris) d’expérience pertinente dans le domaine des observations océaniques ou au sein d’organismes spécialisés dans ce domaine.

    Les candidats doivent justifier d’une expérience avérée dans la coordination, la gestion et la mise en œuvre de projets, de préférence au niveau européen ou international

title: Risk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Risk Analyst

You'll support & refine our lending strategy within Germany, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk.

Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses in Germany with the funds they need to grow.

The team

The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to in Germany, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca Germany’s growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London.

 

The role

We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Risk Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca Germany’s lending strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build expertise in the credit domain.

  • Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis.

  • Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions.

  • Partner with key stakeholders within Team Germany in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes).

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards, presenting a clear picture of the state of our lending.

  • Practice turning data into information, and information into insights, so that you and various stakeholders can deliver improvements with real impact for our customers.

The requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • A degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar.

  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to support decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor analysis and recommendations to different audiences.

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving.

  • A bucket-load of common sense.

  • A commitment to using modern tools effectively – including AI – to maximise quality, speed, and rigour, while retaining responsibility for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • Experience in B2B or B2C credit risk lending and strategy.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Looker

The salary

We expect to pay from £40,000–£55,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Sales Development Representative (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails, and fragmented processes to manage billions of dollars in spend. As AI agents become capable of taking over increasingly complex workflows, the way companies run procurement is about to change.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Development Representative, you're not just booking meetings.

You're creating the first impression of Lio. You're opening conversations with the world's largest enterprises and helping procurement leaders understand how AI can transform the way they operate.

You'll work closely with founders, Account Executives, Marketing, and Product, and directly influence how we scale our go-to-market motion.

What You'll Do

  • Generate and qualify pipeline through creative outbound and inbound strategies

  • Engage early-stage prospects and educate them on how AI agents can transform procurement operations

  • Run outreach across multiple channels including email, LinkedIn, and phone

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Account Executives to refine messaging, qualification, and handoff processes

  • Capture customer feedback and share insights with Product to help shape future features and improvements

  • Own your pipeline from first touch to handoff and ensure a seamless customer experience

  • Help build and continuously improve Lio's go-to-market playbook

Your Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership by default. You don't wait for instructions or permission. You make things happen, care about outcomes, and see challenges as problems to solve rather than obstacles to accept.

  • Know how to communicate and excite. Whether you're speaking to a Fortune 500 executive, a procurement leader, or an operational buyer on the factory floor, you know how to build trust, create excitement, and adapt your message to the person in front of you.

  • Enjoy high-growth environments. Things move quickly, priorities change, and ambiguity doesn't scare you. You learn fast, adapt quickly, and thrive when there's a lot to build.

  • Are curious about AI and excited about the opportunities this technology creates for enterprises. You don't need to be an expert, but you believe AI will fundamentally reshape how businesses operate.

What's not required

Previous experience in enterprise sales, business development, or SDR roles is not required.

We're much more interested in ambition, curiosity, communication skills, and execution than in having the perfect CV.

Why Join Lio?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Silicon Valley's most prestigious investor. We're bringing that same ambition, speed, and culture to Munich. This is a unique opportunity to join a company with Silicon Valley DNA while building in Europe.

We work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, working with C-level procurement leaders on large-scale transformation initiatives. From your very first day, you'll be exposed to some of the most influential enterprises in the world and play a role in how AI gets adopted in the real world.

We move fast, iterate constantly, and care deeply about execution. There are no endless approval processes, no politics, and no waiting around for permission. People here own outcomes and continuously raise the bar.

Joining Lio today means joining early. The category is still being defined. The playbook is still being written. Everyone at Lio is expected to take ownership, move fast, and help shape not only the business, but also the culture we're building.

If you're excited about building something exceptional, working with world-class customers, and helping shape one of Europe's category defining AI companies, we'd love to hear from you.

Opportunities like this don't come around often. If you're looking for a comfortable 9-to-5, Lio is probably not for you. If you're excited about building something extraordinary, we'd love to talk.

Any questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Cansel.

title: Sales Development Representative - Nordics + Benelux
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our London office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in London and looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the Nordics/Benelux region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why you will thrive at n8n?

Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do;

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for;

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) + an additional language is beneficial

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our London office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Sales Director - Security & Defense - Uk
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we can create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to bring about real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measure, allowing you to build a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background, and we speak over 20 languages across our 50+ nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Do you strive to make a difference in the National Security and Defence sector? Are you driven to support the innovation and transformational change that will enable UK Defence to utilize its data fully, unleashing its power at scale and speed, and ensuring that operational and business decisions are based on correct, timely, and trusted information? At Quantexa, we are.

This urge and desire to challenge ourselves and the industry is what drives us every day. At Quantexa, our culture is underpinned not only by our ability to build market-leading, AI-driven technology but also by creating real change across the UK Defence sector. It’s what has led us to support National Security and Defence on several key projects, and we won’t be stopping there. #UNSTOPPABLE

The UK Defence Sales Director will join a collaborative team looking to build on current relationships while also forging new ones. This position is central to the growth of our EMEA Public Sector – National Security & Defence team. Working with our Solution Engineering, Product, Marketing, Delivery, and Customer Success teams, you will be responsible for executing the sales go-to-market strategy, identifying new opportunities, building our pipeline, winning new deals, and meeting company targets.

What you’ll be doing.

Typical responsibilities include working with our VP of EMEA Public Sector, National Security & Defence Market Vertical Lead, and the Director of Government Solutions to define and execute the sales strategy and go-to-market plan for the UK Defence Sector. You will consistently deliver against sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of the business. Your role will be a combination of hunting and farming; we have a great pipeline that needs nurturing, but we also require someone with a hunting mentality to develop new clients.

You will be tasked with bringing together people from different teams, working with Solutions Engineers, Marketing, Delivery, Technology Account Partners, Alliances, and many other areas.

  • In office collaboration: In-office collaboration is a core part of how we build and solve problems together, so there will be an expectation to be in the London office or on client site 2-3 days per week.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • A good understanding of UK Defence Sector issues and the ability to ‘advise and solutionize’ with the customer through a consultative, sales-based approach.

  • A track record of positioning and selling enterprise software, either directly or as part of an ecosystem.

  • Experience building partnerships across System Integrators, Cloud platform providers, and Consultancy organizations.

  • A good understanding of UK Defence Sector operational and buying processes.

  • Experience nurturing accounts and identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities with existing clients.

  • Determination to succeed in challenging circumstances.

  • Ability to integrate into effective sales teams and lead opportunities.

  • Existing relationships within UK Defence.

  • Expertise in working and solution-selling within the UK Defence sector.

  • The ability to be an independent decision-maker who is also inclusive when evaluating options.

  • Ambition and energy with strong interpersonal skills.

  • Strong commercial and entrepreneurial qualities.

  • A good team player, capable of delivering results in less-than-perfect circumstances.

  • Ability to support market changes, flagging these early and reacting effectively and positively.

  • Ability to plan for the future.

  • Can perform effectively in complex and difficult environments.

  • Can achieve success through others.

  • An optimistic outlook and the ability to identify opportunities.

  • Constructive, resilient, and perseverant.

  • You will either hold current SC clearance or have the willingness and ability to achieve it, and possibly DV clearance.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Commission

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Second Charge Mortgage Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Second Charge Mortgage Underwriter to join our underwriting team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful business that is expanding into secured lending. We are bringing Open banking and AI to the secured lending process to save customers money.

We are looking for someone with strong property underwriter experience in a second charge lending space, someone who can work to targets and thrives in a startup environment.

We have great opportunities for progression in an ever-growing business.

About the Team

Unlike traditional lenders, we’re focused on doing things differently. Our underwriting approach combines a state-of-the-art in-house built technology that blends traditional lending methods with Open Banking analysis to create a smoother and more flexible experience for our customers.

We work together to our common goals using Ai to assist our daily lives. We are always working towards improvement and encourage feedback from everyone; you can see your ideas comes to life.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 6:00pm

What You'll Be Doing

  • Assess and underwrite second charge mortgage applications, using Open banking, affordability, credit history, and security property details against lending policy and regulatory requirements

  • Liaise directly with brokers, request further information, and keep cases progressing to completion within SLA

  • Ensure every decision is fully documented and auditable, meeting FCA and internal compliance standards (including affordability, vulnerable customer, and consumer duty requirements)

  • Provide clear, constructive feedback to brokers and internal sales teams on declined or conditioned cases

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of underwriting policy, criteria, and process as the second charge product and book matures

  • Work cross-functionally with Risk, Compliance, and Operations to ensure underwriting practices support both growth and good customer outcomes.

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in second charge mortgages

  • You'll be comfortable working to targets, driving month-on-month growth as the book expands.

  • Good understanding of property as security — including valuation approaches, equity position, LTV and combined LTV calculations, existing charge structures, and title issues — with the ability to lead confidently on lending decisions where property equity is the primary basis for risk.

  • Strong working knowledge of FCA regulation, UK responsible lending rules, affordability assessment, MCOB requirements, fraud prevention, and AML regulations, with the credibility to interpret and apply these commercially.

  • Proven track record in manual underwriting of complex, high-value, and non-standard cases, with the judgement to make balanced decisions beyond a tick-box approach.

  • Relevant industry qualifications (e.g., CeMAP, CeRER, DipFA or equivalent) are highly desirable.

How We Work

• We prioritise sound credit decisions and continuous learning from outcomes.

• We take ownership of our work and support one another to achieve shared goals.

• We work collaboratively across the business and contribute beyond individual responsibilities.

• We encourage open discussion, constructive challenge, and accountability.

• Strong performance and positive contribution are recognised and rewarded.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

descriptionHtml:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

descriptionHtml:

Why Firmus?

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. 

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior AI Security Engineer, AI Products & Applications will be embedded within the AI & Applications team to enable the secure design, development, release, and operation of AI products and applications. The role works directly with AI engineers, application engineers, product managers, inference engineers, DevOps, and platform teams to build practical security controls into agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model-serving APIs, enterprise-data integrations, and user-facing AI experiences.

This is a product- and application-oriented security role. The engineer will help teams deliver trusted AI features without unnecessarily slowing innovation, while ensuring that AI products protect customer, enterprise, and operational data. The role reports operationally to the Head of AI & Applications, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Cybersecurity to maintain alignment with enterprise security strategy, risk management, compliance requirements, and incident-response processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with AI product, application, and engineering teams from discovery through production to define secure-by-design architectures for AI-powered products and services.
  • Threat-model LLM-enabled and agentic workflows, including direct and indirect prompt injection, data exfiltration, unsafe tool use, excessive agent permissions, cross-tenant access, model abuse, and unintended autonomous actions.
  • Design secure patterns for agent identity, delegated authorization, scoped credentials, tool allowlists, approval gates, action validation, execution sandboxing, rollback, and auditability.
  • Secure RAG and enterprise-knowledge workflows, including document ingestion, indexing, retrieval permissions, metadata filtering, source attribution, tenant isolation, sensitive-data classification, and data-retention controls.
  • Define security controls for user-facing AI products, including authentication, authorization, consent, rate limiting, abuse detection, content and output controls, conversation-data handling, and customer-facing audit trails.
  • Secure model-serving and inference APIs through workload identity, API authentication, tenant-aware access controls, quotas, request validation, model access policies, usage monitoring, and logging controls.
  • Build reusable AI security guardrails, libraries, reference architectures, templates, policy-as-code, and developer tooling that make secure implementation the default path for product teams.
  • Work with DevOps and Platform teams to ensure Kubernetes, custom job-scheduler integrations, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, containers, and runtime environments provide the required security posture for AI applications.
  • Lead vulnerability management for AI application dependencies, model-serving runtimes, agent frameworks, SDKs, APIs, containers, CUDA and GPU software components, and related infrastructure.
  • Embed security requirements into application design reviews, pull-request and CI/CD controls, release processes, operational runbooks, and incident-response procedures.
  • Develop security telemetry and detections for anomalous agent actions, unsafe tool calls, unusual data retrieval, credential misuse, inference API abuse, suspicious workload behavior, and policy violations.
  • Act as the principal security liaison between AI & Applications and the Cybersecurity function, coordinating architecture reviews, security exceptions, risk acceptance, compliance evidence, incident response, and remediation tracking.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, platform security, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience embedding security practices into software engineering or product-development teams and supporting secure delivery from design through production.
  • Strong understanding of application security, API security, secure software development lifecycle practices, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and security automation.
  • Practical understanding of AI and LLM application security risks, including prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure tool use, excessive agency, model abuse, sensitive-data exposure, cross-tenant data leakage, and supply-chain risks.
  • Experience securing agentic applications, RAG systems, enterprise search, vector databases, model-serving APIs, enterprise-data connectors, or comparable AI-enabled systems.
  • Experience designing identity and access controls using OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SSO, RBAC, ABAC, workload identity, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and container security, including admission controls, network policies, RBAC, runtime protection, image scanning, software supply-chain security, and policy engines.
  • Experience with secure CI/CD, dependency governance, SBOMs, image signing, provenance, artifact management, and controlled-release processes.
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar language for automation, security tooling, integrations, and analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud and infrastructure security, including logging, monitoring, incident response, encryption, key management, and security controls for multi-tenant systems.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Controls, OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Top 10, or equivalent frameworks.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Secure-by-design AI product and application engineering.
  • Threat modeling for LLM, RAG, agentic, and autonomous workflows.
  • Application, API, identity, and authorization security.
  • Secure AI data flows, retrieval controls, and tenant isolation.
  • Agent governance, tool authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, and action auditability.
  • Kubernetes, container, CI/CD, and software supply-chain security.
  • Risk-based prioritization that balances product velocity, user experience, operational reliability, and security requirements.
  • Developer enablement through reusable guardrails, secure patterns, automation, and clear documentation.
  • Strong cross-functional communication with AI engineers, product teams, platform teams, DevOps, legal/compliance stakeholders, and Cybersecurity leadership.
  • Ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving AI product environment.

SUCCESS METRICS

  • Percentage of AI products, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and inference services that complete security design review before production release.
  • Adoption rate of reusable security patterns, guardrails, libraries, templates, and policy controls across AI & Applications projects.
  • Coverage of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, approval gates, audit logging, secrets management, and data-protection controls across AI applications.
  • Reduction in critical and high-risk security findings discovered late in development, during release, or after production deployment.
  • Mean time to identify, triage, and remediate vulnerabilities affecting AI applications, agent frameworks, model-serving components, APIs, and dependencies.
  • Reduction in unsafe or unauthorized agent actions, insecure tool calls, sensitive-data exposure events, abnormal retrieval attempts, and inference API abuse.
  • Security readiness of AI product releases, including completion of threat models, architecture reviews, security testing, operational runbooks, and exception approvals.
  • Demonstrable improvement in the time required for product teams to adopt approved security controls and obtain production-release clearance.
  • Quality and completeness of security telemetry, audit evidence, incident investigations, and post-incident remediation.

Effective execution of the dotted-line operating model, including consistent alignment with the Head of Cybersecurity on risk posture, standards, escalations, compliance, and incident response

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

You will initially establish operational foundations for new digital-asset and stablecoin capabilities, collaborating across Risk, Compliance, and Merchant teams to create clear, executable processes.
