  • Drive clarity & alignment: Structure ambiguous problems, identify risks, and align cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Scale & optimise: Establish governance, metrics, controls, and automated workflows using AI and modern tooling.

What We’re Looking For

  • Digital Assets & Payments Implementation: A strong background in digital assets, crypto (specifically stablecoin), blockchain technology, and implementing regulated payment capabilities. Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools, agents, and automation to transform operational processes into scalable workflows.

  • Operational Excellence & Process Design: 3+ years in process design or operational excellence driving transformation in fintech. Demonstrated ability to apply structured process methodologies (e.g. Lean Six Sigma) to solve complex, ambiguous problems.

  • Cross-Domain Agility: Proven ability to work across multiple operational functions (e.g. Risk, Compliance, and Merchant servicing) to support cross-functional operational requirements.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Strong analytical skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams without direct authority. You must communicate clearly across technical, operational, and executive audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • End-User Product Experience: Experience supporting or launching end-user facing product capabilities, digital assets, or regulated payment implementations.

  • Advanced AI & Automation: Proficiency with AI tools/platforms (e.g., Claude, Codex, custom agents), workflow automation, process mining, or operational analytics.

  • Process Methodologies: Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, or structured transformation frameworks.

  • Cross-Functional & Governance Operations: Experience across multiple operational functions (Risk, Compliance, Merchant) and establishing governance, operating procedures, and control frameworks.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward senior engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll lead Resonance’s most ambitious client engagements across DACH. You will design and build production AI systems to drive a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier, own end-to-end deployments, and lead a team of AI engineers to build at pace. You’ll set the technical direction, advising CTOs and engineering leads of leading enterprises and owning security, reliability and governance for everything we put into production. You’ll lead the build from first prototype to production while staying hands-on in the code, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems, and setting the bar for code quality, evals and observability. You’ll grow the firm by building Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning patterns from client work into reusable components, and coaching the engineers on your team as one of our first technical leaders in Berlin.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have 5+ years building software, including technical lead or architect responsibility for a production AI system. You might be a senior, staff or principal engineer at an AI-first company or scale-up, a lead forward deployed engineer, a technical lead at an AI consultancy or an AI lab’s applied team, or the founder of your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have designed and shipped LLM systems in production, including agents, retrieval and evals, and design for how they fail. You’ve led engineering teams and raised their bar, make clear decisions under uncertainty, and are commercial and comfortable problem solving with technical and non-technical execs. German is a plus for client work in DACH, but not a requirement.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. Your work drives tangible outcomes for consequential companies, alongside a team aiming to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe and worldwide. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners in Berlin, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Senior Branch Nurse
descriptionHtml:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced RVN to join us as Senior Branch Nurse and lead our Tadley Surgery.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an RVN looking to take the next step in their career and play an important role in the leadership and development of our friendly Tadley team.

Donnington Grove Veterinary Group is an established three-branch practice, with our main RCVS Tier 3 Hospital in Newbury and branches in Thatcham and Tadley.

We have a large and varied client base, a supportive nursing team and excellent opportunities for professional development. We encourage our nurses to develop their own interests and pursue further qualifications.

We have a team of 17 vets, including certificate holders in small animal surgery, ophthalmology and exotics, as well as vets with an interest in internal medicine. This makes us more than a first-opinion practice as we often perform surgeries and treat cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, and with two branch practices in Thatcham and Tadley, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in our caseload. Our nursing team is made up of 15 RVNs and 8 SVNs in various stages of their training. We are supported by a team of 7 nursing assistants. We also have a dedicated team of 3 night nurses.

We encourage our nurses to pursue special interests as much as possible; for example, we currently have nurses studying towards nutrition and small animal medicine certificates

How You’ll Make a Difference

As Senior Branch Nurse, you will provide day-to-day leadership to the nursing team while remaining hands-on clinically. You will work closely with our vets, nurses and support staff to ensure we deliver excellent patient care, outstanding client service and high clinical standards.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you’ll help lead standards within theatre, support and mentor junior colleagues and contribute to the ongoing development of our nursing protocols and ways of working.

Working Pattern

* 40 hours per week across 5 days * Shifts between 8:30 am - 7 pm * No weekend work but OOH cover required with TOIL

General Responsibilities

* Leading and supporting the nursing team at Tadley * Delivering high standards of medical and surgical nursing * Supporting perioperative care and anaesthesia * Providing nurse consultations and excellent client care * Supporting the training and development of RVNs, SVNs and nursing assistants * Taking responsibility for stock control, including monitoring stock levels, placing orders, checking expiry dates, stock rotation and reducing wastage * Taking responsibility for clinical equipment, including regular checks, servicing, maintenance and arranging repairs where required * Helping organise workloads and the smooth running of the branch * Working closely with the vets and Nurse Management Team * Promoting high clinical standards and continuous improvement * Ensuring a positive and supportive working environment

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

We’re looking for an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working as part of a team and is ready to take greater responsibility within a busy theatre environment. You’ll bring:

* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS * Confidence supporting anaesthesia, surgical procedures and peri-operative patient care * Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues * Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities effectively within a busy clinical environment * An interest in supporting, mentoring and developing other members of the nursing team * A proactive approach to learning, reflection and continuous improvement

How We’ll Support You

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

* A varied and rewarding senior nursing role within a specialist-led equine hospital * Opportunities to develop your theatre, surgical and leadership experience * Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into senior nursing, referral and leadership roles, as well as Clinical Coach, mentoring and certificate pathways * Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and specialist clinical teams * A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement

What We Offer Our Team

* 6.6 weeks' annual leave plus your birthday off * Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service * Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay * Private Medical Insurance * Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme * £550 CPD allowance plus 24 hours' paid CPD leave * Certificate support * RCVS and VDS fees covered * Pension scheme * Discounted veterinary care * Voluntary benefits including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts and cashback with hundreds of participating retailers

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

Whether you’re looking to build on your theatre experience, develop your leadership skills or take the next step in your nursing career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

title: Senior Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Brand Designer

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW

Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration.

YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels.

As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. You will support onboarding and coaching our freelancers in the guidelines and internal systems, taking ownership of both.

You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, content, product and editorial teams, while being confident operating independently, solving problems proactively and bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll also be an active contributor to our Creative Community, helping connect, inspire and align creatives across the wider business (there are plenty of creative pockets at Carwow Group!).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver high-quality design across brand, campaign, social, print, CRM, paid media and editorial channels.

  • Partner with the Head of Creative, Creative Strategist and Copywriters to develop clear, insight-led creative ideas and campaign directions.

  • Interpret brand guidelines pragmatically, knowing when to follow, when to adapt and when to propose improvements.

  • Produce assets that scale: layouts, toolkits, templates and visual systems that support efficiency across the group.

  • Concept and create social-first paid video content that reflects platform behaviours and audience expectations, particularly across YouTube and Meta.

  • Work with Product Designers to ensure brand and campaign creative translates effectively into digital journeys.

  • Present your work with clarity, explaining rationale, constraints, and the impact of design decisions.

  • Provide constructive, objective feedback to freelancers and ensure their work aligns with brand expectations.

  • Bring structure and consistency to design delivery through thoughtful file organisation, templating and process improvements.

  • Contribute actively to Carwow’s Creative Community, sharing inspiration, collaborating across teams and helping strengthen our creative culture.

  • Proactively explore AI solutions in the creative workflow without compromising on execution.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A strong portfolio showcasing both concept development and crafted design across digital and print, preferably including a 360 campaign from ATL to tactical performance assets.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, with consistent attention to detail.

  • Ability to create coherent campaign executions, from early concepts to multi-channel rollouts.

  • Experience adapting design to fit channel needs, especially across social and performance environments.

  • Comfortable collaborating creatively with copywriters and stakeholders, and able to offer clear, thoughtful feedback.

  • Self-sufficient, organised and proactive, confident managing multiple projects without heavy oversight.

  • Strong understanding of visual trends, social formats and the role of motion in brand expression.

  • A natural collaborator who enjoys working across disciplines and connecting with other creatives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Motion design capability (After Effects + Premiere Pro)

  • Interest or experience in shooting UGC-style short form content

  • Illustration or iconography skills

  • An interest in creative operations, workflow improvements or building toolkits (including AI solutions)

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Step one: Video call with Head of Creative (30 mins)

  • Step two: Concepting or design task presented to two members of the Brand Creative team (1 hr)

  • Step three: Interview with our Brand and Comms Director (30 mins)

Default on all JDs:

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays (up to 35 with service)

  • Share options

  • Pension via Royal London (up to 5% company contribution)

  • Bupa private healthcare

  • Life assurance (4x salary)

  • Monthly wellbeing coaching with Spill

  • Inclusive parental leave policies

  • Bubble childcare support & discounted nanny fees

  • Work-from-abroad scheme

  • Generous learning & development budget

  • £500 / €550 home office budget

Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, and treat all applicants fairly and equally.

title: Senior Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Business development at Isembard is where the customer is an engineer and the pitch is a tolerance. You will open conversations with engineering-led companies in aerospace, defence, energy and robotics, qualify the work, and bring it to the factory teams who make it.

This is our first senior business development representative role, and the BDRs who join later will build on the approach you help set.

What you'll do

  • Identify and engage high-value customers in defined industrial sectors.

  • Run outreach to founders, CTOs, programme leads and procurement teams.

  • Qualify inbound RFQs, and check manufacturability with factory teams before making promises.

  • Lead early technical commercial conversations about drawings, tolerances, materials and lead times.

  • Support pricing, proposal preparation and contract negotiation.

What we're looking for

  • An engineering background (mechanical preferred) or strong technical literacy.

  • Experience in business development, technical sales or a similar commercial role.

  • Comfort reading drawings and discussing tolerances, materials and lead times.

  • Structured, calm and resilient under pressure.

  • High standards, low ego and a bias towards action.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to aerospace, defence or another regulated sector.

  • Hands-on manufacturing or machining experience.

  • Selling technical products to engineering teams.

Why Isembard

  • Frontline exposure to aerospace and defence manufacturing programmes.

  • Direct collaboration with machinists, CAM programmers and factory leaders.

  • A clear path into senior commercial leadership as the team grows.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London, with travel to customers.

title: Senior Channel Field Marketing Manager, Benelux & Nordics
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-impact, results-driven Field & Channel Marketing Manager to lead integrated marketing execution across the Nordics & Benelux region.

This is a highly visible manager-level role designed to accelerate pipeline growth through a balanced mix of field marketing, channel partner marketing, demand generation, executive engagement, and regional go-to-market execution.

The successful candidate will build and execute scalable regional programs that strengthen partner relationships, create demand, support sales priorities, and elevate brand presence across key Nordics & Benelux markets. This role will be supporting both Enterprise and Commercial Sales reps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the integrated marketing plan for the Nordics and Benelux, aligned to EMEA revenue priorities and sales targets.

  • Translate corporate campaigns into localised regional programs that drive measurable pipeline and partner engagement.

  • Develop multi-touch programs including, but not limited to, events, webinars, direct mailers, roundtables, digital, social and ABM.

  • Support regional sales teams with campaign strategy, market insights, and program execution.

  • Build and execute partner marketing plans with strategic resellers, distributors, MSSPs, alliances, and channel ecosystem partners.

  • Drive MDF / co-marketing investment toward measurable pipeline outcomes.

  • In partnership with the channel team, launch partner-led demand generation campaigns, enablement programs, and joint market initiatives.

  • Strengthen relationships with channel sales leaders and partner account teams.

  • Manage lead flow, nurture alignment, conversion optimisation, and follow-up processes with SDR and sales teams.

  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize based on ROI, conversion, and pipeline metrics.

  • Build quarterly business reviews and performance updates for leadership.

  • Share best practices across EMEA and contribute to scalable regional programs.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in B2B technology marketing, ideally within Cybersecurity

  • Experienced in marketing to the Nordics & Benelux region

  • Strong experience across field marketing + channel/partner marketing + demand generation

  • Proven success supporting revenue teams and delivering measurable pipeline growth

  • Experience working with indirect routes to market including VARs, distributors, alliances, and service providers

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to prioritise investment by market opportunity

  • Comfortable operating in matrixed, fast-growth environments

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience in using technologies such as SDFC, Asana, Reachdesk, G-Suite, Zoom Info, ON24

  • Fluent in English and Swedish OR Dutch

Preferred Experience

  • Understanding of cybersecurity categories such as cloud security, endpoint, identity, SOC, threat intelligence, zero trust, or managed security

  • Experience with ABM strategy and enterprise account engagement

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Base Salary:

  • Sweden: 1,400,000 - 1,890,000 SEK

  • Amsterdam: 127,500 - 172,500 EUR

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

title: Senior Compliance Associate - AML / Privacy (London)
descriptionHtml:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.

Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. The people who shape our company come from other backgrounds, including concert music performances, humanitarian aid, opera singing, sports writing, and BMX racing. You will be part of a team that loves to succeed together.

In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.

As a Senior Compliance Associate, AML & Privacy, you will take ownership of Voleon’s anti-money laundering (AML), investor due diligence, and data privacy compliance efforts, reporting directly to the Senior Compliance Manager in our London office. As our investor base becomes increasingly global, you will partner closely with the firm’s fund administrator on escalated investor cases, lead enhanced due diligence on investors from higher-risk jurisdictions, and oversee the firm’s privacy compliance obligations, particularly under UK and European requirements. This is a chance to build, not just maintain: you’ll help shape our AML and privacy programmes as they grow.

As part of the Compliance department, you will have broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and research groups, navigate issues related to the firm’s investment products in a fast-paced, evolving regulatory environment, and help develop policies and procedures to manage and mitigate regulatory requirements. As you grow, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities, become a subject matter expert, and make an increasingly significant impact on the firm.

This role is hybrid, with an expectation of working in our London office at least three days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on prospective and existing investors, particularly those from higher-risk jurisdictions, and make clear, timely, risk-based recommendations to Compliance leadership

  • Serve as the primary Compliance point of contact on AML and KYC escalated cases

  • Oversee the firm’s data privacy compliance programme, with a particular focus on UK and EU GDPR, including privacy notices and data subject requests

  • Develop and maintain AML and privacy policies, procedures, and operational workflows, and contribute to firmwide compliance training

  • Partner with Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders across the firm on AML, investor due diligence, and privacy matters

  • Liaise and collaborate with outside counsel, compliance consultants, and other service providers, as necessary

  • Take on broader responsibilities and develop subject matter expertise as you grow within the role

Requirements

  • 2-5+ years of experience in AML, KYC, financial crime compliance, or investor due diligence, ideally within investment management or financial services

  • Hands-on experience conducting enhanced due diligence on investors or clients, and making risk-based onboarding recommendations

  • Understanding of AML, counter-terrorist financing, and sanctions requirements across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., UK, EU, US, and offshore fund domiciles)

  • Working knowledge of data privacy requirements, particularly UK and EU GDPR, including privacy notices and data subject rights

  • Bachelor’s degree; backgrounds in finance, law, accounting, or related fields

  • Must have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working at or with a fund administrator, transfer agent, hedge fund, or asset manager

  • Experience building or improving an AML, investor due diligence, or privacy compliance program

  • Familiarity with AML screening, KYC, or sanctions screening tools

  • Experience working in a quasi-academic, engineering-heavy culture where credibility is earned through demonstrated expertise, not authority

title: (Senior) Consultant Customer Engagement D365
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij als Senior Consultant D365 CE klaar om jouw carrière naar het volgende niveau te tillen bij HSO, één van de grootste Microsoft Gold Partners ter wereld? Sluit je aan bij ons CE team en maak het verschil!

Join the journey


Wat ga je doen?

  • Als D365 CE Senior Consultant werk je aan uitdagende projecten voor nationale en internationale klanten in diverse sectoren. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het adviseren, ontwerpen en implementeren van Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen die klanten helpen hun bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren en klantrelaties te verbeteren. Je werkt nauw samen met interne teams, projectmanager en stakeholders bij de klant om oplossingen te leveren die voldoen aan de specifieke zakelijke behoeften van elke klant. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Adviesrol: in nauwe samenwerking met de klant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen en adviseer je over de beste Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen om klantdoelen te bereiken.
  • Implementatie: je geeft leiding aan, en bent functioneel eindverantwoordelijk voor, de implementatie van Dynamics 365 CE inclusief configuratie, aanpassing en integratie met andere systemen.
  • Projectmanagement: je werkt samen met projectmanagers om de scope, planning en kwaliteit van projecten te bewaken.
  • Klantcontact: jij fungeert als sparringpartner voor klanten. Je begrijpt de klantbehoeftes en vertaalt deze naar oplossingen. Je bent op de hoogte van de laatste AI ontwikkelingen en AI functies binnen D365 en zet deze in om klanten te helpen slimmer te werken, betere inzichten te krijgen en klantrelaties op een meer gepersonaliseerde manier te beheren.
  • Teamontwikkeling: jij coacht Junior en Medior Consultants binnen het Dynamics-team en bevordert kennisdeling. Je zet je in op een professionele samenwerking met je collega’s.
  • Op de hoogte blijven: jij volgt actief de technologische trends en innovaties binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen voor onze klanten.


Over het team
Jij komt in een toegewijd team van bijna 100 CE professionals die elkaar waarderen en ondersteunen. HSO is Microsoft Gold Partner en behoort tot de top 2 van de wereld op het gebied van Dynamics 365 implementaties. De serviceline biedt op maat gemaakte oplossingen die organisaties transformeren en helpen hun digitale ambities waar te maken. Als pionier in de industie, met een focus op innovatie, klantgerichtheid en duurzame groei, is het de ideale plek voor CE professionals die hun carrière willen versnellen. Om jouw kennis te verbreden zijn er maandelijks team meetings, expertsessies en is er alle ruimte voor het volgen van trainingen, conferenties en workshops. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring ervaring met Dynamics 365 CE implementaties, bij voorkeur in een consultancy-omgeving;
  • Kennis: diepgaande kennis van Dynamics 365 CE modules zoals Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Project Operations en Marketing;
  • Technische vaardigheden: ervaring met Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), Azure en integraties met derde partijen;
  • Projectervaring: ervaring met zowel agile als watervalprojectmethodologieën;
  • Communicatie: uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Leiderschap: ervaring in het aansturen en coachen van teams en het fungeren als trusted advisor voor klanten.

Voldoe je niet aan bovenstaand profiel en heb je nog geen Dynamics 365 ervaring maar heb je wel proceskennis en ben je in staat om als sparringpartner te fungeren omdat je de uitdagingen waar onze klanten mee worstelen van dichtbij, aan bijvoorbeeld de klantkant, hebt meegemaakt. Twijfel dan niet en solliciteer!

Wat bieden we jou?    
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   


Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO   
HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Content Creator bist du die treibende Kraft für plattformstarken Content: Vom ersten Konzept über die Set-Regie bis zum KI-optimierten Master-Cut machst du Marken auf TikTok, IG & Co. unübersehbar.

  • Creative Lead & Storytelling: Im Co-Creation-Trio mit Social Media Management und klassischem Conceptor entwickelst du native Formate für TikTok, Instagram, YouTube und LinkedIn. Mit Gespür für Trends und Timing machst du daraus Content, der hängenbleibt.
  • End-to-End Regie & Dreh: Am Set übernimmst du eigenverantwortlich Produktionsleitung und Regie. Vom cineastischen High-End-Setup bis zum agilen Smartphone-Shooting erweckst du Ideen visuell zum Leben.

  • Client Sparring & Pitch: Mit Moodboards und ersten Schnittfassungen machst du Ideen greifbar. Du präsentierst deine Konzepte mit Überzeugungskraft und stehst Kund:innen bei visuellen Fragen verlässlich zur Seite.
  • Produktions- & Ressourcensteuerung: Bei größeren Projekten behältst du Budget und Timings im Blick. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für das was am Set gebraucht wird und hast kein Problem damit auch für größere Produktionen eine Technik-Liste aufzusetzen.
  • Data Insights & KI-Innovation: Performance-Daten nutzt du als Hebel für gezielte kreative Optimierungen. Gleichzeitig integrierst du generative KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in Ideation, Kreation und Editing.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Plattform-Expertise & Storytelling: Du besitzt ein exzellentes Gespür für Algorithmen, aktuelle Trends und natives Storytelling. Markenbotschaften übersetzt du zielsicher in virale und performante Formate für TikTok, Instagram, YouTube und LinkedIn.
  • Dreherfahrung & Set-Routine: Mehrjährige Praxis am Set zeichnet dich aus. Du beherrschst Kamerasysteme, Licht und Ton routiniert und behältst auch bei dynamischen Live- und Event-Drehs stets die Ruhe und den Überblick. Dabei reist du gerne auch mal zu spannenden Locations und bist offen dafür, wenn ein Event vereinzelt mal aufs Wochenende fällt.
  • High-End Postproduktion: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects und DaVinci Resolve beherrschst du auf Top-Niveau, ergänzt durch Know-how in Photoshop und Figma. Schnitt, Color Grading, Sounddesign und Motion Graphics setzt du eigenständig und stilsicher um.
  • Präsentations- & Argumentationsstärke: Du bringst visuelle Ideen überzeugend auf den Punkt, begründest gestalterische Entscheidungen fachlich fundiert vor Kund:innen und berätst verlässlich zu Machbarkeit und Bildsprache.
  • Team & Mentoring: Du hast Freude daran, Best Practices im Team zu etablieren, konstruktives Feedback zu geben und Kolleg:innen fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Performance-Gespür & KI-Tools: Du verstehst es, Performance-Daten zu lesen und in kreative Hebel für Hooks, Pacing und Visuals zu übersetzen. Generative KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Firefly oder Runway nutzt du bereits neugierig und routiniert im Arbeitsalltag.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kreativ #kommunikativ #motiviert 

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early  

  • Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

  • Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

  • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

  • Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

  • Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

  • Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

  • Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

  • Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

  • Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

You’ll thrive here if you 

  • Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

  • Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

  • Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

  • Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

  • Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

  • Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

  • Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

  • Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

  • Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

  • Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

  • Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

  • Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

  • Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken.

Darum CONCORDIA

Als Expertin für Gesundheit setzt sich die CONCORDIA für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich Mitarbeitende wohlfühlen und verwirklichen können. Es ist geprägt von abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, vielseitigen Teams und einem familiären Umgang. Zudem motivieren wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, sich weiterzuentwickeln und voranzukommen. Menschen, die Spass an der Arbeit haben und beruflich vorwärtskommen wollen, finden bei uns, was sie suchen: Jobs, die zu 100 % gesund sind.

Deine Vorteile

Ausgezeichnet von den Mitarbeitenden

About the Senior DevOps Engineer Role:

  • Managing containerized applications and orchestrating deployments using Kubernetes.
  • Ensuring security best practices are applied across CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and microservices.
  • Optimizing system performance and scalability through observability and proactive monitoring.
  • Collaborating with development teams to streamline deployment workflows and improve DevOps processes.
  • Advising clients on best practices for cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and system security.
  • Engaging in technical discussions with stakeholders and supporting project execution to ensure timely delivery.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.

What we are looking for in this person

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.

  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.

  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, ideally Kubernetes (K8s).

  • Scripting and automation expertise, preferably with Python.
  • Experience with observability tools and monitoring frameworks for system performance optimization.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

Your expedition: DevOps at Polarsteps

One person, the whole platform.

Polarsteps helps 23+ million travellers plan, track and relive their trips, and all of it runs on our infrastructure. As our DevOps Engineer, you’ll be the main point of contact for that infrastructure. You’ll work alongside our Platform team and support all 8 of our engineering teams, so everyone can ship with confidence.

There’s plenty of room to bring your own ideas and improve how we work, with a supportive team around you to figure things out together. If you enjoy being hands-on, setting up good processes and helping others make the right technical choices, this is your kind of adventure.

Our ambition is big. We want our infrastructure ready for 100 million+ users, built efficiently in both cost and resources.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day:

You will:

  • Report to Simeon, our Lead Backend Engineer, and work closely with our Platform team (Youri, William, Paco, Jimmy, Florian and Ledio) and team leads across Engineering.

  • Own the day-to-day operations of our AWS stack, including S3 and our PostgreSQL databases.

  • Spot bottlenecks in our architecture and scaling, both for users and for developer experience. You’ll create and execute a plan with Engineering and other stakeholders.

  • Review, improve and maintain our observability, monitoring and alerting.

  • Manage and respond to incidents, and keep our infrastructure and troubleshooting documentation up to date.

  • Strengthen platform security and privacy, working alongside our external security lead.

  • Lead initiatives like rolling out company-wide SSO and managing our VPN.

  • You use AI tools like Claude Code, MCP servers and AI-assisted observability (e.g. Datadog) as a daily part of your workflow, from debugging incidents and infrastructure issues to writing and reviewing code.

  • Support our Data team with the infrastructure behind our analytics stack.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you:

  • 5+ years as a DevOps Engineer, SRE or Platform Engineer.

  • Experience automating infrastructure and processes on AWS.

  • Fluency in shell scripting, Python and Terraform / OpenTofu.

  • Experience monitoring, troubleshooting and scaling a similar stack (Python, PostgreSQL/RDS) under growing load.

  • Comfort making changes to backend code when automation calls for it.

  • A pragmatic mindset: you know when to cut corners and when to build something that lasts.

  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, helping them reach decisions on complex trade-offs.

  • Autonomy and a collaborative nature. You’re happy setting up your own processes while working with everyone.

  • Knowledgeable of platform security best practices.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with Nix, Kubernetes, ArgoCD or ECS, RabbitMQ, or TypeScript on the frontend ✨

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 84.000 and 99.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working. Split your time between the office and your home, as you see fit.

  • An extensive home office set-up — everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you, but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily office lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity — be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity — makes both the world and the workplace better.

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
descriptionHtml:
👫 About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪 About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

title: Senior Engineer II, Chromium
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Security & AI Engineering team. In this role, you will bring strong systems engineering skills—ideally with hands-on Chromium experience across core layers—to build, expand, and harden the runtime capabilities that power Menlo's next-generation AI security platform. You will work at the intersection of browser engine internals, systems architecture, and AI security, expanding our detection surfaces to safeguard enterprise workforces and AI agents against modern threats like Prompt Injection (PI) and Shadow AI usage. The role blends deep C++ browser engineering with work on Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and the cloud infrastructure supporting them. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Chromium, AI, and security disciplines to ship high-performance, evasion-resistant protections, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to move fast while maintaining an uncompromising bar for quality and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Chromium-based browser components in C++, working across layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking, that power Menlo's security and AI-driven capabilities.

  • Architect and embed controls for detecting Prompt Injection (PI) and managing Shadow AI activity directly within browser execution and agent workflows.

  • Apply strong networking fundamentals and HTTP security expertise to harden Menlo's browser isolation, proxy/gateway intercepts, and network-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with the MARS and AI teams to build and integrate AI agent capabilities and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into Menlo's security platform.

  • Use Python or Rust to build supporting tooling, detection microservices, and prototypes alongside core C++ systems work.

  • Deploy and operate the cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform) needed to run agent/MCP and threat-detection workloads reliably.

  • Debug and optimize performance-critical, high-scale systems across the browser and supporting backend infrastructure.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and AI engineering teams to ship capabilities end-to-end.

  • Apply AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and code review as part of your daily workflow.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with strong C++ systems programming skills.

  • Strong networking fundamentals, including solid knowledge of HTTP security, web protocols and / or client-side security architecture.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience across Chromium layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking (or equivalent large-scale, high-performance C++ systems experience).

  • Experience or strong interest in AI/LLM security / guardrails domains (e.g., Prompt Injection defense, Shadow AI detection, intent classification, context aware DLP/PII detection, and agentic workflows).

  • Python or Rust experience.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards
descriptionHtml:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

You’ll build features on iwoca’s business credit card and own each one from the first line of code to the moment a customer makes their first spend.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds what business owners use to sign up, get their card, and manage it, on the web and in the iwoca Mobile App. It’s cross-functional – engineers collaborate with product and design.

The role

As a senior full-stack engineer, you’ll work mostly on the backend, and build the frontend for your features too.

  • Ownership. You’ll shape what the team builds next, starting from what customers need. You’ll decide how each of your features works, from the data model and API to how you test, release, and monitor it.

  • Impact. Business owners use your work every time they check their cashback, set spend controls, or freeze a lost card. The team releases often, and your changes reach them quickly.

  • Variation. You’ll write Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL, and React and TypeScript for the web. You’ll also work in React Native on the iwoca Mobile App, and on the Credit Cards CRM that operations staff use, when a feature needs it.

  • Card expertise. You’ll learn how card transactions work – from the card processor to the card scheme – alongside the engineers who build iwoca’s payments platform.

  • AI-first engineering. You’ll build with AI coding tools as standard. On the iwoca Mobile App, for example, the team writes a spec for each feature and reviews it before building it with Claude Code.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've built well-tested Python services for customer-facing products, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Data models and APIs. You've designed relational data models, ideally in PostgreSQL, and built and integrated APIs.

  • Frontend. You've written enough React and TypeScript to build and ship customer-facing features.

  • Product ownership. You've taken features from an idea to production and owned them once they were live. You've challenged a plan when it didn't meet a customer need, and offered a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Mobile. You've developed iOS or Android app features, ideally in React Native.

  • Fintech. You've worked on financial products, especially card payments.

  • FastAPI. You've built and run production services with FastAPI.

  • Internal tools. You've written software for operations or support staff.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £80K – £90K

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The International Accounting team at Planet is seeking a versatile Senior GL Accountant to maintain our books and become a key part of our global Finance team. In this pivotal position, you will serve as a core financial anchor, managing critical workflows that directly support our expanding international footprint and global operational success. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, collaborative, and analytical, bringing a strong work ethic to solve complex financial challenges. Impact You’ll Own:

  • Manage day-to-day closing and reporting activities including journal entries and reconciliations for Fixed Assets and Inventory in our Berlin Manufacturing site to ensure books are maintained in accordance with U.S. GAAP and HGB.
  • Maintain the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), tracking capital expenditures, asset additions, disposals, transfers, monthly depreciation runs, and Construction in Progress (CIP) balances with operational stakeholders.
  • Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing asset movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.
  • Maintain costs, prepayments, and accrued payables associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.
  • Support physical count / cycle count programs and analyze inventory adjustments.
  • Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.
  • Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off and high-volume periods.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German Ausbildung, e.g., Industriekaufmann/-frau, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).
  • Experience with inventory controls, Fixed Assets and multi-entity global structures.
  • Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English, the language of the company.

  • Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB)

title: Senior GTM Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a GTM Senior Product Marketing Manager who wants to take our product from 1-100, not 0-1 scale.

You will join the fastest growing unit inside tem. This team is obsessed about growing our SMB customers and transforming their perception of energy beyond the bill, so we can hand more money and value back in their hands.

You will be a hands-on product marketer who can bring sharp judgment and voice of customer consistently back to the table. Your focus is to grow the trial, adoption and experience of our RED product and be ruthless in those goals. Expect to solve problems on your own and with product, content and engineers whilst running your own team of expert GTM agents.

Good looks like? Every 48 hours you’ll be:

  • Speaking to a customer.

  • Shipping a campaign with Claude.

  • Launching a piece of work that directly solves a customer problem.

You’ll be 20% in architecting, 80% in delivery.

  • Demos: reinvent them.

  • Communications: untangle and re-build them.

  • Campaigns: drive promotional, time-sensitive campaigns.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Everyone at tem works from first principles, acts autonomously and builds. For this role, we also need these, in priority order:

    • Deeply analytical. You go to the numbers first and can explain what moved and why.
