    • Outcome-minded. You can show which of your plays moved a number and which didn’t.

    • Customer-obsessed. You start from the customer’s problem, every time.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. What You'll Be Doing

  • Design for Future:
    • Support the design and continuous improvement of the HSFE Management System.
    • Help build a proactive safety culture across sites through engaging communication, training initiatives, and site-level engagement.
    • Work with operational teams to identify emerging risks, compliance gaps, and design mitigation plans ahead of need.
    • Contribute to the design of the annual audit and inspection schedule.
    • Support the development of H&S KPIs, operational metrics, and emergency preparedness activities.
  • Deliver for Today:
    • Support site inspections, audits, and risk assessments through the timely management and resolution of identified actions.
    • Support investigations into accidents, incidents, and near-misses, identifying root causes and driving corrective actions.
    • Provide daily advice, troubleshooting, and practical guidance to managers and operational teams on all H&S matters.
    • Coordinate responses to operational H&S queries and escalate complex issues when necessary.
  • Execute with Quality:
    • Maintain H&S documentation and reporting to ensure it meets required Group-defined and regulatory standards.
    • Establish clear reporting cadences to keep stakeholders and operational leadership updated on compliance and performance.
    • Implement sustainable, effective processes that maintain a safe and compliant operational environment.

About You

You are an organized, proactive, and solutions-focused safety professional who can build instant credibility and influence at all levels of an operation. You possess meticulous attention to detail, stay calm under pressure, and take a practical approach to resolving safety issues through sound, risk-based judgements.

You'll have:

  • Solid understanding of UK health and safety legislation and its practical application within an operational environment (knowledge of international H&S legislation is a strong plus).
  • Proven experience conducting risk assessments, site audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Experience delivering practical H&S advice, training, and guidance to managers and operational staff across a multi-site network.
  • Experience developing or maintaining H&S policies, procedures, and training programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of incident reporting requirements (e.g., RIDDOR) and relevant regulatory body standards.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence positive safety behaviours across diverse teams.
  • Strong ability to produce clear, high-quality technical reports and data analysis, including incident trend analysis.
  • Qualifications: NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent) is desirable; NEBOSH Diploma (or working towards it) is an advantage.

What You'll Get in Return

Our employee benefits are designed with our people in mind because we know they are at the heart of everything we do.

Alongside challenging work and clear opportunities for professional development, we offer:

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

Du konzipierst Integrationsarchitekturen, entwirfst Datenflüsse und stellst sicher, dass Power Platform und Dynamics nahtlos zusammenarbeiten.
  • Governance, Landing Zones & ALM
    Du hilfst Kunden dabei, eine stabile und zukunftsfähige Power-Platform-Umgebung aufzubauen. Dazu gehört das Ausarbeiten von Governance-Konzepten, die Planung und Umsetzung von Landing Zones, die Strukturierung von Environments sowie die Definition von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards. Gleichzeitig treibst du strukturiertes Application Lifecycle Management voran, baust durchdachte Solution-Strukturen auf und nutzt DevOps-Pipelines, um Entwicklungs- und Deploymentprozesse zu professionalisieren.
  • Geschäftsprozessanalyse & Lösungsdesign

Im engen Austausch mit Stakeholdern übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in saubere Datenmodelle, Logiken, Automatisierungen und Integrationsarchitekturen. Dabei kombinierst du Low-Code- und Pro-Code-Ansätze so, dass Lösungen nachhaltig wartbar und technisch fundiert sind.
  • Datenmanagement, virtuelle Entities & Dataflows
    Du arbeitest mit relationalen Datenbanken, entwirfst Datenmodelle und entwickelst Datenarchitekturen, die optimal zu den Geschäftsanforderungen passen. Du bindest externe Systeme über virtuelle Entities an, nutzt Dataflows und Power Query für ETL-Prozesse und sorgst für konsistente und saubere Datenstrukturen innerhalb von Dataverse. Die Kombination aus Datenmodellierung, technischer Integration und Plattformwissen ermöglicht dir, komplexe Datenlandschaften ganzheitlich zu gestalten.
  • Workshops & Enablement
    Du führst Workshops durch, schulst Fachbereiche und ermöglichst Kundenteams, die Power Platform kompetent und sicher einzusetzen. Dabei vermittelst du Best Practices, erklärst Lösungsansätze verständlich und baust eine langfristige Kompetenz bei den Nutzern auf.

Qualifikationen

    Du entwickelst professionelle Model-Driven Apps, modellierst Dataverse-Strukturen, setzt Geschäftslogiken mit Power Automate um, arbeitest mit Power Pages und nutzt Custom Connectors, AI Builder und erste Funktionen aus Copilot Studio. ALM und Solution-Management sind dir vertraut.

  • Kommunikationsstärke & Leidenschaft für moderne Microsoft-Technologien
    Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie die Motivation, dich in Themen wie Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI & Copilot weiterzuentwickeln.

Vorteile & über HSO

  • Self Determination: Bei uns steht die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe im Mittelpunkt - mit deinen Ideen und Erfahrungen kannst du dich bei uns einbringen, eigenständig agieren und damit den Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten
  • Team Spirit: Da Menschen bei HSO den Unterschied machen, kannst du dich auf eine unterstützende, vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen
  • Learning & Growth: Wir werden dich mit Trainingsangeboten durch unsere hauseigene HSO Academy und externe Schulungspartner in Kombination mit einem individuellen Karrierepfad fördern
  • Onboarding@HSO: Wir heißen dich in unserem Office in Böblingen willkommen - du startest deine ersten Onboarding-Tage bei uns vor Ort, um dich mit unserer Unternehmenskultur, unseren Prozessen und Tools vertraut zu machen

  • Appreciation: Ein attraktives Gehaltsmodell inklusive 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterangebote, Bikeleasing, Gesundheitsförderung durch EGYM Wellpass, Geburtstagsgutscheine und außergewöhnliche Events runden dein HSO-Feel-Good-Paket ab

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - Germany)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)

💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by taking technical ownership of the electrical test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of electrical test equipment and functional-test capability for flight hardware, engineering models and test beds, from early definition through delivery, use and maintenance

  • Establish and maintain a practical development and readiness plan so that test equipment and software are available for early engineering-model testing and subsequent flight-hardware testing

  • Define and assess electrical test-equipment and functional-test needs, making requirements, interfaces, safety constraints, risks and dependencies visible and driving their resolution

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into complete, traceable functional-test strategies, procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Lead the electrical design, integration, build, troubleshooting and maintenance of test equipment and its software, including power, signal, communication and measurement interfaces

  • Develop and review automated functional-test software, data acquisition and test sequences in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand, with clear interlocks, limit checks, safe-stop behaviour and maintainable test records

  • Define and review test-equipment architecture, instrumentation, cabling, schematics, interface definitions, configuration and verification evidence

  • Plan and support test readiness reviews, ensuring that hardware, test equipment, software, procedures, safety controls and acceptance criteria are fit for use before testing begins

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware, including hands-on test preparation and execution

  • Lead technical investigation of test anomalies, assess test data, distinguish unit-under-test issues from test-system issues, and support non-conformance disposition, retest and closure

  • Coordinate electrical test activities and technical interfaces with MAIT, design, systems, software, quality and other relevant teams

  • Provide technical guidance and review to other engineers and technicians, sharing good practice in test design, execution, troubleshooting and evidence capture

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components where required

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Significant hands-on experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan and deliver electrical or functional tests for complex hardware, from requirements and interfaces through test execution and evidence review

  • Strong practical experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test strategy, procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly and commissioning of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop and review software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation, measurement-chain verification and systematic troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Experience preparing hardware and test systems for controlled testing, including safety controls, configuration management and objective test records

  • Ability to lead technical anomaly investigations, communicate uncertainty and risk, and agree evidence-based retest or closure actions

  • Experience providing technical guidance, reviewing work or sharing good practice with colleagues

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fuent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Senior Manager PR and Communications APAC
descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Manager, Communications & PR, APAC to help drive OKX’s communications and media relations activities across the region. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong media relationships, excellent storytelling skills and a proven ability to deliver high-impact PR campaigns. You’ll work closely with regional business leaders, marketing and product teams, and the global communications function to support major announcements, strengthen OKX’s reputation and generate meaningful media coverage. We’re looking for a proactive self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments, can independently manage communications initiatives from planning through execution, and knows how to turn business developments into compelling stories. Experience in or a passion for cryptocurrency and digital assets is a strong advantage. Candidates based in Hong Kong, Singapore and Australia are encouraged to apply. Remote arrangements may also be considered in selected APAC locations. We operate with regional flexibility and a results-first culture, with a focus on impact and outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support the development and execution of OKX’s APAC communications strategy, delivering impactful PR campaigns and initiatives across key regional markets.
  • Work closely with regional business leaders, marketing, product, legal and compliance teams to identify and execute communications opportunities aligned with business priorities.
  • Leverage and expand relationships with journalists, editors and influential industry voices across APAC, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as global tier-one media covering the region.
  • Proactively identify, pitch and secure compelling stories in leading business, financial, broadcast, technology and crypto publications, driving consistent, high-quality media coverage.
  • Manage communications for regional product launches, business announcements, partnerships and executive thought leadership initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the global communications team to support international announcements and adapt global campaigns for APAC audiences.
  • Identify and activate PR opportunities through OKX’s global partnerships, including McLaren F1 Team and Manchester City Football Club.
  • Develop high-quality press releases, media pitches, executive briefing materials, talking points, messaging and other communications content.
  • Support regional executives with media interviews, speaking opportunities and thought leadership activities.
  • Manage PR agency relationships and coordinate external partners to deliver against agreed objectives.
  • Support issues management and crisis communications, working closely with regional stakeholders and the global communications team.
  • Monitor media coverage, track PR performance and report on results, with a focus on coverage quality, reputation and business impact.

What We Look For In You

  • 8–12 years of experience in PR and communications, ideally within financial services, fintech or technology.
  • Strong, established media relationships across APAC are highly valued, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as connections with global tier-one business, financial and broadcast media covering the region.
  • Demonstrated success securing high-quality coverage in leading international and regional publications and delivering impactful PR campaigns.
  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technical developments into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Experience supporting product launches, corporate announcements, executive communications and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Experience in financial and investment communications is an advantage.
  • Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets or Web3, or a genuine passion for the industry, is a strong advantage.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with senior executives and cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, identify opportunities and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across different markets.
  • Experience managing PR agencies and external communications partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism or a related field.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in other regional languages is an advantage.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees’ growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website. descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • You’ll be the focal point between product development (Engineering) and industrialization (Manufacturing)
  • Ensure manufacturing optimized design decisions from early project phases. Advise and consult the engineering team based on your expertise in manufacturing.
  • Represent manufacturing in concept development, design meetings and design reviews. Flagging risks and proactively developing solutions and suggestions for improvements.
  • Follow the entire manufacturing engineering process until full production rate to capture lessons learned and best practices from each program to implement into following design projects.
  • Develop tools and processes to ensure an effective and efficient DFM process, supportive to Engineering teams and overall accelerating the time to market and efficiency.
  • Suggest technologies and processes to be considered. Initiate strategic competence build-up if beneficial and required to a program.
  • Work with vendors and equipment manufacturers to identify innovative solutions to manufacturing problems. Drive co-development for highly specialized processes & technologies.
  • Operate as a manufacturing all‑rounder, bridging detailed process design with factory‑level thinking to ensure coherent design and seamless integration into the manufacturing system at exceptional industrialization speed.
  • Identify process‑level risks and trade‑offs early, driving mitigations through design, analysis, or process changes.
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including drawings, specifications, and design justifications.
  • Act as a technically credible problem‑solver in ambiguous environments, closing decisions and keeping programs moving at pace.

Who you are
  • A senior Manufacturing Engineer with firsthand expertise and experience in manufacturing / assembly. Ideally combined with experience in product design or previous DFM roles.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated manufacturing systems. Ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance, cross functional environments under intense time pressure.
  • Managing partners and suppliers proficiently and effectively. Motivating everyone to go above and beyond to achieve common goals and timelines.
  • Dealing well with ambiguity and uncertainty, willing to anticipate, test and reconsider if necessary.
  • Comfortable operating at multiple levels of abstraction from detailed design to work center‑ or system‑level.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated systems, ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance hardware environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals covering process- and product design
  • Pragmatic and delivery‑focused, able to make sound engineering trade‑offs without over‑engineering
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and acting as a technical integrator, not just a specialist.
  • Hands‑on by instinct, willing to support build, integration, and test when needed.
  • Calm and effective in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where priorities evolve.
  • Motivated by building real, high‑consequence hardware where mechanical and system correctness truly matter.

What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

Security and Eligibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - Agency
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your mission: drive ARR growth by turning hundreds (soon thousands) of n8n agency partners into a demand engine through scaled marketing programs.

Our agency partner network includes automation specialists and small consultancies with most ranging from 1–50 people. They leverage n8n to help their customers automate and transform their business - they have technical skills and customer knowledge but most have limited marketing resources.

The goal for this position is to define, build and launch creative marketing programs that our agency partners can utilize to grow their business with n8n. This will include building scalable self-serve programs (one to many) as well as working with some of the larger agency partners on specific marketing programs (one to one). Here’s an overview of what this position will be responsible for:

Build the program portfolio - Drive adoption

  • Work directly with the agency partner marketing managers to define the overall strategy - what playbooks, what investments, what markets etc.

  • Ship ready-to-run programs: Event-in-a-Box kits for local workshops and seminars, email and social campaigns, industry-specific use-case campaigns, reusable customer stories and simple demand-gen playbooks.

  • Make every program executable without help: clear steps, editable templates and localisable assets that work for a solo consultant and a 50-person agency, in any region.

  • Drive awareness and adoption of the various marketing programs through scaled and creative communications.

Measure and multiply

  • Track the full funnel from access to download, execution, customer opportunities and revenue — for partners and for n8n.

  • Use partner feedback and performance data to decide what to scale, what to change and what to stop.

  • Turn each working program into a repeatable model for the next one, and automate your own program operations with n8n where it saves time.

  • Measure the overall business impact and growth from agency partner generated business.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Partner marketing at scale: You've built one-to-many programs adopted by hundreds or thousands of partners, and can show adoption numbers

  • Self-service program design: You've packaged marketing so non-marketers can run it (kits, templates, playbooks) and know what makes them get used rather than downloaded

  • Small-business empathy: You understand how small consultancies work and design for their limited time, budget and marketing know-how

  • Outcome-driven measurement: You measure execution and pipeline, not asset views, and you're comfortable stopping a program that isn't working

  • Bias for action: You're happy as a first hire with limited design and development support; you ship a pilot quickly and improve it with real data

  • Global mindset: You've run programs across several regions and segments, and know how to localise without rebuilding from scratch

 

Nice-to-have

  • Strategic partner programs: You've also built custom marketing programs with large partners that ran over several months or quarters

  • Channel or ecosystem background: You've worked on an agency, solutions-partner or reseller program at a software company

  • Hands-on with automation: You've built workflows yourself — in n8n or similar tools — and can talk shop with technical partners

  • Local events: You've designed field events or workshops that others delivered

  • Languages: You work professionally in a language beyond English

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Senior People Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Senior People Business Partner

As a Senior People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. This is our most senior individual contributor People Business Partner role, where you translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Partner with senior leaders and Leadership Team members on organizational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and organizational health.

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 6 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or People Business Partner in a fast growing international organization.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission by helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity.

  • Great career development opportunities in a growing company.

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Attractive pension plan with the full premium covered by us.

  • Hybrid working model.

  • Policies that support working parents.

  • Healthy lunch at the office.

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists through OpenUp.

  • An additional holiday every year to celebrate Liberation Day on May 5.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Senior People Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

  

The Role

You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat.

You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval.

What You'll Do

  • Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month

  • Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers.

  • Manage commission review, approvals, exceptions, ns and payment accuracy each cycle; reconcile commission data between sales systems, Finance, and payroll

  • Own equity grant administration: approvals, documentation, vesting schedules, leaver events, exercises, cap table reconciliation and employee communications

  • Build and improve people workflows in Humans, Ashby and connected systems, using automation to remove manual steps from pay reviews, promotion packs, onboarding and routine queries.

  • Own onboarding, probation, employment changes, transfers, parental leave, and offboarding end-to-end: coordinate access, equipment, payroll and documentation across People, IT, Finance and hiring managers

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR generalist experience in a scaling technology business or high-growth scaleup, with meaningful hands-on work in payroll, mobility, PEOs and benefits

  • Track record of building and running multi-country people processes from the ground up, not just maintaining existing structures.

  • Confidence owning payroll controls, global mobility operations and equity administration across multiple jurisdictions

  • Strong data literacy and experience with HRIS platforms, payroll systems and ATS integrations, with a bias toward automation over manual work

  • Clear written communicator who can produce clean documentation and audit-ready records

Valued

  • Experience independently owning multi-country payroll, mobility and equity through a scale up's growth phase.

  • Familiarity with PEO relationships, renewals and service management

  • Experience with commission administration and pooling

How We Work

We're an office-first team in London. You'll be based at our offices on Paul Street and expect to work in-office as your default. We work together because it helps us move faster, collaborate closely across Finance, IT and People, and stay sharp on detail.

This role sits at the center of trust for the whole company. We expect high standards of accuracy, timeliness and data integrity. You'll manage sensitive information and ensure payments, visas, and equity records are handled properly.

People will come to you with urgent requests and competing priorities. You need to stay organised, keep control of your workload, and know when to push back and when to escalate. This isn't a role for someone who needs a heavy process or lots of direction.

  

Why Wordsmith

We're scaling fast across product, commercial, and engineering, and People operations is foundational to that growth. Every new hire adds complexity to payroll, visas, benefits, and equity. Getting that right, automated, ed and audit-ready is what lets us move quickly without losing control.

This role is a key foundational hire. You'll be building the systems and processes that scale with us from ~130 people toward 300. You'll have real ownership over how the function works, and a clear seat in how we operate.

You'll report to our Head of People (or interim People leader, with a clear line to a future Head of People), work closely with Finance and leadership, and have meaningful say in how we run the function.

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We're changing how the world moves money. Wallets are where that change becomes real: the first place millions of people truly own their money. You'll own design execution across our wallets, working directly with the Design Lead to shape where they go next.

Responsibilities

  • Own design execution end to end: from concept and prototype to launch and iteration.

  • Turn complex, conceptual ideas into experiences that feel simple to someone using a wallet for the first time.

  • Prototype fast and often: high-fidelity and interactive, in days not weeks, using the best tools available, AI included.

  • Partner daily with product, engineering and research, and present your work clearly to leadership.

  • Raise the bar for quality across everything we ship.

  • Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including AI tools to accelerate ideation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

title: (Senior) Product Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
descriptionHtml:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Product Engineer, you own features from start to finish: from conversations with customers and concept work through to implementation and continuous improvement in production.

What you can work on:

  • Understanding customers and the market. You talk to users, join customer meetings and analyse usage data. This way, you find out where MAIA can help most in people's daily work. You work closely with product management and customer success.

  • From problem to concept. You write concepts, build prototypes to test ideas quickly, and slice features so they reach users early.

  • Building across the full stack. You write the implementation plan, let coding agents implement it, and own architecture and quality, from the data model to the user interface.

  • AI that people understand. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context, letting agents complete multi-step tasks and following their results.

  • Measuring and improving. After a release, you check whether a feature is used and actually helps, and you keep improving it based on feedback, usage data and evals.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built products that people use every day and operated them in production, across backend and frontend. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • Product experience. You have talked to customers, questioned requirements and taken features from the first idea to daily use. You listen closely and recognise the problem behind a request.

  • A feel for good usability. You notice when an interface overwhelms people, and you'd rather build a simple solution that people understand than a powerful one that nobody finds.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects, and you know their quirks: answers vary, take time, and agents fail in unexpected places. You build products that deal with this honestly.

  • Measure, don't guess. You check whether a feature works using usage data, feedback and evals. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. People understand your concepts on first read. You enjoy talking to customers as much as to engineers. You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, as many of our customer conversations are in German.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview that also covers product decisions and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

title: Senior Product Manager – Account (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Account squad in our European tribe. You’ll own the foundations that let us onboard firms, clients and accounts across Europe, and shape the products we build on top of them.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Account squad sits at the centre of both.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. Working alongside a small, high-impact European team, our Compliance and Commercial colleagues and key European clients, you’ll play a central role in taking us from a deep Irish proposition to a scalable European one.

What you’ll own

  • Launching an Irish Personal Investment Account (PIA). This is a new tax-incentivised product that isn’t yet live in the market, which makes it a genuine first mover opportunity for Seccl and our clients. Moving quickly and getting it right will matter.

  • Introducing jurisdiction into the Seccl platform, so products, rules and regulation can vary by country without rebuilding it each time

  • Building the foundations that let us scale onboarding for firms, clients and accounts and expand at speed across Europe

  • Integrating a third-party pension provider, so Irish firms can offer their clients a fuller suite of products

  • Turning Irish and European regulatory requirements into clear product requirements, working closely with Compliance

  • Defining and prioritising the Account squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with the foundations Europe will need

  • Breaking down complex problems like jurisdiction into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Adapting and extending UK product and engineering capabilities for European markets

  • Making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value in a highly regulated environment

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in account, onboarding or customer lifecycle products in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions or insurance)

  • You have launched regulated products into European markets and understand how requirements can differ from one country to the next

  • You have experience of integrating with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

  • You’re comfortable in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments, making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive, creating momentum rather than waiting for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, focused on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional teams, working with Compliance, Commercial and Engineering and communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Desirable: you’ve launched regulated products into European markets, or integrated with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

This role isn’t for you if:

  • You rely on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes.

  • You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet.

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver.

  • You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle. 

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £75K – £90K

descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.

The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.

Make day-one success the default

  • Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

  • Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

  • Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..

Build and run provider partnerships

  • Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

  • Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

  • Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.

Shape the enterprise AI gateway

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager you will own the narrative for UFORCE products: what each platform is for, whom it serves, and the language that makes both immediately clear. The positioning, messaging frameworks and arguments produced in this role are what the rest of the company works from - sales, press, government relations, the website and the exhibition stand.

The role is the bridge between the engineers who build the systems and the people who sell them. It requires sustained time with both, and with the operators who use the products, until the technology can be explained effortlessly.

It also carries custody of that language. The standard is uncompromising: no document that overclaims, no adjective that would not survive a procurement review. The narrative is expected to iterate at the pace of the products.

What you will do

  • Own positioning and messaging for products, and maintain the frameworks that keep it consistent across markets, languages and audiences.

  • Produce the materials the company sells with: one-pagers, capability briefs, specification sheets, sales decks, demonstration narratives and launch content.

  • Maintain a current assessment of the competitive landscape - the neo-primes, the incumbent primes and the low-cost entrants - and convert it into positioning rather than description.

  • Brief designers, 3D artists and film-makers so that a complex system is legible visually.

  • Provide PR, communications and government relations with the product substance their work depends on, and ensure claims remain consistent wherever they appear.

  • Lead go-to-market for new products and capabilities, covering audience, message, materials, sequencing and timing.

  • Travel to events, facilities and customer engagements.

Required Skills

  • Substantial experience marketing hardware or software within a technology company, including ownership of at least one launch from positioning through to market.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without loss of accuracy.

  • Exceptional writing and editing across registers. Copy for engineers, procurement, investors and press are four distinct disciplines.

  • The ability to brief a creative such that the resulting image or video explains a system rather than decorating it.

  • A record of cross-functional work with product and engineering teams, and a willingness to keep asking elementary questions until the answer is clear.

  • Ability to obtain UK national security clearance if required

Nice to have

  • Experience in defence, dual-use or uncrewed systems, whether in industry or in service

  • Experience working with engineering or operational teams remotely

  • Complementary skills in design or video

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?
